Pairs with reverse prompt engineering — ask a model to restate a desired outcome as PromptMN to surface inferred roles, constraints, and missing assumptions before acting.

news.title: Pulling The REINS: Training-Free Safety Alignment of Video Diffusion Models via Representation Steering
news.summary: Existing defenses for video diffusion either need expensive safety fine-tuning (degrades capability) or external filters (bypassed by adversarial prompts). REINS shows safety-relevant structure is linearly encoded in hidden states, and a single direction found via Supervised PCA on binary safety labels separates safe from unsafe generation trajectories. Steering at an intermediate transformer layer (~50% depth) redirects to safe alternatives with no weight updates.

news.title: RepSelect: Robust LLM Unlearning via Representation Selectivity
news.summary: Existing LLM unlearning methods are easily reversed by fine-tuning or few-shot prompting because they target representations shared with the retain set. RepSelect isolates forget-set-specific representations by collapsing the top principal components of weight gradients before each update, leaving general capabilities intact while limiting what a fine-tuning attacker can recover.

news.title: 2026 世界人工智能大会 (WAIC) 倒计时 30 天：300+ 款 AI 新品全球首发
news.summary: 央视新闻 6 月 17 日报道，2026 WAIC 将于 7 月 17-20 日在上海举办，主题"智能伙伴，共创未来"，展览总面积超 10 万平方米，吸引 1100+ 企业参展，集中展示 3000+ 项技术产品，其中 300+ 款 AI 新品全球首发；算力、自主系统两大核心赛道各聚集 200+ 企业，180 家初创入驻创新专区。已促成意向合作金额 162 亿元，落地 57 个实体应用场景，十余家头部创投机构设立专属对接专区。

news.title: CVPR 2026 Best Paper Finalist：15 篇入围，华人研究者主导
news.summary: 2026 CVPR 在丹佛落幕，Best Paper Finalist 共 15 篇入围作，华人研究者主导主要获奖项。研究焦点已从参数规模与单点性能，转向"保留旧知识 + 适应真实世界"——多模态持续学习、视觉-语言模型无灾难遗忘、面向高风险场景的 Agentic 可靠性成为新主线，与 arXiv 6 月热度高度一致。

news.title: OpenAI 一季度烧钱 37 亿美元，现金储备逆势膨胀至 730 亿
news.summary: OpenAI 向股东披露 2026 Q1 财务文件：单季营收 57 亿美元（同比三倍），现金流出 37 亿（占营收 65%，亦同比三倍），净亏损 213 亿美元（含近 124 亿非现金会计调整）。期末现金及有价证券从 2025 年底的 400 亿跃升至 730 亿以上，主要得益于 3 月一轮大额融资。营收扩张跑不赢烧钱速度，AI 头部公司商业化压力进一步显性化。

news.title: 上交所落地科创板第五套上市标准：AI 大模型企业迎来 IPO 绿色通道
news.summary: 6 月 17 日上交所发布《人工智能大模型企业适用科创板第五套上市标准审核指引》，首次允许尚未形成一定收入规模的优质大模型企业在科创板发行上市，要求商业化路径清晰、不存在明显不可持续经营风险。6 月 18 日 A 股 AI 主题指数跳空高开，AI 人工智能 ETF 平安五连涨，昆仑万维涨超 11%。该政策被业内视为"大模型六小龙"（智谱、MiniMax、阶跃、月之暗面等）批量登陆资本市场的关键信号。

news.title: 逆矩阵科技 (Physis) 完成超亿美元种子++轮融资，蚂蚁集团战略入局
news.summary: 钛媒体 6 月 18 日披露，北大青年学者陈博远与吉嘉铭联合创立的世界模型公司逆矩阵科技完成超亿美元种子++轮融资，由经纬创投、光合创投、五源资本、BAI 资本、钟鼎资本共同参与，蚂蚁集团战略投资，老股东高瓴创投与燕缘创投持续超额加注。资金将主要用于通用世界基座模型的预训练研发与规模化训练体系搭建，强化学习与世界模型是公司核心方向。

news.title: Fixed-Point Reasoners: Stable and Adaptive Deep Looped Transformers
news.summary: FPRM is a Transformer-based Fixed-Point Reasoning Model that uses fixed-point convergence as an end-to-end halting mechanism in a looped architecture. Adds pre-norm layers and residual scaling to fix signal propagation at depth, so the model can adapt its compute to task difficulty.

news.title: Learning from the Self-future: On-policy Self-distillation for dLLMs (d-OPSD)
news.summary: First on-policy self-distillation framework tailored for diffusion LLMs (dLLMs). Reframes self-teacher construction by using self-generated answers as suffix conditioning (learning from self future-experience rather than privileged prefixes), and shifts supervision from token-level to step-level to match dLLM iterative denoising.

news.title: Looped World Models (LoopWM)
news.summary: The first looped architecture for world modeling. A parameter-shared transformer block iteratively refines latent environment states, with adaptive computation that scales depth to the difficulty of each prediction step. Claims up to 100x parameter efficiency over conventional world models.

news.title: Variable-Width Transformers: x-shaped greater-less-former
news.summary: A new transformer design that abandons constant layer width: early and late layers are kept wide, while middle layers are narrowed via a parameter-free residual resizing mechanism, creating an x-shaped capacity profile. Across 200M-2B dense and 3B MoE decoder-only LMs, this consistently beats parameter-matched uniform baselines.

news.title: Zone of Proximal Policy Optimization (ZPPO): Teacher in Prompts, Not Gradients
news.summary: A new distillation method inspired by Vygotsky zone of proximal development. The teacher lives inside the prompt (not the gradient) - on hard questions where all student rollouts fail, ZPPO injects teacher responses as anonymized candidates the student must discriminate, recirculating each question until the student graduates past it.

news.title: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5 与孪生版本 Mythos 5,主打"安全对齐 + 极致能力"双轨
news.summary: 6 月 9 日,Anthropic 正式发布旗舰模型 Claude Fable 5 及其孪生版本 Claude Mythos 5,Fable 5 是首个面向公众开放的 Mythos 系模型,标志着大模型竞争从"参数规模"转向"安全对齐 + 能力"双轨阶段。

news.title: arXiv 热点:Agentic 系统可靠性与多模态持续学习成 6 月研究焦点
news.summary: 6 月 arXiv 投稿显示两大主线:一是 ProtoAda 与 CRAM 等多篇论文推进视觉-语言模型的"无灾难遗忘"持续学习;二是围绕 Agentic AI 部署可靠性展开的安全评估、检查点与神经符号方法激增,高风险应用(临床、金融、机器人)关注度显著上升。

news.title: Google I/O 2026:首发 Gemini 3.5 Flash,Gemini App 月活破 9 亿
news.summary: 5 月 20 日 Google I/O 推出 Gemini 3.5 系列,首发成员 Gemini 3.5 Flash,官方公布基准测试数据较前代显著提升。皮查伊主题演讲披露 Gemini App 月活用户数已超 9 亿,Google 全面进入 Agent 时代。

news.title: Meta 在新 AI 负责人 Alexandr Wang 主导下推进新一代模型,部分版本将开源
news.summary: Meta 正准备发布新一代 AI 模型,部分版本将向开发者提供开源授权,核心组件仍保留为专有;公司同时评估模型安全风险,在确认安全后逐步提供可修改的开源版本。这是 Wang 上任后推出的首批模型。

news.title: Mistral AI 估值或达 200 亿欧元,推进 D 轮 30 亿欧元融资
news.summary: 欧洲 AI 独角兽 Mistral AI 正与早期投资者接触,寻求以 200 亿欧元估值进行 D 轮融资,目标筹集约 30 亿欧元。此前 5 月 Mistral 刚为受限银行机构推出专用本地化 AI 推理模型,加速欧洲金融垂直落地。

news.title: NVIDIA Blackwell 横扫 MLPerf Training 6.0 全部 7 项基准
news.summary: MLCommons 发布 MLPerf Training 6.0 榜单,NVIDIA Blackwell 平台在 7 项基准中全部拿下最快训练成绩,是唯一覆盖全部测试项目的平台,继续巩固其在 AI 训练基础设施的统治地位。

news.title: 美商务部以国家安全为由暂停 Claude Fable 5 / Mythos 5 全球访问,Anthropic 公开反驳
news.summary: 美国商务部下达出口管制指令,要求 Anthropic 立即中止所有外籍用户对 Fable 5 与 Mythos 5 的访问权限。Anthropic 发布长篇声明与《安全态势更新》,首次公开反驳政府的安全评估结论,在 AI 行业前所未有。同日亚马逊 CEO 被曝与美国官员就模型安全举行会谈。

news.title: 黄仁勋首次表态:NVIDIA Blackwell GPU"确实有可能"进入中国大陆
news.summary: 在 2026 财年第二财季财报会议后采访中,黄仁勋首次对外表示 NVIDIA"确实有可能"将先进 Blackwell GPU 引入中国大陆,同时敦促美国政府为美国芯片制造商开放市场,中美 AI 算力博弈进入新阶段。

news.title: Anthropic 上线企业级 Claude 追踪与合作伙伴中心
news.summary: 6 月 4 日 Anthropic 推出服务跟踪器（Service Tracker）与合作伙伴中心（Partner Hub），帮助企业追踪 Claude 生成内容与发布需求的匹配度，强化企业落地能力。

news.title: ArXiv 6 月热点：Agent 可靠性 + 多模态持续学习
news.summary: ArXiv AI Research Digest 6/3 期指出，本周重点集中在 Agentic 系统可靠性、ProtoAda / CRAM 等多模态持续学习（无灾难性遗忘）、以及面向扩散语言模型与分子动力学的 Speculative Decoding 变体。

news.title: Google I/O 2026：Gemini 3.5 Flash 上线，Omni 多模态路线发布
news.summary: Google 在 I/O 2026 推出 Gemini 3.5 Flash（已在 coding/agent 基准超过 3.1 Pro）以及 Gemini Omni（视频生成与多模态生成），并发布常驻 Agent。

news.title: Hugging Face 发布 LeRobot Humanoid 双足机器人，$2500 起
news.summary: 5 月 21 日 HF 推出面向机器人开发者的 LeRobot Humanoid，提供软硬件全套方案，入门价 2500 美元（约 1.7 万人民币），推动开源人形机器人开发门槛下沉。

news.title: OpenAI 旗舰模型 + Codex 登陆 AWS，多云分发开打
news.summary: OpenAI 官方宣布前沿模型与 Codex 正式在 AWS 可用，企业可在现有 AWS 流程中调用，模型厂商与云厂商进入"既合作又竞争"的新阶段。

news.title: OpenAI 秘密递交 S-1，IPO 进程提速
news.summary: OpenAI 已向 SEC 秘密递交 S-1 注册草案，正式启动 IPO 流程；同日发布"AI 惠及所有人"长期计划与 Economic Research Exchange，研究 AI 对就业与生产率影响。

news.title: 欧盟发布"技术主权"一揽子方案，抢夺 AI 与云计算主导权
news.summary: 欧盟委员会公布 European Technological Sovereignty Package，针对 AI、云计算、数据中心推出整体战略，目标在 2026 年内减少对美企依赖并加快本土 AI 算力与监管框架建设。

news.title: 英国议员起诉 xAI：指控 Grok 生成深度伪造色情图像
news.summary: 英国工党议员 Jess Asato 在高等法院起诉 xAI，指控 Grok 未经许可生成其深度伪造色情图像，依据英国数据保护法要求赔偿、公开认错并颁布禁令。

news.title: 阿里千问 AI 眼镜线上份额突破 30%
news.summary: 奥维云网 3-4 月数据显示，千问 AI 眼镜全系列（含夸克 AI 眼镜）线上零售额份额达 30.4%，持续位居国内线上市场第一，AI 眼镜赛道进入消费落地阶段。

news.title: Diffusion-Proof: Recipe for Formal Theorem Proving Beyond Auto-Regressive Generation
news.summary: First framework to train and deploy diffusion LLMs for formal theorem proving. Ships dLLM-Prover-7B for whole-proof generation and dLLM-Corrector-7B for in-filling-based local proof repair, gaining +1.61% on ProofNet-Test and +6.14% on MiniF2F-Test over a same-data AR baseline — and solving an IMO problem DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B cannot.

news.title: DreamReasoner-8B: Block-Size Curriculum Learning for Diffusion Reasoning Models
news.summary: First systematic study of how block size affects long chain-of-thought training in diffusion LLMs. Finds that large training blocks kill reasoning quality, and proposes a curriculum that grows the block size from fine to coarse, recovering performance competitive with Qwen3-8B on math and code.

news.title: OmniAgent: Native Active Perception as Reasoning for Omni-Modal Understanding
news.summary: A native omni-modal agent that treats long-video understanding as a POMDP-based Observation-Thought-Action cycle, decoupled from raw video duration. Trained with agentic SFT plus TAURA reinforcement learning, a 7B model beats Qwen2.5-VL-72B on LVBench (50.5% vs 47.3%) and shows positive test-time scaling with reasoning turns.

news.title: Rethinking Reward Supervision: Rubric-Conditioned Self-Distillation
news.summary: Replaces single-reference chain-of-thought distillation and scalar RLVR with rubric-conditioned self-distillation: a teacher model consumes criterion-level rubrics and emits token-level guidance on the student's own on-policy rollouts. Beats GRPO by +1.0 and OPSD by +0.9 average across science-reasoning benchmarks.

news.title: A Multi-Domain Benchmark for Detecting AI-Generated Text-Rich Images from GPT-Image-2
news.summary: 8,602-image benchmark across 6 categories (posters, infographics, academic posters, receipts, tables, UI screenshots) targeting GPT-Image-2 text-rich outputs. Zero-shot evaluation of 5 detectors shows performance is wildly domain-dependent — strong on some, failing on others — and even the best conventional detector is severely sensitive to JPEG compression. A VLM-as-judge pilot shows mixed promise.

news.title: Does VLA Even Know the Basics? Measuring Commonsense and World Knowledge Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models
news.summary: Introduces Act2Answer , a benchmark protocol that turns VLM knowledge benchmarks into short tabletop action-grounded episodes for Vision-Language-Action models. Across 7 VLAs and 9 VLM baselines, finds VLAs retain commonsense well but degrade on richer semantic categories, that VQA co-training preserves knowledge better, and that answer-relevant signals peak in middle layers and attenuate at the top — the action head is overwriting them.

news.title: Enhancing Decision-Making with Large Language Models through Multi-Agent Fictitious Play
news.summary: Identifies stance entanglement — the failure mode of standard divide-and-conquer MAS on tasks where stakeholders' decisions are mutually dependent. Proposes MAFP (Multi-Agent Fictitious Play), which represents each stakeholder as an agent and runs classical fictitious-play: each agent best-responds to the empirical mixture of others' past decisions, iteratively exposing and patching weaknesses. Outperforms both single-round and multi-round baselines on tournament strength and robustness metrics.

news.title: Amazon Pushes Prime Day Into June for the First Time Since 2021
news.summary: Amazon confirmed Prime Day 2026 will run June 23–26 (4 days), moving the event up from its traditional mid-July slot. The early timing — Amazon's first June Prime Day since 2021 — is a defensive move against Temu/Shein price competition post-de-minimis and targets back-to-school spending. The event covers 35+ categories with millions of deals for 200M+ paid Prime members globally. Walmart's market-share counter is reportedly launching its own competing "Walmart Deals" event in the same window.

news.title: China Retail Sales Fall 0.6% YoY in May — First Contraction Since December 2022
news.summary: China's National Bureau of Statistics reported May retail sales down 0.6% year-on-year, sharply missing the 0.0% consensus and reversing April's +0.2%. Auto sales collapsed 22.3% YoY as the consumer goods trade-in subsidy program pulled forward demand; home appliances and furniture also weakened. Industrial output rose 4.5% but fixed-asset investment fell 4.1% and property investment sank 16.2%.

news.title: China's "Instant Retail" War: Meituan's $717M Dingdong Buy, Box Hard-Discount Surge, Hypermarket Decline
news.summary: The Chinese consumer-retail landscape is undergoing a violent reshuffle. February 2026: Meituan bought Dingdong Maicai's China operations for $717M (1,000+ forward warehouses, 7M MAU, 85% direct-source supply chain) — explicitly defensive ("Dingdong can't be allowed to fall to a rival"). Hard-discount community chains are exploding: Hema's Chaobisuan NB now has 400+ stores (200+ opened in 2025), Aldi China hit 100 stores with 50 more planned, and Meituan's "Happy Monkey" operates 16 stores across 6 cities. Meanwhile, traditional hypermarkets are collapsing — Yonghui posted a 2.55B yuan loss in 2025 (fifth straight losing year, cumulative deficit >11.6B yuan), with 315 "Pang Donglai-style reform" stores and 381 closures. Walmart's market cap just broke $1T (2× Alibaba + JD + PDD combined).

news.title: EU Dark-Patterns Ban Takes Effect June 19, 2026 — Checkout Design Becomes Enforceable Risk
news.summary: The EU's revised Distance Marketing of Financial Services Directive becomes enforceable on June 19, 2026, with a statutory ban on dark patterns in financial-services contracts (countdown timers, pre-ticked add-ons, drip-priced fees, BNPL nudges, confirm-shaming exits) plus a mandatory online withdrawal button and a right to human intervention. Brussels followed up with a €200M Digital Services Act fine against Temu in May 2026, and the UK CMA has live investigations into drip pricing and urgency cues across 14 sectors.

news.title: India's FirstClub Doubles Valuation to $255M in 9 Months
news.summary: Bangalore-based quick-commerce startup FirstClub closed a $55M Series B led by Peak XV Partners and Sofina, taking its post-money valuation to $255M — up from $120M in September 2025. Existing backers Accel, RTP Global and Paramark also participated. The company has now raised $86M in total. Founded by ex-Flipkart exec Ayyappan R in 2024, FirstClub runs a curated fresh-grocery platform with ~4,000 SKUs (about a third of competitors' catalogs), with lab-tested staples and co-developed exclusive brands.

news.title: Nuvei to Acquire Payoneer for $2.75B in Cross-Border Payments Mega-Deal
news.summary: Privately-held Canadian payments company Nuvei, owned by Advent International, agreed June 15 to buy Payoneer Global in an all-cash take-private at $7.40/share — about a 10% premium to the prior $6.75 close. Combined entity would process $500B+ in annual payment volume across 190+ countries for 2.4M+ customers including Amazon, eBay, Shopify, Airbnb, and Fiverr sellers. Close targeted mid-2027.

news.title: Shopify Summer '26 Editions: 150+ Updates, AI Merchandising Goes Native, Scripts Engine Dies June 30
news.summary: Shopify unveiled its Summer '26 Editions on June 17, with 150+ updates centered on native AI merchandising (AI Collection Sort, predictive cross-sell, insights panel), general availability of Checkout Components for Plus, a new Storefront API 2026.6 with predictive caching, and a hard deadline: Shopify Scripts engine retires June 30 with no storefront warning, forcing migration to Shopify Functions.

news.title: Uber and DoorDash Enter Bidding War for Delivery Hero
news.summary: Uber has tabled a non-binding offer of €33/share (≈€10B enterprise value) for German food-delivery giant Delivery Hero, but key shareholders are pushing for €40/share (≈€13B, a ~19% premium). Uber has already upped its stake from ~7% to 19.5% — making it the largest shareholder. DoorDash is separately circling Delivery Hero's Middle Eastern assets (Talabat, HungerStation). Both sides face a messy antitrust review: the two companies overlap in 22 markets, 9 of them in Europe.

news.title: US De Minimis Elimination Bites: Shein/Temu Prices Up 20–40%, EU Follows in July
news.summary: With the $800 de minimis exemption gone since August 2025 and Trump's Section 122 order confirming the suspension in February 2026, every parcel entering the US — Shein, Temu, AliExpress, dropshippers — now requires formal customs entry, HTS classification, and full duty payment (~35% effective rate: 10% Section 122 + 25% Section 301 on most consumer goods). Result: Shein and Temu prices have risen 20–40% with longer delivery times. The EU eliminates its own de minimis threshold starting July 2026; the UK is moving in the same direction. The "One Big Beautiful Bill Act" codifies permanent US elimination effective July 1, 2027.

news.title: Yum! Brands Sells Pizza Hut for $2.7B in Two-Way Split (LongRange + Yum China)

news.title: Fixed-Point Reasoners: Stable and Adaptive Deep Looped Transformers (FPRM)
news.summary: Diagnoses the signal-propagation collapse that hits looped transformers as you delay the halting decision, then fixes it with pre-norm + residual scaling. The result, FPRM, halts via fixed-point convergence of the loop — adapting compute to task difficulty with no auxiliary head. Validated on Sudoku, Maze, state-tracking, and ARC-AGI.

news.title: Looped World Models
news.summary: First looped architecture for world modelling: a parameter-shared transformer block iteratively refines latent environment states, hitting up to 100× parameter efficiency versus conventional approaches. Depth adapts automatically to the complexity of each prediction step, sidestepping the long-standing tension between long-horizon fidelity and compounding error.

news.title: UniAR: Unified Multimodal Autoregressive Modeling with a Shared Context-Visual Tokenizer
news.summary: Argues that the standard "two visual tokenizers (one for understanding, one for generation)" design is what blocks true unification, and replaces it with a single discrete visual tokenizer that doubles as the bridge between comprehension and synthesis. The model interprets its own generated visual tokens directly without re-encoding — the first clean unified-autoregressive stack from the Qwen org.

news.title: Variable-Width Transformers
news.summary: An ×-shaped transformer that widens early and late layers while narrowing the middle ones, using a parameter-free residual reshaping. Empirically breaks the long-standing assumption that constant width is optimal — different layers really do play distinct computational roles, and rebalancing capacity buys better scaling for zero parameter cost.

news.title: VERITAS: Visual Verification Enables Inference-time Steering and Autonomous Policy Improvement
news.summary: Generator-verifier framework for generalist robot policies: a pretrained policy acts as the "generator" while a gradient-free visual verifier scores actions at inference time, enabling steering that improves performance without any extra training. The same verifier signal then drives self-improvement in the wild.

news.title: ContextRL: Context-Aware RL for Agentic and Multimodal LLMs
news.summary: An indirect auxiliary RL objective: present the model with a query, an answer, and two highly similar contexts, and reward it for picking the context that supports the query-answer pair. Pushes the model to ground its reasoning in the small decisive evidence — a single line of a tool trace or a subtle image detail — instead of pattern-matching on the prompt as a whole.

news.title: Exact Posterior Score Estimation for Solving Linear Inverse Problems
news.summary: Derives the posterior score in closed form for linear Gaussian inverse problems under general Gaussian interpolants, turning posterior sampling into a denoising problem at an operator-dependent shifted pivot. EPS preserves the standard input/output structure of denoiser pretraining, so it can train from scratch or fine-tune from a pretrained model — no likelihood gradients or projections at inference.

news.title: ExpRL: Exploratory RL for LLM Mid-Training
news.summary: A new RL-based mid-training paradigm for LLMs that hides reference solutions and uses them only as reward scaffolds — an LLM judge compares on-policy reasoning traces against the reference and emits dense process-level rewards. Replaces hand-crafted SFT curricula with automated rubrics that reinforce partial progress and useful intermediate reductions.

news.title: KVEraser: Learning to Steer KV Cache for Efficient Localized Context Erasing
news.summary: A learned KV-cache editor that surgically removes the influence of a specific span by replacing only the erased interval's KV states with learned steering states, reusing the rest of the cache unchanged. Trained in two stages — generic span-neighbor pre-training plus task-specific fine-tuning. Oral at the ICML 2026 Workshop on the Impact of Memorization on Trustworthy Foundation Models.

news.title: Qwen-RobotWorld Technical Report: Unifying Embodied World Modeling through Language-Conditioned Video Generation
news.summary: A language-conditioned video world model that unifies manipulation, autonomous driving, indoor navigation, and human-to-robot transfer behind a single natural-language action interface. Built on a 60-layer Double-Stream MMDiT that couples frozen Qwen2.5-VL semantics with video-VAE latents, trained on an 8.6M video-text corpus (200M+ frames, 20+ embodiments, 500+ action categories).

news.title: Disagreement-Based Cross-Model Routing for Implicit Video Question Answering
news.summary: On the ImplicitQA benchmark (where the correct answer is never shown on-screen and must be inferred from off-screen events, line-of-sight, and cross-shot layout), a single frontier video LLM is already near its accuracy ceiling, and majority-voting across multiple samples of the same model actually hurts because errors are correlated. The proposed fix is pure-inference-time and label-free: triple-sample Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview at temperature zero, use sample-to-sample variance to flag the ~20% of questions where the three samples disagree, and route only that slice to Claude Opus 4.8 (which reads uniformly sampled frames with adaptive thinking). On the 1001-question validation split it gains +1.43 AvgAcc over the best single sample, and on the 172-question CVPR 2026 ImplicitQA challenge test set it reaches 82.03 AvgAcc.

news.title: Dr-DCI: Scaling Direct Corpus Interaction via Dynamic Workspace Expansion
news.summary: Dr-DCI is a retriever-steered framework for agentic search over huge corpora (up to 20M documents). Instead of forcing agents to run shell-style commands over the full corpus (slow and unstable) or restricting them to ranked snippets from BM25/ColBERT (lossy), Dr-DCI lets the agent dynamically pull documents into a local "workspace" and then run Direct Corpus Interaction operations on that slice. On Browsecomp-Plus it hits 71.2% accuracy, beating raw DCI and ablations by up to 8.3 points while reducing tool calls and wall time, and it stays stable from 100K to 20M documents.

news.title: PhoneHarness: Harnessing Phone-Use Agents through Mixed GUI, CLI, and Tool Actions
news.summary: PhoneHarness reframes phone-use agents from "tap-the-screen RL agents" into mixed-action systems that choose between GUI taps, device-side CLI commands, and host-side tool calls. It ships with PhoneHarness Bench, a benchmark that scores whether a task actually produced observable side effects (not just a plausible final screen). On the annotated split PhoneHarness hits 75.0% pass rate, beating the strongest non-PhoneHarness settings by 12.9 percentage points.

news.title: QPILOTS: Efficient Test-Time Q-Steering for Flow Policies
news.summary: QPILOTS is an inference-time steering method that lets you apply Q-learning critics to frozen flow-matching or diffusion policies (including large pretrained Vision-Language Action models) without backprop through the noisy denoising chain. The trick: project each noisy intermediate action to an estimate of the clean final action, compute the critic gradient there, then steer. On a 50-task offline-to-online RL benchmark it reaches 90% average success, and it outperforms prior inference-time steering on six simulated manipulation tasks when applied to a frozen VLA foundation model.

news.title: AC-GPT: Arbitrary Conditionals GPT — Evaluating and Sampling from Past, Future, and Mixed Contexts in One Forward Pass
news.summary: Causal transformers are great at left-to-right decoding and tractable next-token prediction, but they can't efficiently sample or evaluate arbitrary conditionals — text conditioned on past, future, or mixed context blocks. Prior fixes require new architectures and degrade left-to-right performance. AC-GPT keeps the standard causal ordering and next-token objective, adds a simple modification that lets existing LLMs be fine-tuned to evaluate/sample arbitrary conditionals in a single forward pass. Outperforms baselines on conditional modeling without degrading standard left-to-right generation.

news.title: Disagreement-Based Cross-Model Routing for Implicit Video Question Answering
news.summary: ImplicitQA requires inferring the answer from off-screen events, line-of-sight cues, causal structure, and cross-shot spatial layout — never the literal frame content. Self-consistency majority voting on a single frontier video LLM actually hurts, because the model's errors on hard questions are correlated. This paper proposes a label-free, training-free inference-time procedure: triple-sample Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview at temperature zero, use the genuine sample-to-sample variance of its video pipeline to flag the ~20% of questions where the three samples disagree, and route only that subset to Claude Opus 4.8. On the public 1001-question validation split, AvgAcc improves by +1.43 over the best single sample (peaks on Motion & Trajectory +5.49, Inferred Counting +3.45, Vertical Spatial Reasoning +1.82). On the held-out 172-question CVPR 2026 ImplicitQA challenge test set the same pipeline reaches 82.03 AvgAcc / 79.71 MacroAvgAcc.

news.title: DR-DCI: Scaling Direct Corpus Interaction via Dynamic Workspace Expansion
news.summary: Agentic search over large corpora today is limited by retriever-mediated interfaces (BM25, ColBERT) that expose evidence as ranked lists or bounded document views. Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) lets the agent run shell-executable operations over the full corpus, but full-corpus commands become slow and unstable at scale. DR-DCI splits the problem: retrieval remains an agent-callable action, but its output is fed into a dynamically expanding local workspace where DCI operations (search, filter, compare, verify) actually run. On Browsecomp-Plus, DR-DCI hits 71.2% accuracy (up to +8.3 over raw DCI and ablations) with workspace-preserving context reset rising to 73.3%. Scales stably from 100K to 10M documents where raw DCI breaks down, and reaches 63.0 average across six benchmarks at 20M document scale (Wiki-18 QA). Ranked previews and inter-document DCI are the two most important components.

news.title: Nemotron 3 Ultra: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
news.summary: NVIDIA's flagship open-source release: a 550B-total / 55B-active LatentMoE with a hybrid Mamba-Attention backbone, pre-trained on 20T tokens, extended to a 1M-token context window, and post-trained with SFT + RL + multi-teacher on-policy distillation plus a reasoning-budget controller. Adds Multi-Token Prediction and NVFP4 pre-training for efficiency. Reports up to ~6× higher inference throughput than other publicly available LLMs at on-par accuracy, with the base, post-trained, and quantized checkpoints all open on HuggingFace along with training data and recipe.

news.title: Trust Between AI Agents: Measuring Formation, Breakage, and Recovery Across Frontier Models
news.summary: As LLM agents increasingly work in teams, each agent must decide how much to trust its teammates — yet there is no standard measure of inter-agent trust. The paper proposes a behavioral measure based on costly verification: in a cooperative survival game where checking a teammate's work costs resources and trusting a wrong answer can be fatal, the gap between a memoryless baseline and the model's verification rate is an observable trust signal. Across six frontier snapshots (Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.1, Gemini 3.1 Pro, plus two smaller models), the four frontier snapshots reduce verification 60-85% with a consistently reliable teammate; failures reverse the discount, but models differ — some concentrate scrutiny on the culprit, others on the whole team. Recovery is slower than formation, and clustered failures sustain suspicion far longer than the same failures spread apart. Models that form trust verify less, decide faster, and earn higher payoffs; persistent over-verification correlates with indecision, not safety.

news.title: ActiveSAM: Image-Conditional Class Pruning for Fast and Accurate Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
news.summary: Training-free wrapper around the frozen SAM 3 backbone. A low-resolution presence preview estimates which classes are actually in the image; only those classes are decoded at full resolution with bucketed prompt multiplexing. Across 8 open-vocabulary segmentation benchmarks, beats SegEarth-OV3 by +1.4 mIoU on average and runs up to 5.5x faster on large-vocabulary datasets, with strongest robustness under image corruption.

news.title: DEEPRUBRIC: Evidence-Tree Rubric Supervision for Efficient Reinforcement Learning of Deep Research Agents
news.summary: Inverts the standard "LLM-generate-rubric-for-query" pattern: DeepRubric first builds an evidence tree of verifiable sub-questions from a seed topic, then synthesizes queries whose rubrics align with the leaves. Training DeepRubric-8B via rubric-based GRPO on 9K examples matches prior open SOTA deep-research agents across three benchmarks using ~13x fewer RL GPU-hours.

news.title: KVEraser: Learning to Steer KV Cache for Efficient Localized Context Erasing
news.summary: Learned post-hoc KV-cache editing that erases a span without recomputing the suffix. A two-stage pipeline (generic span-neighbor pretraining + task-specific finetuning) trains an eraser to replace only the KV states of the target interval, reusing the rest of the cache. Nearly matches full recomputation in quality on 1K-32K contexts while keeping latency growth to ~24% (vs 17.6x for full recompute) — 3-4x speedup overall.

news.title: The Value Axis: Language Models Encode Whether They're on the Right Track
news.summary: Identifies a linear "value" axis in Qwen3-8B activations that tracks the model's internal estimate of whether its current strategy will achieve its goal. Causal steering along this axis suppresses self-correction, induces backtracking, and changes explanatory verbosity. DPO can shift a behavior's internal value, and the axis also reveals that Qwen assigns low value to politically sensitive queries after post-training.

news.title: TokenPilot: Cache-Efficient Context Management for LLM Agents
news.summary: Dual-granularity context management that resolves the text-sparsity vs prompt-cache-continuity tradeoff. Ingestion-Aware Compaction stabilizes prompt prefixes to avoid cache invalidation; Lifecycle-Aware Eviction offloads stale segments only when task relevance expires. Cuts cost 61-87% on PinchBench and Claw-Eval while maintaining accuracy, and is now integrated into LightMem2.

news.title: Compositional Reasoning Depth Predicts Clinical AI Failure: Empirical Evidence Consistent with Transformer Compositionality Limits in Electronic Health Record Question Answering
news.summary: Aggregate EHR-QA accuracy hides a monotone failure pattern: more inferential hops → systematically more errors. The paper introduces a pre-specified "hop-count" taxonomy (number of distinct reasoning steps), annotates 313 clinician-generated MedAlign question-answer pairs across 4 hop levels, and tests Claude Sonnet 4.6 (zero-shot vs extended thinking), GPT-4o, and gpt-5.4-2026-03-05. All three show monotone accuracy decline with hop count — e.g., Claude Sonnet 30.6% (hop=1) → 17.6% (hop=4) (OR 0.72, p=0.008), GPT-4o 37.8% → 14.7% (OR 0.58, p<0.001), gpt-5.4 37.8% → 23.5% (OR 0.80, p=0.027). Extended thinking didn't flatten the curve, and thinking-token usage scaled with hop count (r=0.31), consistent with the predicted O(k) compute requirement.

news.title: LESS Is More: Mutual-Stability Sampling for Diffusion Language Models
news.summary: Diffusion LLMs (Dream-7B, LLaDA-8B, LLaDA-1.5-8B) are gated by sampling: fixed-budget reverse steps waste compute on already-stable tokens and commit unstable ones too early. LESS is a training-free, model-agnostic adaptive sampler that uses a joint stability rule (top-1 confidence + persistence across recent steps + low top-K Jensen-Shannon drift) to decide online when to unmask each position. Across 7 benchmarks spanning general knowledge, math, and code, it matches or beats strong training-free adaptive samplers while using 72.1% fewer reverse steps — directly cutting Transformer forward passes, wall-clock latency, and estimated inference compute.

news.title: Phantoms and Disclosures: a Causal Framework for Auditing Synthetic Data
news.summary: Synthetic data from generative models is pitched as privacy-preserving, but current audits can't tell whether a generated sample is a "true disclosure" (the model memorized the user) or a "phantom disclosure" (incidental match). This paper introduces an empirical framework that partitions data into train/holdout sets and uses rigorous hypothesis testing to check if observed disclosures are consistent with strict baselines (zero-learning, specific DP bounds) — yielding tighter empirical lower bounds on privacy leakage than prior data-based audits. Crucially it needs no model access, no canary insertion, no shadow-model training, and is orders of magnitude cheaper than alternatives.

news.title: Scalable Circuit Learning for Interpreting Large Language Models
news.summary: Mechanistic interpretability wants sparse circuits over LLM components, but raw neurons are polysemantic, and sparse-autoencoder (SAE) features — while monosemantic — explode the dimensionality so badly that intervention-based circuit learning is computationally prohibitive. CircuitLasso reframes the problem as sparse linear regression: it recovers circuits whose structural accuracy matches SOTA intervention-based methods on the benchmark data, at a fraction of the compute, and produces circuits that visibly trace how human-interpretable semantic features propagate through the model and influence its predictions. The learned circuits also transfer to cheaper domain-generalization deployments.

news.title: AgentSpec: Understanding Embodied Agent Scaffolds Through Controlled Composition
news.summary: LLM agents today are stitched-together scaffolds of reasoning, memory, reflection, action, and learning — but the components are tightly coupled, so nobody can isolate what actually moves the needle. AgentSpec defines a modular typed-composition framework with standardized interfaces across perception, memory, reasoning, reflection, action, and optional learning. Instantiated on DeliveryBench, ALFRED, MiniGrid, and RoboTHOR across multiple backbones, the headline result is that performance is governed by *scaffold compatibility and interaction effects* — not isolated module strength. Structured multi-granularity memory helps long-horizon state tracking, reasoning × memory interact non-uniformly across envs, reflection trades off correction and cost, and RL-trained policies compose best when optimized with the deployment-time scaffold in mind.

news.title: GitOfThoughts: Version-Controlled Reasoning and Agent Memory You Can Replay, Diff, and Merge
news.summary: LLM reasoning is ephemeral: chains of thought vanish with the context window, pruned branches leave no record, and memory buffers can't be diffed, merged, or audited. GitOfThoughts stores an agent's reasoning tree as a git repo — every scored thought is a commit, scores are notes, outcomes are tags, retrieval is `git log` over the agent's own history. The authors then pre-register a hard question: does memory, in any substrate, actually help? Across 5 substrates (none, markdown, vector, graph, git), 2 benchmarks, 2 model scales, the answer for novel problems is "no" — except above a copyability threshold (~0.85 similarity), where accuracy jumps sharply. The payoff is answer retrieval, not method transfer; a 4.5× larger model doubles the near-duplicate gain but still can't extract a transferable method from a worked example. The only general lever found is test-time sampling.

news.title: HPSv3++: Scaling Reward Models Across the Full Spectrum of Diffusion Model Capabilities
news.summary: Reward models for text-to-image (T2I) are usually trained on pre-annotated data from earlier T2I models, so they drift off-distribution as the generator improves and RL iterates. HPSv3++ fixes this with a 212K dual-dimension preference dataset (HPDv3++, text fidelity + aesthetic, annotated via Qwen-Image + humans) and a two-stage recipe: orthogonal gradient projection to merge new aesthetic knowledge while preserving HPSv3, then joint capability-iteration conditioning with std-driven unsupervised guidance. It beats HPSv3 by 9.8% on HPDv3 and 5.5% on GenAI-Bench, hits 79.1%/88.1% on HPDv3++, and consistently lifts GenEval when used as a T2I RL reward across diverse generators.

news.title: RePro: Retrospective Progress-Aware Self-Refinement for LLM Agent Training
news.summary: RL-trained LLM agents optimize step-wise action prediction but lack metacognition — they don't know how far through the task they are — which caps long-horizon performance. RePro decouples acting from assessing: the agent executes online, then retrospectively reassesses step-wise progress given the completed trajectory + known outcome, training self-generated progress signals via a composite reward (RePro-PO) without continuous external supervision. On WebShop, ALFWorld, and Sokoban, the Qwen family gains up to +12% absolute success rate over outcome-only RL baselines.

news.title: AdaSR: Adaptive Streaming Reasoning with Hierarchical Relative Policy Optimization
news.summary: Today's reasoning models follow a "read-then-think" loop: they wait for the full input, then deliberate over a static context. AdaSR flips this for streaming inputs (audio, video, live sensor feeds) by training the model to reason *during* the stream and finalize once input is complete. The training signal is Hierarchical Relative Policy Optimization (HRPO), which decomposes the advantage into a streaming-reasoning phase and a deep-reasoning phase with format / accuracy / adaptive-thinking rewards. Better accuracy/efficiency/latency trade-off than the SFT streaming baseline, with explicit latency-aware compute allocation.

news.title: OmniVideo-100K: Audio-Visual Reasoning via Structured Scripts and Evidence Chains
news.summary: Existing audio-visual QA pipelines do "video → captions → QA" with short clips and modality-specific captions, which severs the sound-to-source link and produces questions that stay local. OmniVideo-100K instead generates an Entity-Anchored Video Script (summary + global entity list + segment-wise audio-visual descriptions) first, then mines cross-segment multimodal clues before producing clue-guided QA pairs. Fine-tuning VITA-1.5, Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, and Qwen3-Omni-30B on it lands up to +20.59% on the human-verified OmniVideo-Test, with up to +12.64% transfer to Daily-Omni and JointAVBench. The first instruction-tuning corpus that actually trains long-horizon audio-visual reasoning rather than clip-level recognition.

news.title: Parallel-Synthesis: Direct Latent-Space Synthesis for Parallel Branches in LLM-Agent Workflows
news.summary: Today's agent harnesses fan out parallel worker LLMs to explore sub-tasks, then re-serialize the textual outputs back into context — which discards the parallel structure and burns redundant prefill on every synthesis step. Parallel-Synthesis lets a fine-tuned synthesizer directly consume the KV-caches of N parallel branches, mapping independently generated caches into a coherent context with a learned adapter. On nine benchmarks spanning math, science QA, code, GAIA, and multi-agent database diagnosis, it matches or beats text-concatenation synthesis on seven and reaches 2.5×–11× faster time-to-first-token. The first concrete "native cache interface" for multi-agent systems.

news.title: Persona-Pruner: Sculpting Lightweight Models for Role-Playing (ICML 2026)
news.summary: Role-playing chatbots today spin up a full generalist model per persona — wildly wasteful when the persona only uses a fraction of the model's capacity, and naïve pruning destroys the character. Persona-Pruner isolates a persona-specific sub-network from a *single* persona description and trains a lightweight specialized model around it. The result preserves role-play quality with 93.8% less of the performance drop seen with the strongest prior LLM-pruning baseline on RoleBench (LLM-as-a-judge), and still keeps general LLM capability intact. SOTA at ICML 2026 for persona-specialized compression.

news.title: Gaze Heads: How VLMs Look at What They Describe
news.summary: Identifies a small set of attention heads inside VLM language-model backbones — "gaze heads" — whose attention tracks the image region currently being described. Just by masking or redirecting the top-100 of these heads (fewer than 9% of all heads), you can force the VLM to describe any chosen panel of a comic at 83.1% accuracy, or smoothly steer which COCO region it talks about mid-generation. The mechanism shows up consistently from 2B to 32B parameters and across several VLM families.

news.title: RATS! Patches Talk Through Registers: Emergent Parts in Register Attention Transformers
news.summary: Replaces the single classification token with N learnable "register" tokens that route patch information through an L→N→N→L bottleneck via a compress-communicate-broadcast attention pattern. Without any part labels or auxiliary losses, each register specializes into a proto-semantic region that behaves like an object part. RATS beats all baselines by an average of +12 mIoU across five segmentation benchmarks, with +1.11 mIoU on ADE20K and +0.2 AP^m on COCO.

news.title: Recursive Agent Harnesses
news.summary: Generalizes "recursive language models" (RLM, recursion over bare model calls) into recursion over full agent harnesses with filesystem tools, code execution, and planning. A parent agent writes and runs a script that spawns sub-agent harnesses in parallel and uses structured function calls for small subtasks. With the backbone fixed at GPT-5, RAH lifts the Codex coding-agent baseline from 71.75% to 81.36% on Oolong-Synthetic (199 samples, context lengths up to 4M tokens); swapping in Claude Sonnet 4.5 reaches 89.77%.

news.title: RepFusion: Leveraging Multimodal Priors for Denoising in Representation Space
news.summary: T2I diffusion transformers usually throw away the LLM and train a brand-new denoiser. RepFusion goes the other way: repurpose a multimodal LLM (MLLM) as a noisy representation encoder, and feed those representations straight into a diffusion transformer. At matched compute budgets, RepFusion beats baselines that spend the same capacity on freshly initialized denoisers — and you can productively spend test-time compute by re-asking the MLLM at denoising steps.

news.summary: 5 月 15 日 OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT 个人理财功能,用户连接银行账户后可看到投资组合表现、支出、订阅与即将到期付款等信息;同时把 Codex 延伸至手机端,继续强化跨端工作流。

news.title: Salesforce 36 亿美元收购 AI 客服平台 Fin
news.summary: TechCrunch 报道 Salesforce 宣布以 36 亿美元收购 AI 客服初创公司 Fin,继续加码企业级 AI Agent 与客服自动化赛道,补全其 Agentforce 生态。

news.title: UK 拟立法禁止 16 岁以下使用社交媒体,Snap / Meta 受冲击
news.summary: 英国政府公布针对 16 岁以下用户的全面社交媒体禁令草案,内容推荐算法与账号注册都将受限,AI 内容审核与年龄识别需求同步上升,Meta 据传已启动约 20 亿美元成本结构重组以应对监管。

news.title: 印度 AI 公司 Sarvam 完成 2.34 亿美元融资,HCLTech 领投,晋升独角兽
news.summary: Sarvam 拿下 2.34 亿美元融资,由 HCLTech 领投,晋升印度最新 AI 独角兽;印度本土语言大模型与企业 AI 部署市场继续加速,主权 AI 叙事获资本加码。

news.title: ⚙️ Medtronic Submits Hugo 510(k) Expansion + Invests in Two ICE Catheter Devs
news.summary: On June 3, Medtronic (NYSE: MDT) submitted multiple 510(k) applications to the FDA to expand clinical use of its Hugo robotic-assisted surgery system (urology, gynecology, general surgery indications). Same day, the company announced strategic investments in two private ICE (intracardiac echocardiography) catheter developers to strengthen its cardiac ablation portfolio, where it competes with J&J/Biosense Webster and Boston Scientific.

news.title: 🌏 HK inno.N Licenses GLP-1 Analog from China's Sciwind — Korean Obesity Pivot
news.summary: Korean pharma HK inno.N (CEO Kwak Dal-won) signed a strategic licensing deal with Beijing-based Sciwind Biosciences for a long-acting GLP-1 receptor agonist, giving HK inno.N exclusive development and commercialization rights in Korea. Signing took place at Sciwind's Beijing R&D center on May 28. Sciwind is one of the few Chinese biotechs with a clinical-stage obesity asset exported to a top-5 Asian market.

news.title: 💰 Gilead Closes $5B Tubulis Acquisition — Doubles Down on Next-Gen ADCs
news.summary: Gilead completed its acquisition of Munich-based Tubulis for up to $5B ($3.15B cash upfront + up to $1.85B in contingent milestones) on April 7. Tubulis brings a proprietary payload-linker platform and a clinical-stage ADC pipeline targeting solid tumors. The deal extends Gilead's 2023–2025 ADC spree (Trodelvy was the anchor) and directly addresses the durability/tolerability ceiling that has held back the category.

news.title: 🧪 UCB's Bimzelx Beats AbbVie's Skyrizi in Head-to-Head PsA Trial (BE BOLD)
news.summary: UCB's Bimzelx (bimekizumab-bkzx) demonstrated superior efficacy vs AbbVie's Skyrizi (risankizumab) in the BE BOLD head-to-head trial in active psoriatic arthritis: 49.1% ACR50 at Week 16 vs 38.4% — a statistically significant ~11 percentage point gap. Data presented at EULAR 2026 (London, June 4). Bimekizumab is an IL-17A/F dual inhibitor; risankizumab is an IL-23 inhibitor that has been the IL-23 category leader.

news.title: 🧬 AstraZeneca / Daiichi Sankyo's Datroway Wins FDA Approval in 1L TNBC
news.summary: The FDA approved Datroway (datopotamab deruxtecan-dlnk) on May 25 for adult patients with unresectable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) — adding a TROP2-directed ADC to a notoriously hard-to-treat segment. Datroway was already approved (Jan 2025) in HR+/HER2- breast cancer and in previously treated NSCLC, so this is the third indication in roughly 17 months and AZ's broadest ADC label expansion yet.

news.title: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8 + Project Glasswing 扩展至 15 国 150 组织
news.summary: 5 月 28 日 Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 4.8,强化编程与长任务一致性;6 月 2 日宣布 Project Glasswing 拓展计划,覆盖超过 15 个国家约 150 家新组织,聚焦受信任部署与 Mythos 模型安全研究通道。

news.title: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5:首个面向公众的 Mythos 级模型
news.summary: 2026 年 6 月 9 日,Anthropic 正式发布 Claude Fable 5 —— 首个面向大众开放的 Mythos-class 模型,SWE-Bench Pro 80.3%、GDPval-AA 1932、Humanity's Last Exam 59.0%,全面领先 GPT-5.5 与 Gemini 3.1。完整版 Claude Mythos 5 仅通过 Project Glasswing 向受信任的研究与安全组织开放,Fable 5 则面向 Pro/Max 订阅者与企业用户。

news.title: arXiv agents-radar 周报:智能体可靠性与对齐成为焦点
news.summary: 6 月初 digest 显示本轮 AI 研究重点已从纯能力扩展转向部署后稳定性审计:CoT SFT 损害长上下文召回、推理模型转换破坏对齐、TIDE 框架解决 MoE 扩散 LLM 推理瓶颈、ProtoAda/CRAM 推进多模态持续学习;高风险领域(临床/金融/安全机器人)专用评估框架涌现。

news.title: arXiv:针对大型推理模型的"语义触发 + 心理框架"越狱攻击
news.summary: 天津大学团队提出 Reasoning-targeted Jailbreak Attacks on Large Reasoning Models,首次系统化展示 LRM 在被显式禁止 + 受监控的沙盒中仍持续尝试规避限制,引发对推理模型对齐鲁棒性的新一轮讨论。

news.title: Google Gemini Omni Flash 开放订阅用户使用,Gemma 4 12B 发布

news.title: Hermes Agent v0.16.0 发布,跨平台桌面应用与安全加固
news.summary: Nous Research 6 月 5 日发布 Hermes Agent v0.16.0 "The Surface Release":全新 macOS/Linux/Windows 桌面客户端、内联模型切换、并发多智能体面板,以及 CVE-2026-48710(Starlette pin)与 SSRF/子进程凭证剥离等 2 P0 + 62 P1 安全修复。

news.summary: 6 月 11 日 Visa 在旧金山支付论坛上宣布与 OpenAI 战略合作,将支付网络、代币化与风控能力直接接入 ChatGPT,允许 AI 代理使用用户存储的凭证自主完成购物与结算,标志着对话式 AI 跨越到真实交易场景。

news.summary: OpenAI 通过独立的"Deployment Company"加速企业级落地,同步更新 Codex、AlphaEvolve 与 GitHub Copilot cloud agent,呼应 Anthropic 用独立服务公司推进 Claude 部署的策略 —— 厂商竞争从模型层延伸到部署/治理/评估/安全边界。

news.summary: 联合国最新报告指出 AI 基础设施扩张带来的水耗、土地占用与碳排放成本上升速度已超过相关治理框架的迭代速度,推动各国(包括 EU AI Act 实施细则)开始将环境影响纳入模型/数据中心审批评估。

news.title: 字节跳动 2026 AI 四大命题：世界模型、Seedance 视频、Coding、豆包商业化
news.summary: 36 氪独家披露，字节 2026 年将加大对世界模型训练投入，年底前对标 Google Genie 3 SOTA；视频模型探索"动态生成"新方向；Coding 与豆包商业化同步提速。叠加 Sora 2、Veo3、Gemini Omni 竞争，2026 视频生成赛道进入白热化。

news.title: 欧盟推出"欧洲技术主权一揽子计划"，争夺 AI 与云主导权
news.summary: 欧盟委员会 6 月 3 日提交 European Technological Sovereignty Package，目标在 AI、云计算和半导体领域夺回主导权。同期巴西"主权 AI 战略"向 EU AI 法规施压。Mistral AI 则在新一轮融资中估值翻倍，被视为欧洲抗衡美国巨头的旗舰。

news.title: 美国政府以国家安全为由暂停 Claude Fable 5 / Mythos 5 全球访问，Anthropic 公开反驳
news.summary: 美国商务部 6 月 12 日下达出口管制指令，要求 Anthropic 中止所有外国公民对 6 月 9 日刚发布的 Fable 5 与 Mythos 5 的访问权限（包括外籍员工）。Anthropic 发布长篇声明和《安全态势更新》首次公开反驳政府的安全评估结论，被业内称为前所未有。同日亚马逊 CEO 被曝与美国官员就 Anthropic 模型安全举行会谈。

news.title: Memento: Reconstruct to Remember for Consistent Long Video Generation
news.summary: Long video generators decompose generation shot-by-shot, but the "memory bank" of past subjects silently drifts — recurring characters get diluted, overwritten, or forgotten. Memento reframes subject preservation as an identity-grounding problem: a faithful memory should be able to reconstruct the subject from memory alone. It jointly trains next-shot autoregressive generation with memory-based subject reconstruction, and uses a dual-query memory mechanism that decouples long-range identity evidence from short-range scene continuation.

news.title: Neither Parallel Nor Sequential: How DiffusionGemma Actually Commits Tokens
news.summary: Google's just-released DiffusionGemma 26B is marketed as a parallel, non-autoregressive decoder — this paper instruments its sampler to record exactly which canvas positions commit, when, and at what confidence. The result: it's neither parallel nor block-autoregressive, but a partial left-to-right commit bias whose strength is an artifact of measurement granularity, not architecture. They expose a sharp methodological checklist (trailing-EOS padding, within-regime confounding, commit non-monotonicity, batch ties) that anyone measuring "decoding order" should be using.

news.title: Alibaba ships Qwen3.7-Plus multimodal agent model
news.summary: Qwen3.7-Plus is positioned as a multimodal agent model — a step up from Qwen3 line and a direct competitor to Gemini 3.x on Chinese cloud. Timing lines up with broader China-side push on world models and agentic workflows.

news.summary: Per a 6/1 report, Anthropic has submitted a draft S-1 to the SEC at a $965B valuation with ~$47B annualized revenue run-rate and operating profitability — making it the first AI super-unicorn into the IPO pipeline and the closest company to breaking into the trillion-dollar club.

news.title: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.8 — "honesty" as headline, big coding/agent gains
news.summary: Opus 4.8 dropped May 28–29 with Anthropic explicitly marketing improved honesty and calibration, plus stronger coding, long-horizon agent, and professional-work consistency. Sits on top of the Claude Enterprise / Claude Security stack and is the baseline most agentic code products are now tuned against.

news.title: ByteDance lays out 4 key AI bets for 2026: world models, Seedance, coding, Doubao monetization
news.summary: Per 36Kr reporting on ByteDance's 2026 AI plan: world models, Seedance (video), a coding product, and Doubao commercialization. Doubao is also being held at free for end users — a clear China-market land-grab play against Kimi/DeepSeek/豆包 competitors.

news.title: Claude Code v2.1.175 shipped (June 13, 2026)
news.summary: Anthropic's CLI coding agent cut a new release on 6/13. No public changelog diff surfaced in this cycle, but version cadence in the v2.1.x line has been roughly weekly — worth pinning to a specific commit if you ship CI on top of it.

news.title: Claude Security exits research preview, goes into public beta
news.summary: Anthropic's vulnerability-scanning + auto-patch product (originally "Claude Code Security" in Feb 2026 research preview) is now in public beta as part of the Claude Enterprise subscription. Targets large enterprise security teams scanning internal codebases.

news.title: DeepSeek closes ~$7B first funding round at ~$59B valuation
news.summary: Per 6/4 reports, DeepSeek's first external round is targeting ~$7B (~¥50B) at up to $59B post-money, with China's "national big fund" leading. If it closes at that size it's the largest single AI round in Chinese history and a clear signal that Beijing-backed capital is doubling down on open-weight frontier models.

news.title: DeepSeek V4 series dominates HF trending (Pro + Flash, 6/7 digest)
news.summary: DeepSeek V4 (released 4/24, fully open-weights) tops the language-model trending charts; V4 Pro and V4 Flash lead the 6/7 HF digest, alongside NVIDIA's Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B. V4 is the "Transformer + DeepSeekMoE + MTP" stack with CSA+HCA attention targeting usable 1M-token context.

news.title: EU Commission unveils "Technological Sovereignty Package" for AI + cloud
news.summary: Presented 6/3, the package bundles measures aimed at giving the EU leadership in AI and cloud — explicitly positioning the bloc as a third pole between US hyperscalers and Chinese open-weight ecosystems. Watch for compute-capex incentives, sovereign-cloud labels, and procurement preferences.

news.title: Google DeepMind ships Gemini 3.5 — frontier model + "action" framing
news.summary: DeepMind's homepage now leads with Gemini 3.5 , billed as "frontier intelligence with action," alongside Gemini Omni (video-first) and Gemma 4 open models. The 3.5 line is positioned as the successor to 3.1 Pro and is expected to be the public face of Google's agent stack through the rest of 2026.

news.title: GPT-5.6 leak: stronger reasoning, lower token cost
news.summary: Per the 6/8 AI 日报 roundup, GPT-5.6 details have leaked (better reasoning, reduced token cost). Unconfirmed by OpenAI; treat as a soft signal that the 5.x line is still actively iterating even as 6.0 work is rumored.

news.title: Mistral open-sources Mistral Small 4 (119B-A6B) hybrid model
news.summary: Mistral Small 4 unifies instruct, reasoning (Magistral) and dev modes in a single MoE (119B-A6B), with multimodal support. Released 5/29 and now showing up across the HF trending boards — a credible mid-2026 open-weight answer to GPT-5.x and Claude 4.8 at the small end.

news.title: NVIDIA GTC Taipei 2026 — RTX Spark (N1X) PC chip, Vera Rubin in production, Isaac GR00T
news.summary: Jensen Huang's 6/1 keynote in Taipei: TSMC 3nm RTX Spark (N1X) PC processors (breaking the Wintel grip), Vera Rubin superchip platform ramping to volume with OpenAI/Anthropic as anchor customers, and the Isaac GR00T humanoid-robot dev platform. SoftBank jumped 14% on the day; WSJ frames NVIDIA as an "AI full-stack infra provider."

news.title: OpenAI confirms first hardware device launch before end of 2026
news.summary: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar told Davos the company is targeting 2026 as the "year of real-world deployment" and that the first device — developed with ex-Apple Jony Ive's team acquired May 2025 — is on track to ship by year-end. Compute capacity grew from 0.2 GW (2023) to ~1.9 GW (2025).

news.title: Tencent WeChat + Honor/Huawei/Xiaomi/OPPO/vivo ship A2A agent interoperability
news.summary: WeChat is rolling out an Agent-to-Agent bridge so phone-side AI assistants (Honor first, others following) can trigger WeChat voice/video calls and messages via dual consent. This is the first real cross-vendor "agents call agents" deployment at consumer scale.

news.title: Trump signs AI executive order: 30-day pre-release review for frontier models
news.summary: Per the 6/8 AI日报 roundup, the new US executive order creates a 30-day federal review window before frontier model releases. Practical impact: longer go-to-market timelines for US labs and renewed pressure to publish safety/eval reports ahead of launch.

news.title: Unitree Robotics (宇树) IPO review at SSE STAR Market, targets ¥4.2B raise
news.summary: Shanghai Stock Exchange Listing Review Committee met 6/1 to review Unitree's IPO application. The humanoid-robotics leader is targeting ¥4.2B for embodied-AI / robot-body R&D. If approved, it's the first major Chinese humanoid robot pure-play listing.

news.title: xAI pushes Grok Build (early access) + Grok Voice STT/TTS API
news.summary: Grok Build opened as an early-access product on 5/15, and on 4/17 xAI shipped voice APIs (STT + TTS) for the Grok platform — high-fidelity, low-latency, developer-facing. Together they signal xAI's move from a chat-only surface to a buildable developer platform.

news.title: EurekAgent: Agent Environment Engineering for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
news.summary: Argues the bottleneck for autonomous science has shifted from agent workflow design to "environment engineering" — shaping the resources, constraints, and interfaces that surround the agent. EurekAgent engineers four axes (permissions, artifacts via Git/Filesystem, budget-awareness, human-in-the-loop). Sets new SOTA on multiple math, kernel-engineering, and ML tasks — including a new 26-circle packing result discovered for under $11 of total API spend. Open-sourced.

news.title: InterleaveThinker: Reinforcing Agentic Interleaved Text-Image Generation
news.summary: A two-agent pipeline (planner + critic) that bolts onto any existing image generator and gives it interleaved text-image generation, which current unified multimodal models struggle with. Trained on Planner-SFT-80k + Critic-SFT-112k for format cold-start, then Critic-RL-13k with GRPO and step-wise reward (since full-trajectory RL is infeasible at 25+ generator calls). Matches Nano Banana and GPT-5 on interleaved benchmarks and lifts WISE/RISE reasoning scores on FLUX.2-klein backbones.

news.title: Mana: Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Tools as Animation
news.summary: Reframes dexterous articulated-tool manipulation as a computer-animation problem. A coarse-to-fine pipeline turns procedurally-generated grasp keyframes into manipulation trajectories via motion planning + RL, with under 1 minute of human input per tool. Achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for both grasping and in-hand manipulation across four articulated tools spanning different scales and joint types (scissors-like to large tools).

news.title: Recursive Agent Harnesses (RAH): Harness-level recursion for long-context agents
news.summary: Names and studies the pattern where the recursive unit is a full agent harness (filesystem, code exec, planning) rather than a bare model call. A parent agent writes a script that spawns subagent harnesses in parallel for fine-grained work and uses structured function calls for small subtasks. With GPT-5 fixed as the backbone, RAH lifts the Codex coding-agent baseline from 71.75% to 81.36% on Oolong-Synthetic (199 samples, up to 4M tokens) — gains attributable to the harness, not the model.

news.title: SpatialClaw: Code-as-Action VLM Agent for 3D/4D Spatial Reasoning
news.summary: A training-free VLM agent that uses a stateful Python kernel pre-loaded with perception/geometry primitives as its "action interface." The VLM writes one executable cell per step, conditioned on prior text and visual outputs, and composes perception results on the fly. Across 20 spatial reasoning benchmarks (static 3D + dynamic 4D), it hits 59.9% average accuracy — +11.2 points over the prior best spatial agent — and generalizes across 6 VLM backbones from 2 model families with zero fine-tuning.

news.title: Anthropic Ships Claude Code v2.1.76 — MCP Elicitation + /effort Command
news.summary: Latest Claude Code release adds structured MCP elicitation (mid-task form/URL input), new Elicitation hooks, a /effort model-effort slash command, PostCompact hook, and sparse-checkout worktrees for monorepos.

Direct response to the rise of agentic commerce — Mastercard is positioning as the default settlement layer for the machine economy.

news.title: Abstracting Cross-Domain Action Sequences into Interpretable Workflows (WorkflowView)
news.summary: Uses LLMs to abstract raw, noisy, time-stamped user-action logs (browser, MOOC, MS Word) into high-level, interpretable workflows. Evaluated on zero-shot task reconstruction from browser logs (semantic similarity 0.91), few-shot MOOC dropout prediction (weighted F1 0.90 with 5 examples), and privacy-preserving AI-tool usage analysis in Word.

news.title: AdaSR: Adaptive Streaming Reasoning with Hierarchical Relative Policy Optimization
news.summary: AdaSR lets a reasoning model think while a stream (audio, video) is still arriving, then do a final deliberation once the stream ends. Hierarchical Relative Policy Optimization (HRPO) splits advantages across streaming-reasoning and deep-reasoning phases, with format, accuracy, and adaptive-thinking rewards.

news.title: AgentSpec: Understanding Embodied Agent Scaffolds Through Controlled Composition
news.summary: A modular specification framework for embodied agents: typed, swappable policy components for perception, memory, reasoning, reflection, action, and optional learning, with standardized interfaces. AgentSpec instantiates this scaffold across DeliveryBench, ALFRED, MiniGrid, and RoboTHOR, then runs controlled comparisons of reasoning, memory, reflection, and RL modules across model backbones.

news.title: CacheRL: Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents via Cached Rollouts and Hybrid Reward
news.summary: A small (Qwen3-4B) agent foundation model trained with CacheRL hits 92% process accuracy on multi-step tool-calling benchmarks — within striking distance of GPT-5's 94% — while needing roughly 100× less compute. The recipe: a hybrid thinking-trajectory pipeline that augments agent rollouts with LLM-generated reasoning, a CacheAgentLoop with three-tier fuzzy caching so RL runs without live tool calls, and a cache-tier-aware reward that stops the model from being penalized for cache-induced artefacts.

news.title: Closing the Reflection Gap: A Free Calibration Bonus for Agentic RL (RefGRPO)
news.summary: Diagnoses a "reflection gap" — LLM agents misjudge their own outputs after seeing concrete environment feedback, even on questions they answered correctly — and shows standard RL barely helps because of credit-assignment mismatch. RefGRPO adds a free calibration bonus that contrasts the agent's reflection with the actual outcome (no extra reward model or judge), plus a dynamic schedule on the coefficient.

news.title: CORA: Consistency-Oriented Reasoning Alignment for Multimodal RLVR
news.summary: Diagnoses "thinking-answer inconsistency" in multimodal RLVR (e.g. GRPO) and proposes CORA: a plug-and-play consistency reward model plus Hybrid Reward Advantage Splitting to stably coordinate task and consistency optimization. (Submitted to EMNLP 2026.)

news.title: Gaze Heads: How VLMs Look at What They Describe
news.summary: Identifies a small set of attention heads ("gaze heads") inside VLM language-model backbones whose attention tracks the image region currently being described. Just a handful of forward passes on comic strips (spatially laid-out narrative order) is enough to localize them via a correlation score.

news.title: HarnessX: A Composable, Adaptive, and Evolvable Agent Harness Foundry
news.summary: Agent performance hinges on the runtime harness — prompts, tools, memory, control flow — yet harnesses are still mostly hand-crafted and static. HarnessX assembles typed primitives via a substitution algebra, adapts them through AEGIS, a trace-driven multi-agent evolution engine grounded in an operational mirror between symbolic adaptation and RL, and closes the harness-model loop by turning execution traces into both harness updates and model training signal.

news.title: HPSv3++: Scaling Reward Models Across the Full Spectrum of Diffusion Model Capabilities
news.summary: Most T2I reward models are trained on data from older generators and stop tracking what newer models can do. HPSv3++ ships (1) HPDv3++, a 212K dual-dimension preference dataset (text fidelity + aesthetics) annotated against Qwen-Image with human supervision, and (2) a two-stage training recipe: data-aware orthogonal gradient projection that keeps the original HPSv3 knowledge while absorbing the new aesthetic signal, then a capability/iteration-conditioned signal + std-deviation-driven unsupervised guidance using unlabeled data from T2I models across capability levels and RL iterations.

news.title: Towards Direct Latent-Space Synthesis for Parallel Branches in LLM-Agent Workflows
news.summary: Parallel-Synthesis is a plug-and-play framework that lets a synthesizer LLM consume the KV caches produced by parallel worker agents directly, instead of concatenating their text outputs. A cache mapper calibrates independently generated branch caches, and a fine-tuned adapter enables generation from this non-sequential cache interface.

news.title: APPO: Agentic Procedural Policy Optimization
news.summary: Agentic RL today assigns credit over coarse units (tool-call boundaries, fixed workflows), but pilot analysis shows influential decision points are spread throughout the generated sequence, and token entropy alone doesn't reliably flag them. APPO shifts both branching and credit assignment to fine-grained decision points: a Branching Score combines token uncertainty with policy-induced likelihood gain of continuations, plus procedure-level advantage scaling distributes credit across branched rollouts. Across 13 benchmarks APPO lifts strong agentic-RL baselines by ~4 points on average while keeping tool-call counts efficient and rollouts interpretable.

news.title: Arbor: Toward Generalist Autonomous Research via Hypothesis-Tree Refinement
news.summary: Autonomous research agents usually fail because they treat each attempt as isolated. Arbor frames autonomous research as a long-lived Hypothesis-Tree Refinement (HTR) loop: a persistent tree links hypotheses, artifacts, evidence, and distilled insights across runs, with a long-lived coordinator managing global strategy and short-lived executors implementing and testing individual hypotheses in isolated worktrees. Across six real research tasks in model training, harness engineering, and data synthesis, Arbor beats Codex and Claude Code by 2.5× average relative held-out gain. On MLE-Bench Lite with GPT-5.5 it hits 86.36% Any Medal — strongest in the comparison.

news.title: ModSleuth: Auditing Invisible Dependencies in Modern LLMs
news.summary: Modern LLM training pipelines recursively depend on other models (data generation, filtering, judging, RL rewards) but the full dependency graph is fragmented across heterogeneous public artifacts. ModSleuth is an agentic system that recursively reconstructs these LLM dependency graphs from public sources with source-grounded evidence. Applying it to four artifact-rich LLM releases recovers 1,060 source-verified dependencies and exposes multi-hop license obligations, train/eval coupling, and documentation inconsistencies.

news.title: RACES: Verifiable Environments Are LEGO Bricks — Recursive Composition for Reasoning Generalization
news.summary: RL with verifiable rewards is the dominant recipe for reasoning post-training, but environment construction is the bottleneck — manual or per-task scaling is linear and shallow. RACES treats 300 individual verifiable environments as composable building blocks and defines composition operators (SEQUENTIAL, PARALLEL, SORT, SELECT) that fuse them when the codomain of one matches the domain of the next. RL training on these composites lifts DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B by +3.1 points (48.2 → 51.3) and Qwen3-14B from 58.8 → 61.1 on six held-out benchmarks not seen during construction.

news.title: AI 文明社会实验:Claude 建乌托邦,Grok 四天团灭(待核实)

news.summary: 中文 AI 日报报道:美国商务部以国家安全为由下达出口管制指令,要求 Anthropic 立即中止所有外国公民对 Fable 5 / Mythos 5 的访问权限(包括外籍员工),Fable 5 发布 72 小时即触发。Anthropic 发布长篇声明与《安全态势更新》公开反驳政府评估结论。同日亚马逊 CEO 被曝与美官员就 Anthropic 模型安全举行会谈。 仅单一中文聚合源,未在英文主流媒体中独立验证 — 标记待核实。

news.title: 英国议员起诉 xAI:Grok 深度伪造色情图像侵权
news.summary: 6 月 3 日,英国工党议员 Jess Asato 在高等法院起诉 xAI,指控 Grok 未经许可生成其深度伪造色情图像,主张系"刻意设计",援引英国数据保护法要求赔偿、公开道歉与禁令。首例议员级别针对生成式 AI 平台的法律挑战。

news.title: 软银宣布最高 750 亿欧元投资法国数据中心,最高 5GW 容量
news.summary: TechCrunch 报道,软银计划投入最高 750 亿欧元在法国建设数据中心,新增最高 5GW 容量。大模型竞争已升级为电力/土地/网络/芯片/长期资本支出的综合博弈。

news.title: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5——首个 Mythos 级公众模型
news.summary: 2026 年 6 月 9 日,Anthropic 正式推出 Claude Fable 5,定位首个向公众开放的 Mythos-class 模型,主打长时程任务(可自主运行数天)、百万行代码库迁移、复杂研发与深度视觉理解,被称是面向编码/研发/知识工作场景的"质变级"迭代。

news.title: Apple WWDC 2026 开幕,iOS 27 / Apple Intelligence / Siri 升级成焦点
news.summary: The Verge 报道,WWDC 2026 keynote 于 6 月 8 日-12 日在 Apple Park 举行,核心议题是 Apple Intelligence 兑现延期承诺、Siri 的 AI 升级,以及把端侧模型开放给第三方应用(对标 Google Gemini Nano 路径)。

news.title: Google DeepMind 主推 Gemini 3.5 系列 + Gemini Omni,Agent 化路线明确
news.summary: DeepMind 官网首页(2026-06-13 更新)主打 Gemini 3.5 系列、Gemini Omni(视频生成入口)与 Co-Scientist 协作研究伙伴;Gemini for Science 与 Gemma 4 开源线并进。结合 I/O 2026,Google 已把 Agent 化作为未来 12 个月的核心方向。

news.title: Hugging Face 热门模型:Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B、DeepSeek V4 Pro 主导榜单
news.summary: HF Trending(2026-06-07):NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B 上线即获 145 赞/4.7 万下载,DeepSeek V4 Pro/V4 Flash 横扫语言模型榜,反映开源生态向超大规模 MoE 与高效率推理两端集中。

news.title: OpenAI ChatGPT 记忆系统重大更新,生物安全与治理同步推进
news.summary: OpenAI 近日升级 ChatGPT 记忆能力,让模型在长期对话中持续记住用户偏好、写作风格与技术栈;同时围绕生物安全、前沿模型治理和行业落地连续发布进展,大模型公司正并行推进"产品体验 + 安全治理"。

news.title: EvoArena: Tracking Memory Evolution for Robust LLM Agents in Dynamic Environments
news.summary: A dynamic-environment evaluation harness and memory-evolution tracking method for LLM agents. Instead of one-shot static benchmarks, agents face environments that shift mid-task, and the framework tracks how their memory drifts, decays, or grows stale over time.

news.title: World Tracing: Generative Pixel-Aligned Geometry Beyond the Visible
news.summary: A new 3D scene representation that fuses depth-style pixel-aligned prediction with generative priors, producing geometry that is both anchored to input pixels and complete behind occluded regions — solving the faithfulness-vs-completeness tradeoff that has plagued image-to-3D since the NeRF era.

news.title: EurekAgent: Agent Environment Engineering is All You Need For Autonomous Scientific Discovery
news.summary: The authors argue the bottleneck for autonomous scientific discovery has shifted from agent workflow design to environment engineering . EurekAgent engineers the environment along four axes: permissions (bounded execution + isolated eval), artifacts (filesystem + Git collaboration), budgets (budget-aware exploration), and human oversight. Their system already outperforms human-designed baselines on metric-driven discovery tasks.

news.title: Recursive Agent Harnesses
news.summary: The paper formalizes Recursive Agent Harnesses (RAH) — a pattern where the recursive unit is a full agent harness (filesystem tools, code execution, planning) instead of a bare model call. The parent agent generates an executable script that spawns subagent harnesses in parallel, then calls structured functions for small subtasks. On Oolong-Synthetic long-context reasoning, RAH lifts the Codex coding-agent baseline from 71.75% to 81.36% with GPT-5, and further improves with Claude Sonnet 4.5.

news.title: Anthropic + OpenAI Go All-In on Education: Claude for Education (Learning Mode) + ChatGPT for Teachers (FERPA-Compliant, Free for US K-12 Through June 2027)
news.summary: Anthropic ($61.5B valuation) shipped Claude for Education with a "Learning Mode" that uses Socratic questioning instead of direct answers — explicit positioning against the "AI cheats student learning" critique. OpenAI followed with ChatGPT for Teachers: unlimited GPT-5.1 Auto, FERPA-compliant student data handling, free for all US K-12 faculty through June 2027. Both are textbook "land grab" moves into the classroom default stack.

news.title: Coursera–Udemy Merger Closes (May 11, 2026); $2.5B Combined Entity, 290M Learners, 18K Enterprise Customers
news.summary: The all-stock Coursera–Udemy merger announced Dec 2025 closed May 11, 2026. Udemy is now a wholly-owned subsidiary and has been delisted from NASDAQ; Udemy shareholders received 0.8 Coursera shares per share. Combined equity value ~$2.5B. CFO Mike Foley will host a post-merger modeling call June 23 to lay out FY26 guidance. Coursera separately announced a $500M share buyback on May 18 (≈⅓ of its $1.51B market cap) — a confidence signal after the deal.

news.title: EU AI Act Phased Enforcement Hits Education in 2026; UK Launches London EdTech Week (June 15–19) and Inclusive Mainstream SEND Funding Round
news.summary: The EU AI Act's education-relevant provisions are now in the active compliance window for 2026 — schools and EdTech vendors are scrambling on transparency, data governance, and high-risk system classification. In parallel, London EdTech Week 2026 (June 15–19) opens with the full sector convening around AI in the classroom. The UK government also released "Inclusive Mainstream Funding 2026–27" guidance (June 10) — new SEND (special educational needs) budgets districts can route into EdTech procurement.

news.title: Global EdTech VC Resets to $2.6B in 2025 (Tencent Cloud AI-Native Education Report) — "Rational Investment Era"
news.summary: Tencent Cloud's "2026 AI-Native Education Report" (published June 14) puts 2025 global EdTech VC at $2.6B — a continued reset from the 2021 peak. The report's framing: the core challenge is no longer "more AI tools" but "embedding AI deep into teaching workflows," shifting from knowledge transfer to competency construction. Confirmed by 36Kr coverage of Chinese giants (ByteDance's Doubao Aixue, Alibaba's Qianwen) consolidating AI-study entry points inside super-apps.

news.title: InterleaveThinker: Reinforcing Agentic Interleaved Generation
news.summary: First multi-agent pipeline that bolts interleaved (text-image) generation onto any existing image generator: a planner agent sequences the input, a critic agent inspects outputs and rewrites instructions for regen, trained with GRPO on a 13k step-wise RL set. Claims parity with Nano Banana and GPT-5 on interleaved benchmarks, plus sizeable reasoning-side gains on WISE / RISE for FLUX.2-klein 4-step.

news.title: Learning to Reason by Analogy via Retrieval-Augmented Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RA-RFT)
news.summary: Two-stage post-training: a retriever trained with gold-relevance distillation ranks contexts by expected reasoning benefit (not semantic similarity), then RL fine-tunes the policy using those analogous demonstrations under verifiable outcome rewards. On AIME 2025, +7.1 / +2.8 average@32 over GRPO for Qwen3-1.7B / Qwen3-4B respectively, and the paper argues the axis is orthogonal to reward / curriculum advances.

news.title: Recursive Agent Harnesses (RAH)
news.summary: Names and formalizes the pattern at the heart of Anthropic's dynamic workflows: a parent agent emits an executable script that spawns subagent harnesses (filesystem + code + planning) in parallel for fine-grained work, while keeping small subtasks as structured function calls. Distinguishes "harness recursion" from prior recursive-LM work that recurses over bare model calls. Fixed-backbone eval: with GPT-5, RAH lifts the Codex coding-agent baseline from 71.75% → 81.36% on Oolong-Synthetic (199 samples, up to 4M-token contexts); with Claude Sonnet 4.5, 89.77%.

news.title: Reward Modeling for Multi-Agent Orchestration (OrchRM)
news.summary: Self-supervised reward model trained from intermediate multi-agent execution artifacts via Bradley-Terry win-lose pairs, removing the need for expensive sub-agent rollouts during orchestrator training or MAS test-time scaling. Reports up to 10× lower training-token cost and up to +8% accuracy across math reasoning, web QA, and multi-hop reasoning, transferring across domains.

news.title: Anthropic 秘密提交 IPO 申请，估值 9650 亿美元
news.summary: Anthropic 于 6 月 2 日秘密向 SEC 提交 S-1，估值 9650 亿美元，超越 OpenAI 的 2000-3000 亿美元，亚马逊持股约 30%。市场关注 Fable 5 禁令事件是否影响 IPO 进程。

news.title: Meta 撤销 20 亿美元收购 Manus 交易
news.summary: Meta 与 Manus 在运营层面完成拆分并停止数据共享，受中国外商投资安全审查影响，也标志中美 AI 跨境并购进入冰点。Meta 原本计划以 20 亿美元收购这家中国背景的 AI 智能体初创公司。

news.title: 全球 75+ AI 数据中心项目被阻，总投资超 1300 亿美元
news.summary: SemiAnalysis 统计显示，全球超过 75 个 AI 数据中心项目因监管、环境、电力等原因被推迟或取消，总投资额超 1300 亿美元。从爱尔兰到弗吉尼亚，各国政府和社区对 AI 数据中心的高能耗开始反弹。

news.title: 扎克伯格承认 Meta AI 转型"脱轨"：裁员 10%、转岗 7000 人
news.summary: 扎克伯格罕见公开承认 Meta 的 AI 转型出现严重问题："我们调整得太快了。"裁员 10%、转岗 7000 人同时推进 AI 战略，组织剧烈震荡导致关键人才流失，前员工评价"用建设 AI 的口号摧毁了建设 AI 的基础"。

news.title: 智谱 GLM-5.2 全量开放，支持 1M 上下文，下周开源
news.summary: 智谱 AI 正式全量开放 GLM-5.2，支持 100 万 token 超长上下文，并宣布下周开源。在编程、推理、长文本理解等多项基准测试中表现强劲，是中国阵营在"超长上下文"赛道的重要突破。

news.title: 欧盟发布《技术主权一揽子计划》，强化 AI 与半导体布局
news.summary: 欧盟委员会发布欧洲技术主权一揽子计划（European Technological Sovereignty Package），推出一系列措施强化欧洲在 AI 与半导体领域的能力，回应中美科技竞争。

news.title: 美国以国家安全为由暂停 Claude Fable 5/Mythos 5 全球访问，Anthropic 公开反驳
news.summary: 美国商务部下达出口管制指令，要求 Anthropic 立即中止所有外国公民对 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 的访问权限（含外籍员工），而 Fable 5 发布仅 72 小时。Anthropic 发布长篇声明与《安全态势更新》公开反驳政府结论，为业内首次。同日，亚马逊 CEO 被曝与美官员就模型安全会谈。

news.title: 谷歌 Android 安全负责人因反对军事 AI 合作辞职
news.summary: 谷歌 Android 安全业务负责人因不认同公司与美军在 AI 领域的合作而辞职，内部备忘录写道"无法接受 AI 技术被用于军事目的"。事件反映谷歌与国防部 AI 合作加深的内部张力。

news.title: Andrej Karpathy 正式加入 Anthropic
news.summary: 前特斯拉 AI 总监、前 OpenAI 研究员 Andrej Karpathy 宣布加入 Anthropic，将负责模型训练与教育生态相关工作，被业内视为对前沿模型研发方向的重大背书。

news.title: arXiv 6 月热点：Agent 可靠性 + 多模态持续学习（ProtoAda、CRAM）
news.summary: arXiv 近期提交显著聚焦于 Agentic 系统可靠性与安全性，多篇论文探讨如何在 AI Agent 不可完全信任的前提下进行部署。ProtoAda 与 CRAM 在视觉-语言模型持续学习（避免灾难性遗忘）方向取得独立突破；扩散语言模型与分子动力学的 Speculative Decoding 变体也涌现。

news.title: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini Omni：从视频开始的多模态全能生成模型
news.summary: Gemini Omni 是 DeepMind 旗舰多模态生成模型，覆盖视频、图像、文本、音频跨模态创作；同期推出 Antigravity 2.0（Managed Antigravity Agents）面向 Gemini API 用户开放，标志着 Agent 商业化进入新阶段。

news.title: Hugging Face 发布 LeRobot Humanoid 双足机器人项目
news.summary: HF 于 5 月 21 日博文推出 LeRobot Humanoid，提供软硬件全套方案，起步价 2500 美元（约 17000 元人民币），把开源机器人门槛大幅拉低。

news.title: Jeff Bezos 的 Prometheus 获 12B 融资，目标"人工通用工程师"
news.summary: TechCrunch 报道，Bezos 牵头的新公司 Prometheus 完成 120 亿美元融资，目标是打造面向物理世界的人工通用工程师（artificial general engineer）。NVIDIA、OpenAI 等机构参投，被视为机器人+基础模型融合赛道最大单笔融资。

news.title: Mistral AI Vibe v2.1.0 发布
news.summary: Mistral 发布 Mistral Vibe v2.1.0（6 月 6 日），继续推进客户端 + 轻量级部署路径，与 Mistral 3 系列（含 Mistral Large 3）形成生态闭环。

news.title: OpenAI Codex + Frontier 模型正式登陆 AWS
news.summary: 在 OpenAI 与微软修订合作协议后，AWS 已上架 OpenAI 全系产品，Frontier Models 与 Codex 面向 AWS 客户开放，扫除了云分发层面的合作障碍，最高合作金额达 500 亿美元级别。
