news.summary: OpenAI 政策主管 Chris Lehane 在达沃斯透露，公司将在 2026 年下半年推出首款硬件设备，已就芯片、电机、包装材料、数据中心冷却等关键组件向美国本土厂商发出 RFP，涵盖消费设备、机器人及云数据中心扩展。

news.title: 韩国《AI 基本法》1 月 22 日生效：全球首部全面实施的国家级 AI 法律
news.summary: 韩国《关于人工智能发展和构建信赖基础的基本法》自 1 月 22 日起施行，是全球首个全面落地的国家级 AI 监管法律，欧盟 AI Act 全面生效要等到 2027 年；中国开发者涉黄刑案二审、上海一中院已休庭，AI 内容合规边界持续受到法律审视。

news.title: BitResEdit: Bitwise Residual Editing for Visual Autoregressive Models
news.summary: A training-free editor for bitwise-residual visual autoregressive generators (e.g. Infinity). BitEdit tilts per-bit Bernoulli log-odds via source-negative guidance under a closed-form Bernoulli-KL trust region; ResEdit converts sampled bits into per-scale continuous residuals, gates them with a localization mask, and re-injects them through the generator's native sum-of-scales. On PIE-Bench with Infinity-2B it improves CLIP on the edited region by +1.07 over the strongest prior editor at competitive background preservation.

news.title: EpiBench: Verifiable Evaluation of AI Agents on Epigenomics Analysis
news.summary: A verifiable benchmark for short-horizon epigenomics workflows spanning CUT&Tag/CUT&RUN, ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq and DNA methylation. Across 5,088 valid trajectories from 16 model-harness pairs, no system passes a majority of attempts: GPT-5.5/Pi leads at 45.0%, GPT-5.5/Codex 39.9%, Opus 4.8 Max 39.0%, GPT-5.4/Pi 39.0%. Agents locate the right files and compute useful intermediates, but break when the task demands deeper, assay-specific scientific judgment.

news.title: LabVLA: Grounding Vision-Language-Action Models in Scientific Laboratories
news.summary: Identifies lab data and embodiment as the central bottlenecks for VLA models and addresses both: a simulation-based RoboGenesis data engine that composes workflows from atomic skills, plus a two-stage policy (FAST action-token pretraining on Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, then flow-matching DiT action expert under knowledge insulation). Hits the highest average success rate on the LabUtopia benchmark in-distribution and OOD. Project at zjunlp.github.io/LabVLA/.

news.title: China Pushes "AI + Education" Action Plan; K-12 Districts Begin Mandatory AI Literacy Courses
news.summary: China's May 2026 "AI + Education" Action Plan (五部门联合) is now being operationalized. Xiuzhou District confirmed AI literacy will be a mandatory general-education course for all students starting Fall 2026. The 2026 World Digital Education Conference set the policy frame; provincial rollout is the next 12 months.

news.title: Nuventive Launches AI-Powered Feedback Assistant for Higher-Ed Planning
news.summary: Nuventive (June 2, 2026) shipped an AI Feedback Assistant aimed at university institutional-effectiveness and planning teams, automating the close-the-loop cycle on assessment results and accreditation evidence. Move signals the "AI for the back office" wave hitting higher ed a full year after the K-12 classroom.

news.title: School Districts Pivot to ClassDojo Amid Phone-Free School Push and Budget Squeeze
news.summary: EdTech Chronicle (June 10) reports that U.S. K-12 districts are increasingly consolidating family-communication spend onto ClassDojo as phone-free classroom policies force a return to managed apps and tight 2026 budgets push out point solutions. ClassDojo now claims 45M+ students and parents on its platform.

news.title: UK EdTech Platform Edumentors Crosses $4M Revenue Milestone
news.summary: Edumentors, the UK-based 1:1 tutoring marketplace, has crossed $4M in cumulative revenue, per EdTech Chronicle. Growth is driven by UK/EU parent demand for vetted human tutors post-ChatGPT — a notable counter-signal to the "AI eats tutoring" thesis.

news.title: 2026 AI 状况报告：全球 AI 投资 8000 亿美元，应用层押注生产力重构
news.summary: 报告显示 2025 年全球 AI 相关投资突破 8000 亿美元，AI 初创风投融资 2258 亿美元（同比 +97%），平均交易规模翻倍；印度成为 AI 应用核心市场，企业级"结果付费"模式成为新趋势。

news.title: Anthropic 推出企业级 Claude 追踪工具 + 合作伙伴中心
news.summary: 6 月 4 日 Anthropic 上线服务跟踪器（Service Tracker）与合作伙伴中心两项新功能，帮助企业追踪 Claude 生成内容的产出进度并比对需求匹配度，属 3 月推出的 Claude Partner Network 的一部分。

news.title: Google DeepMind 上线 Managed Antigravity Agents
news.summary: Google 通过 Gemini API 提供托管式 Antigravity 2.0 Agents，让开发者直接调用托管多智能体执行能力，进一步把 Agent 能力下沉到 API 层。

news.title: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemma 4 开源模型系列
news.summary: 4 月 3 日 DeepMind 发布 Gemma 4，推出 4 款规格覆盖端侧到工作站，端侧 Gemini Nano 4 性能提升 4×、电池消耗下降 60%。Hugging Face 热度榜上 Gemma 4 多规格版本近期持续霸榜。

news.title: Google I/O 2026：Gemini 3.5 Flash + Antigravity 2.0 + 搜索最大改版
news.summary: 5 月 20 日 Google 开发者大会以 Gemini 3.5 Flash 打头阵（速度 4× 同类、价格不足一半），同时发布 Gemini 应用新视觉语言 "Neural Expressive"，并推出 Agent 生态与全栈技术闭环。

news.title: Mistral AI 发布 Medium 3.5 + 远程编码代理 + Le Chat 工作模式
news.summary: 4 月 29 日 Mistral 一口气甩出三件套：中型模型 Medium 3.5、基于其驱动的 Vibe 平台远程编码代理，以及 Le Chat 工作模式，正式发力企业协作与远程开发。

news.title: Mistral AI 拟以 ~200 亿欧元估值进行 D 轮融资，目标募资 30 亿欧元
news.summary: 彭博 6 月 13 日消息：Mistral AI 正与投资人就新一轮融资进行早期接触，估值约 200 亿欧元（约合 1567 亿元人民币），目标融资 30 亿欧元，用于运营扩张。

news.title: xAI 推出 Grok STT/TTS API
news.summary: 4 月 17 日 xAI 正式开放语音转文本（STT）与文本转语音（TTS）API，主打高保真、低延迟，面向开发者集成语音对话能力，扩大 Grok 商业化入口。

news.title: AgentBeats: Agentifying Agent Assessment for Openness, Standardization, and Reproducibility
news.summary: Agent evaluation is fragmented because most benchmarks use LLM-centric fixed harnesses that create test-production mismatch. The authors advocate "Agentified Agent Assessment" (AAA): judges are themselves agents, and every participant — judge and subject — interacts only through standardized protocols (A2A for task management, MCP for tools). They back this with a 5-month open competition that drew 298 judge agents across 12 categories + 467 subject agents from independent teams, plus a controlled coding-agent case study that confirms fidelity with public records.

news.title: Agents-K1: Towards Agent-native Knowledge Orchestration
news.summary: Research agents orchestrate calls well but treat papers as flat citations. Agents-K1 is an end-to-end pipeline that converts raw scientific documents into agent-native knowledge graphs: a multimodal parser (entities, evidence, claims, method lineages, 5-module schema), a 4B extraction backbone trained with GRPO + rule-based rewards, and a tri-source agent interface (graphanything CLI) that unifies web search, multimodal graph retrieval, and cross-document traversal. Already used to build Scholar-KG over 2.46M papers across six subjects (1M-paper subset released).

news.title: HyperTool: Beyond Step-Wise Tool Calls for Tool-Augmented Agents
news.summary: Today's tool agents expose every atomic tool call, observation, and value transfer in the model's main reasoning trace — creating execution-granularity mismatch where deterministic sub-routines are unfolded into repeated model-visible decisions. HyperTool changes the model-visible unit: the model emits a code block that calls existing tools through their original MCP schemas, manipulates returned values, and passes intermediates locally, folding deterministic sub-workflows into one outer call. Trained on synthesized HyperTool-format trajectories verified in real MCP environments.

news.title: Mana: Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Tools
news.summary: A sim-to-real framework that reframes dexterous manipulation as an animation problem: procedurally-generated grasp keyframes get turned into manipulation trajectories via motion planning + RL. Data generation is nearly automatic (<1 minute per tool). Achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for grasping and in-hand manipulation across four articulated tools spanning different scales and joint types.

news.title: Modality Forcing for Scalable Spatial Generation
news.summary: A simple post-training recipe that turns a single DiT into a joint image+depth generator by assigning separate noise levels per modality — trainable on sparse real-world depth, with per-modality decoders. The key finding: scale works. Training T2I DiTs from scratch at 370M → 3.3B parameters shows larger models trained on more image data produce more accurate depth, with the largest model competitive with SOTA monocular depth estimators and a 57% relative AbsRel reduction vs. existing joint image-depth generative models.

news.title: Reasoning as Pattern Matching: Shared Mechanisms in Human and LLM Everyday Reasoning
news.summary: When LLMs fail in seemingly random ways, the standard explanation is "they're not really reasoning, just pattern-matching." This paper tests 25 LLMs and human participants on the same everyday causal-reasoning problems and finds they make strikingly similar errors — including errors humans make from irrelevant prompt details. The authors then identify the specific attention heads driving LLM responses and show these heads implement a form of pattern-matching that also predicts the human errors.

news.title: SpatialClaw: Rethinking Action Interface for Agentic Spatial Reasoning
news.summary: A training-free spatial-reasoning framework that gives a VLM a stateful Python kernel pre-loaded with perception and geometry primitives — the agent writes one executable cell per step, conditioned on prior outputs. Across 20 static/dynamic 3D-4D spatial reasoning benchmarks, it hits 59.9% average accuracy, +11.2 points over the prior best spatial agent, with consistent gains across 6 VLM backbones.

news.title: Anthropic launches "Claude Corps" — $150M fellowship placing 1,000 AI fellows at US nonprofits
news.summary: Announced Jun 11, Claude Corps pays 1,000 early-career fellows $85K/year for 12 months to embed at 400+ nonprofits (Braven, Code the Dream, Heartland Forward, Montgomery County Food Bank, etc.). Backed by CodePath as employer-of-record and Social Finance for measurement. Co-released with Anthropic's new "Policy on the AI Exponential" framework — a clear escalation of the labor-disruption policy fight.

news.title: Anthropic publishes "Policy on the AI Exponential" — argues institutions are built for a slower world
news.summary: Released Jun 10, the policy paper is Anthropic's most aggressive push yet for structural AI-era institutional reform. It frames current policy as calibrated for linear progress and proposes specific overhauls for labor, safety, and AI governance. Expect this to be cited heavily in US/EU debates over the rest of 2026.

news.title: Anthropic ships Claude Fable 5 (Mythos-class) and Claude Mythos 5 to cyberdefenders
news.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5 on Jun 9 — described as its most capable generally-released model yet, SOTA on nearly every benchmark, can autonomously play Pokémon FireRed with vision-only harness, and stay coherent across millions of tokens. Pricing is $10/$50 per million I/O tokens (less than half Claude Mythos Preview). Claude Mythos 5 (same weights, safeguards lifted) is rolling out first to Project Glasswing cyber defenders and the US government.

news.title: DeepMind announces "Gemini Omni — Create anything from anything, starting with video"
news.summary: Featured as a flagship Jun-2026 release on deepmind.google, Gemini Omni is positioned as a multimodal creation model that takes any input (text/image/audio/video) and produces any output modality. Pairs with the new "Nano Banana" image model and Veo video stack. Likely a direct shot at Sora + Midjourney + ElevenLabs combined.

news.title: DeepMind dedicates new round of funding to multi-agent AI safety research
news.summary: Jun-2026 DeepMind blog post formalizes "Investing in multi-agent AI safety research" as a research priority — coordination failures, collusion, and emergent behavior in agent swarms. Significant because DeepMind has historically stayed quieter on agent governance than Anthropic; this signals a public posture shift.

news.title: EU "Tech Sovereignty Package" (Cloud & AI Development Act, Chips Act 2.0) advances to Parliament
news.summary: Commission unveiled the package Jun 3 with two new legislative proposals — the Cloud & AI Development Act and Chips Act 2.0 — plus an open-source strategy and a digitalization/AI roadmap for energy. Now in Council/Parliament trilogue. Includes explicit "open source strategy" — first time the EU has bundled FOSS into its industrial policy this directly.

news.title: Google DeepMind ships DiffusionGemma — 4x faster text generation via diffusion LLMs
news.summary: Released Jun 2026, DiffusionGemma is DeepMind's open diffusion-based language model family claiming up to 4x faster generation than comparable autoregressive models at similar quality. Big deal for the "diffusion LLM" camp (LLaDA / Mercury / etc.) — Google just legitimized the approach with first-party weights.

news.title: OpenAI confirms confidential S-1 filing with SEC — IPO path now real
news.summary: Filed Jun 8, OpenAI submitted a confidential draft S-1 to the SEC for a future public listing, paired with a "Built to Benefit Everyone: Our Plan" pledge and the launch of the OpenAI Economic Research Exchange. Also on Jun 10, OpenAI made its models and Codex accessible via Oracle Cloud commitments — distribution moat keeps widening.

news.title: OpenAI to acquire Ona — and shows Codex simulating black holes with an astrophysicist
news.summary: Two Jun-11 moves: (1) acquisition of Ona (developer-tooling/agent platform), expanding OpenAI's desktop/CLI agent surface area; (2) a published case study where an astrophysicist uses Codex to drive black-hole simulations — first serious public pitch for Codex in scientific computing. Academy courses for "next era of work" dropped Jun 12.

news.title: Trump signs "narrower" AI executive order — 30-day pre-release notice to government (down from draft 90)
news.summary: Signed earlier this month after industry lobbying shaved the pre-release review window from a draft 90 days down to 30. Creates a centralised federal AI approval authority and is explicitly designed to pre-empt state-level AI laws (per AI czar David Sacks). Also instructs national security/cyber officials to coordinate with top labs on Mythos-class software-bug discoveries.

news.title: Chinese ADRs rally; Nasdaq Golden Dragon +0.48%
news.summary: Most major Chinese ADRs closed higher in New York trade: TSMC +0.65%, Alibaba +0.08%, PDD +0.32%, ASE +3.53%, NetEase +0.17%, UMC +4.50%, JD +1.78%, Li Auto +3.77%. The Nasdaq Golden Dragon Index gained 0.48%.

news.title: EU prepares AI Act enforcement guidance; ECB monetary dialogue ahead
news.summary: European Parliament ECON committee confirmed a Monetary Dialogue with the ECB for 22 June (prep 18 June), focused on the quarterly assessment of ECB monetary stance and rising concerns over euro-area AI/cloud capex inflation. Brussels is also finalising enforcement guidance for general-purpose AI obligations under the EU AI Act.

news.title: Intel surges ~8% as AI-chip positioning rattles semis
news.summary: Intel (INTC) jumped 8.1% to US$126.43 in late US trade Friday, lifting market cap to roughly US$635B, after renewed investor appetite for US AI-chip exposure dragged the broader semi complex higher. TSMC, UMC and ASX-listed semis sentiment firmed in sympathy.

news.title: Musk becomes first trillion-dollar net-worth individual
news.summary: Elon Musk crossed the US$1 trillion mark on Friday, driven by SpaceX's revised valuation and a re-rating of xAI/x.com. The milestone comes as SpaceX pivots strategy toward AI infrastructure for 2027 and beyond.

news.title: US tightens chip-export pressure on allies; Beijing pushes back
news.summary: Bloomberg reported the Trump administration is sketching a tougher version of semiconductor curbs and pressing key allies (Japan, Netherlands, Korea) to escalate restrictions on China's chip industry. Beijing's foreign ministry called the moves "politicisation of trade" and warned of blowback.

news.title: Anthropic CEO Amodei: 10–25% chance AI causes "civilizational collapse"
news.summary: Dario Amodei gave a stark warning this week, putting the probability of AI-driven civilizational collapse at 10–25% and calling current institutional preparation "painfully inadequate." Comes as Anthropic walks back a Claude policy that critics said would have sabotaged independent AI safety research.

news.title: ArXiv digest: agentic safety + multimodal continual learning dominate
news.summary: Latest ArXiv agentic-AI digests highlight (1) ProtoAda and CRAM — vision-language models that expand without catastrophic forgetting, (2) MLLM-as-a-Judge perceptual-bias fixes via perceptual perturbation + reward modelling, and (3) specialised safety/eval frameworks for clinical, financial, and safety-critical robotics.

news.title: DeepSeek V4 (1M context) and Qwen remain the open-source charts leaders
news.summary: April's DeepSeek-V4 preview (1M-token context, open-sourced) plus strong Qwen variants continue to dominate Hugging Face trending charts, keeping pressure on closed labs on cost-per-token and long-context benchmarks.

news.title: EU unveils sweeping tech sovereignty package, testing open source rules
news.summary: The EU is pushing a "tech sovereignty" package that rebalances autonomy with openness, putting open-source AI rules under a fresh stress test. Bruegel argues the bloc should trade ex-ante regulatory burden for stronger ex-post monitoring and judicial review.

news.title: Google ships Gemini 3.5 Flash with "Neural Expressive" UI redesign
news.summary: Following Google I/O 2026 (May 19–20), Gemini 3.5 Flash is now live in the Gemini app — faster than peers, can generate rich interactive web UIs/charts, and beats Gemini 3.1 Pro on coding/agent benchmarks. Gemini 3.5 Pro slated for the following month.

news.title: Meta's "Avocado" (Llama successor) drops as a proprietary model in 2026 Q1
news.summary: After the Llama 4 benchmark-cheating scandal (confirmed by Yann LeCun), Meta shifts strategy — Avocado will be closed-weight, a major departure from Meta's open-weights tradition. Pressure mounts as Mistral, DeepSeek, and Qwen continue shipping strong open models.

news.title: OpenAI targets ~4,000 headcount by year-end, doubles down on multi-agent 2026
news.summary: CFO Sarah Friar says 2026 is the "year of multi-agent systems" — agents running ERP, real-time contract tracking, and personal trip planning. OpenAI also plans to ship its first hardware device in 2026 and is roughly doubling staff to ~4,000.

news.title: Trump signs AI executive order requiring 30-day pre-release notice to government
news.summary: New EO mandates AI labs notify the US government 30 days before publicly releasing powerful models, and creates a centralised federal AI approval authority designed to pre-empt state-level regulation.

news.title: xAI engineer fired after raising Grok safety alarms — new lawsuit claims
news.summary: A former xAI engineer alleges retaliation for flagging Grok safety issues. TechCrunch has the story; OCI also just added native xAI Grok 4.3 support and xAI-compatible tools, signalling Grok is being wired deeper into enterprise stacks.

news.title: xAI preps 1.5T-parameter Grok V9-Medium for public release in 2–3 weeks
news.summary: Musk confirmed training finished on the 1.5T-param Grok V9-Medium base; fine-tuning underway, RL stage next. Meanwhile Grok Build (beta) is now open to all SuperGrok and X Premium+ users with Plan Mode, image/video gen, and a CLI for orchestration.

news.title: Anthropic pulls Fable 5 and Mythos 5 from every customer after Trump export-control order
news.summary: Trump administration issued an export-control directive to Anthropic to suspend foreign-national access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 (the models it had called "too dangerous" to release). Anthropic disabled them globally "to ensure compliance," says it believes there's a "misunderstanding" and is working to restore access. Comes as OpenAI was also subpoenaed by the New York AG on Friday covering ads, minors, deep learning, and consumer data.

news.title: DOJ clears Paramount Skydance's $110B Warner Bros Discovery takeover
news.summary: After an 8-month antitrust review, the DOJ found the $110B ($156B AUD) Paramount–WBD merger is unlikely to harm competition. California AG and the EU/UK are still reviewing (EU tentative deadline July 7; UK CMA initial decision early August). 1,400+ Hollywood creators signed an open letter opposing the deal; the merged entity would own HBO, CNN, and the broader Warner film/TV library.

news.title: SpaceX IPOs at $2.2T — Musk becomes the world's first trillionaire; xAI now in the stack
news.summary: SpaceX listed on Nasdaq Friday at $135, opened $150, briefly hit $176.50, closed ~$161 — biggest-ever IPO, raising $75B. Valuation now $2.2T; Bloomberg pegs Musk at $1.11T net worth. Company is unprofitable ($9B+ losses 2025-YTD 2026) on heavy AI/orbit-data-center capex, with $9B+ in losses 2025–YTD 2026. xAI was folded in earlier this year.

news.title: Switzerland votes tomorrow on capping population at 10 million — labour-market implications for tech
news.summary: Swiss referendum on Sunday would cap the population at 10M and restrict immigration. Switzerland hosts a large chunk of EU/UK Big Tech R&D (Google Zurich, Meta Lausanne/Geneva, Microsoft, many AI labs). Combined with the Anthropic ban hitting foreign AI access, the EU's AI Act enforcement ramp, and US export controls, the talent+model-access squeeze on non-US engineers is compounding.

news.title: US-Iran peace deal "close" — Hormuz reopens, blockade lifted, 60-day nuclear clock starts
news.summary: Iran's FM says a 14-point MOU is finalising after Pakistani/Qatari mediation. Strait of Hormuz reopens and US blockade lifts "more or less immediately" once signed, followed by 60 days of talks on Iran's enriched uranium (destroyed on-site, then removed). No up-front cash for Tehran — staged reintegration tied to verified performance, including proxy-funding cuts.

news.title: China launches 17-game June pipeline — Tencent's "Lineage 2", NetEase life-sim, female-oriented "夜幕之下" lead the slate
news.summary: GameLook tally shows ~17 Chinese mobile/PC titles slated for June, headlined by Tencent's Lineage 2 mobile, a NetEase life-sim, and 百奥's female-oriented "夜幕之下". Also: 斗鱼 posted Q1 2026 revenue of ¥822M with gross margin +14% YoY (adjusted net profit ¥30.8M, swung positive) on a higher-margin "innovation + ads" mix now 44% of revenue for five straight quarters.

news.title: China's VAST closes ~$200M (A+ / A++) and pivots to "world model" tech for interactive content
news.summary: VAST, a 3D / world-model AI startup founded by ex-Tsinghua researchers, closed a combined ~$200M A+ and A++ round led by 渶策资本 (INCE Capital) and 国寿长三角科创基金, formally disclosing a world-model technical roadmap for persistent, multi-user interactive scenes. Latest valuation undisclosed; previous round was the largest single check in China's 3D large-model track.

news.title: MA Damai Entertainment FY2026 — Revenue ¥8.02B (+20%), Net Profit ¥705M (+94%) on IP Boom
news.summary: Alibaba-affiliated Damai Entertainment (01060.HK) reported FY2026 (ended March 31) revenue of ¥8.02B, up 20% YoY; net profit attributable to owners of ¥705M, up 94% YoY. IP derivatives business grew 60% YoY to ¥2.17B. The live performance ticketing segment grew 11% — China's concert box office crossed ¥60B (~US$9B) in 2025, +6.4% YoY.

news.title: Paramount merges Pluto TV, BET+, and Paramount+ tech stack ahead of HBO Max integration
news.summary: Paramount confirmed (11 Jun) it will consolidate Pluto TV (FAST), BET+ (Black-audience SVOD), and Paramount+ onto a single tech stack by mid-2026 to prepare for the WBD integration. The shared backend underpins the unified "HBO Max" relaunch in North America, bundling ad-tier HBO Max with Paramount's three services under one login and billing rail.
news.source: Paramount merges Pluto TV, BET+, and Paramount+ tech stack ahead of HBO Max integration

news.title: POLICY Ubisoft Delays Profit Targets Again — Restructuring Reshapes Game Pipeline
news.summary: Ubisoft pushed back its profitability milestones as its multi-year restructuring continues to reshape its release slate. Cost-cutting and project cancellations remain the dominant theme, with new release dates slipping across several franchises.

news.title: PRODUCT Netflix Launches Free FIFA World Cup Game on June 11 — Taking On EA Without a Streaming License
news.summary: Netflix Games released FIFA World Cup: Launch Edition on June 11 — the day the 2026 FIFA World Cup kicks off in the US/Canada/Mexico. The subscription-included title features 48 national teams, 16 real stadiums, and 1,248 players. No broadcast rights, no extra fee — just lean on Netflix's 280M+ global subscriber base.

news.title: PRODUCT Summer Game Fest 2026 — Major Reveals: Alien: Isolation 2, Control Resonant, Star Wars Galactic Racer, Onimusha 3
news.summary: Geoff Keighley's Summer Game Fest 2026 showcase (June 5–6, Dolby Theatre LA) dropped a packed slate: Alien: Isolation 2 , Remedy's Control: Resonant (Sept 24), Star Wars: Galactic Racer (Oct 6), PlatinumGames/Paramount's TMNT: The Last Ronin , Bandai Namco's Gundam Rogue Orbit (2027), and Onimusha 3 . PlayStation State of Play followed with the surprise God of War: Laufey and Insomniac's Wolverine .

news.title: Sony State of Play June 2026: God of War 3D "Laufey" PS5 surprise, Marvel's Wolverine gameplay, Control Resonant dated
news.summary: Sony's 4 June State of Play (timed with Summer Game Fest) revealed: God of War "Laufey" for PS5 starring Jack Quaid as a cube companion, Marvel's Wolverine gameplay featuring Jean Grey team-up, Control Resonant (Remedy) release date + return of a fan-favorite character, and Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis reveal. PS Plus June catalog adds Final Fantasy XVI, Sonic × Shadow Generations, Kingdom Come: Deliverance. Bungie fans hijacked the broadcast to demand Destiny 3.
news.source: Sony State of Play June 2026: God of War 3D "Laufey" PS5 surprise, Marvel's Wolverine gameplay, Control Resonant dated

news.title: Take-Two reaffirms GTA VI 19 Nov 2026; Q4 net bookings $1.58B, TTWO +6% after-hours
news.summary: Take-Two Interactive (TTWO) reiterated GTA VI will ship 19 Nov 2026 on PS5 / Xbox Series X|S, with CEO Zelnick telling The Game Business review scores are "critical." Q4 revenue $1.68B (+6.3% YoY), net bookings $1.58B, EPS loss narrowed to -$0.32 vs. -$0.57 expected. Shares jumped 6% in extended trading.

news.title: UK CMA opens formal probe into Paramount Skydance's $110B Warner Bros. Discovery takeover
news.summary: Britain's Competition and Markets Authority has launched a formal antitrust review of Paramount Skydance's proposed ~$110B acquisition of WBD, announced 10 June. UK regulator joins U.S. lawmakers (Sen. Warren, House Democrats) already probing the deal, while Paramount defends the merger in letters to the California AG citing theatrical incentives.
news.source: UK CMA opens formal probe into Paramount Skydance's $110B Warner Bros. Discovery takeover

news.title: Agents-K1: Towards Agent-native Knowledge Orchestration
news.summary: End-to-end pipeline that converts 2.46M raw papers into an agent-native scientific knowledge graph (Scholar-KG) using a 5-module multimodal parser + 4B extraction backbone trained with GRPO. Releases a 1M-paper subset, exposed via a "graphanything" CLI that unifies web search, multimodal graph retrieval, and cross-document traversal.

news.title: Arbor: Toward Generalist Autonomous Research via Hypothesis-Tree Refinement
news.summary: A generalist agent that runs long-horizon autonomous research by combining a long-lived coordinator, short-lived executors, and a persistent Hypothesis Tree that links hypotheses, artifacts, evidence, and distilled lessons across runs. Re-frames autonomous research from a sequence of local attempts into a cumulative process where strategy, execution, and evidence carry forward in time.

news.title: Claw-SWE-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating OpenClaw-style Agent Harnesses on Coding Tasks
news.summary: A multilingual SWE-bench-style benchmark (350 issues across 8 languages and 43 repos, plus an 80-instance Lite subset) with an adapter protocol that makes heterogeneous agent harnesses — "claws" — comparable under a fixed prompt, runtime budget, workspace contract, and patch extraction pipeline.

news.title: EurekAgent: Agent Environment Engineering is All You Need For Autonomous Scientific Discovery
news.summary: Argues the bottleneck for autonomous science has shifted from agent workflows to environment design . Engineers the agent env along four axes: permissions, artifacts (git+fs), budgets, and human-in-the-loop. The system sets new SOTA on math, kernel engineering, and ML tasks.

news.title: EvoArena: Tracking Memory Evolution for Robust LLM Agents in Dynamic Environments
news.summary: A new benchmark suite that evaluates LLM agents in environments that keep changing, plus EvoMem, a patch-based memory paradigm that records how the agent's memory evolves over time. Current agents score only 39.6% on average; EvoMem boosts accuracy on evolving tasks by 1.5% and lifts GAIA by 6.1% / LoCoMo by 4.8%.

news.title: Flex4DHuman: Flexible Multi-view Video Diffusion for 4D Human Reconstruction
news.summary: A multi-view video diffusion built on Wan 2.1 1.3B that lifts a monocular or sparse-view video into dense synchronized multi-view using only relative camera-pose conditioning (no skeleton/depth/normals priors). Extends spatio-temporal RoPE with view indices + continuous SE(3) geometry. Plugs into 4D Gaussian Splatting.

news.title: InterleaveThinker: Reinforcing Agentic Interleaved Generation
news.summary: First multi-agent pipeline that gives any off-the-shelf image generator interleaved (text+image sequence) generation capability. A planner agent organizes the image-text input sequence and instructs the image generator step-by-step; a second agent then integrates outputs. Reinforcement learning is used to make the planner reason about interleaving decisions.

news.title: Learning to Reason by Analogy via Retrieval-Augmented Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RA-RFT)
news.summary: Trains a retriever to rank contexts by expected reasoning benefit instead of semantic similarity, then fine-tunes the policy via GRPO on those retrieved analogical demonstrations with verifiable outcome rewards.

news.title: Mana: Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Tools
news.summary: Re-frames dexterous manipulation as a computer-animation problem: a coarse-to-fine pipeline turns procedurally-generated grasp keyframes into full manipulation trajectories via motion planning + RL. Data generation needs <1 minute of mouse clicks per tool.

news.title: MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA): Native 1M-Context Inference for Multimodal Models
news.summary: Blockwise sparse attention built on Grouped Query Attention: a lightweight Index Branch scores key-value blocks and picks a Top-k subset per GQA group; the Main Branch then runs exact block-sparse attention only on those blocks. Co-designed with an exp-free Top-k + KV-outer sparse GPU kernel. Trained on a 109B-parameter natively multimodal model.

news.title: Modality Forcing for Scalable Spatial Generation
news.summary: A simple post-training recipe that turns a single DiT into a joint image+depth generator by assigning per-modality noise levels and per-modality decoders. Trains on sparse real-world depth and scales from 370M → 3.3B parameters.

news.title: Reason, Then Re-reason (ReRe): Cross-view Revisiting Improves Spatial Reasoning
news.summary: A training-free, inference-time framework for spatial reasoning from egocentric video. The Reason phase forms a spatial hypothesis from the original clip; the Re-reason phase verifies or revises it by watching a Geometry-to-Video pipeline that renders strategically complementary novel views (elevated, oblique, scene-spanning) from predicted 3D geometry.

news.title: RepWAM: World Action Modeling with Representation Visual-Action Tokenizers
news.summary: Argues that reconstruction-based video tokenizers (the default in world action models) are the wrong abstraction for robot control. Proposes a representation visual-action tokenizer that maps inputs to aligned visual + latent-action tokens, then pretrains a WAM to jointly model future states and the actions connecting them.

news.title: Reroute, Don't Remove: Recoverable Visual Token Routing for Vision-Language Models
news.summary: Visual-token reduction for VLMs usually ranks and permanently discards low-importance tokens. Reroute shows that hurts grounding because importance flips across decoder depth. A training-free plug-in replaces removal with recoverable routing: deferred tokens bypass a stage and re-enter the candidate pool at the next routing decision.

news.title: Reward Modeling for Multi-Agent Orchestration (OrchRM)
news.summary: Self-supervised reward model that scores the orchestrator (not sub-agents) of an LLM multi-agent system. Uses intermediate artifacts from MAS executions to build win/lose pairs for Bradley-Terry training — no human annotation, no costly sub-agent rollouts. Enables reward-guided orchestrator training and MAS test-time scaling.

news.title: Select and Improve: Understanding the Mechanics of Post-Training for Reasoning
news.summary: Controlled math-reasoning experiments on Qwen-2.5-1.5B identify two distinct mechanisms behind RL post-training gains: "strategy selection" (activated by diverse SFT data) and "strategy improvement" (activated by increasing RL data difficulty). Gives mechanistic insight + actionable training recipes.

news.title: SpatialClaw: Rethinking Action Interface for Agentic Spatial Reasoning
news.summary: Argues the bottleneck for spatial-reasoning VLMs is the action interface, not the model. SpatialClaw uses code-as-action: a stateful Python kernel pre-loaded with frames + perception/geometry primitives, where the VLM writes one executable cell per step, conditioned on all prior text+visual outputs. Training-free.

news.title: TRON: Tracing Rays to Orchestrate a Neural Renderer for 3D Gaussian Reconstructions
news.summary: Bridges two rendering paradigms for 3D Gaussian scenes: uses an inverse-rendering model's intrinsic decomposition priors to regularize the Gaussian field's materials, then repurposes a ray tracer as a structured 3D scaffold (radiometric guidance, not final pixels) so a lightweight neural renderer can bridge the PBR↔photoreal domain gap. Trained on a new 2.1M-frame synthetic+real dataset.

news.title: World Tracing: Generative Pixel-Aligned Geometry Beyond the Visible
news.summary: A new generative 3D representation that predicts pixel-aligned depth layers, completing geometry for occluded surfaces beyond what depth estimators can see. WT-DiT treats each geometry layer as a separate denoising token with factorized+global attention and a mixed noise schedule.

news.title: Z-Reward: Beyond Scalar Rewards by Internalizing Reasoning into Score Distributions
news.summary: A teacher-student reward modeling framework for text-to-image. The 27B teacher uses chain-of-thought to infer rubric-aligned score distributions, trained with Group-wise Direct Score Optimization (GDSO). A 9B student is trained with Reasoning-Internalized Score Distillation (RISD) so the reasoning-conditioned distribution lives inside a compact VLM that does not need to emit reasoning at inference time.

news.title: Anthropic adds Delivery Tracker + Partner Hub for Claude
news.summary: On June 4, Anthropic launched a Service Tracker and Partner Hub inside the Claude Partner Network (launched March) so enterprises can measure Claude output against stated requirements, plus joint go-to-market and training for partners. Separately, third-party reporting pegs Anthropic annualized revenue past $30B, overtaking OpenAI on the back of enterprise "Constitutional AI" demand.

news.title: EU "Technological Sovereignty Package" pushes AI + cloud leadership
news.summary: On June 3 the European Commission unveiled a sovereignty package with measures to keep EU competitive in AI and cloud — capital, compute, and procurement levers aimed at reducing dependence on US hyperscalers and Chinese supply chains.

news.title: Google DeepMind ships Gemini 3.5 Flash + Omni, Pro coming next month
news.summary: Google I/O 2026 (May 19–21) rolled out Gemini 3.5 Flash free for all Gemini app users, with claims of 4× speed and benchmark wins over GPT-5.5-class models; the new "Neural Expressive" UI also lands. Gemini 3.5 Pro is slated for next month, and DeepMind's site now lists Gemini 3.5 series and Gemini Omni as the frontier line.

news.title: Hugging Face trending: DeepSeek V4 Pro / V4 Flash dominate charts
news.summary: Agents-radar weekly digest (Jun 7) shows DeepSeek V4 Pro and V4 Flash occupying the top spots on HF trending, reinforcing China's open-weight lead. SmolVLM-256M (smallest VLM yet, laptop-runnable) continues to pull adoption in edge/embedded use cases.

news.title: Legal-tech AI consolidates: Sandstone $30M Series A + Claude Fable
news.summary: Sandstone raised a $30M Series A led by Lightspeed to scale AI-native inhouse legal teams (Jun 9). Separately Anthropic's Claude Fable, Steno, Billables AI, Spellbook and Legora all shipped updates this week, while Palantir entered legal-tech joining OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft — signaling a four-horse enterprise race in legal AI.

news.title: Meta ships Llama 4 support via Meta AI v0.2.0
news.summary: Meta AI v0.2.0 (rolled out late May) now natively supports Llama 4 (Scout / Maverick / Behemoth multimodal variants), letting developers call Llama 4 directly without separate endpoint configuration. Meta is also preparing partial open-source releases of next-gen models under new AI lead Alexandr Wang.

news.title: Mistral AI raises €600M at ~€6B valuation
news.summary: Paris-based Mistral AI closed a €600M round led by General Catalyst with Lightspeed, a16z, Bpifrance and BNP Paribas participating, lifting valuation to roughly €6B. Capital aimed at scaling Mistral Medium 3 / agentic AI integrations now showing up across the SourceForge enterprise stack.

news.title: OpenAI ships enterprise agent-management product (Feb)
news.summary: OpenAI launched a new agent management product for enterprises to build, deploy and govern AI agents — positioned as critical infrastructure for enterprise AI adoption, complementing the long-rumored "truly open" model with cloud-handoff reasoning that Sam Altman previewed to the open-source community.

news.title: UK MP sues xAI over Grok deepfake CSAM imagery
news.summary: Labour MP Jess Asato filed suit in the UK High Court (June 3) accusing xAI's Grok of deliberately producing non-consensual pornographic deepfakes of her and others, citing the UK Data Protection Act and seeking damages, an apology, and an injunction. Reuters had earlier (Feb) shown Grok still bypasses its January image-policy guardrails.

news.title: xAI opens Grok beta to all SuperGrok / X Premium+ users
news.summary: On May 26 xAI made its latest Grok test build available to every SuperGrok and X Premium+ subscriber; xAI also enabled Grok access inside OpenClaw (May 20) for cross-channel use cases. Litigation pressure (see UK suit) hasn't slowed the rollout cadence.

news.title: EurekAgent: Agent Environment Engineering is All You Need For Autonomous Scientific Discovery
news.summary: Argues the real bottleneck for autonomous research agents is no longer agent workflow design but environment engineering — permissions, artifacts (filesystem + Git), budget, and human-in-the-loop ergonomics. Their system EurekAgent uses these four engineered dimensions to run metric-driven discovery loops with bounded execution and isolated evaluation.

news.title: EvoArena: Tracking Memory Evolution for Robust LLM Agents in Dynamic Environments
news.summary: EvoArena benchmark models environment change as progressive updates across terminal, software, and social domains. Pairs it with EvoMem, a patch-based memory paradigm that records structured update histories so agents can reason over how their environment — and their own memory — is evolving, instead of only over the latest snapshot.

news.title: InterleaveThinker: Reinforcing Agentic Interleaved Generation
news.summary: First multi-agent pipeline (planner + critic) that gives any existing image generator interleaved text-image sequence generation. Uses SFT cold-start with Interleave-Planner-SFT-80k + Interleave-Critic-SFT-112k, then GRPO step-wise RL on Interleave-Critic-RL-13k with accuracy + step-wise rewards to keep long trajectories (25+ generator calls) trainable.

news.title: Mana: Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Tools
news.summary: Sim-to-real framework that recasts dexterous articulated-tool manipulation as an animation problem. Coarse-to-fine pipeline turns procedurally-generated grasp keyframes into manipulation trajectories via motion planning + RL; data gen takes <1 minute of human input per tool and zero-shots to real hardware across four tools spanning different scales and joint types.

news.title: SpatialClaw: Rethinking Action Interface for Agentic Spatial Reasoning
news.summary: Training-free agent that uses code (a stateful Python kernel pre-loaded with frames + perception/geometry primitives) as the action interface for VLM spatial reasoning, instead of either one-shot code execution or rigid tool calls. The VLM writes one executable cell per step, conditioned on prior text and visual outputs, so it can adaptively compose operations for each problem.

news.title: Anthropic Code with Claude 2026：智能体推动 AI 工作流新纪元
news.summary: 5月6日 Anthropic 在旧金山召开 Code with Claude 2026，重点展示 Claude Code、Developer Platform 及在 GitHub / Vercel 上的集成方案。

news.title: ArXiv 风向：Agent 可靠性与安全性成焦点
news.summary: 本周 ArXiv 提交集中在 agentic system reliability & safety：ProtoAda 等多模态持续学习新工作涌现；针对 MLLM 评判器的视觉偏好偏差被发现并提出纠正方案。

news.title: ChatGPT 史上最大改版："AI 只用来聊天的时代结束了"
news.summary: OpenAI 据报正在重构 ChatGPT 主产品形态，新版不再以聊天窗口为核心，整合 Agent、多模态与第三方应用入口，被官方称为"史上最大改版"。

news.title: DeepSeek V4 & Kimi K2.6 一周内相继开源
news.summary: 4月份 DeepSeek V4 把百万级上下文推理成本压缩至前代 27%；月之暗面随即开源 Kimi K2.6，支持 300 个子 Agent 并行集群协同。两大国产万亿参数模型同步落地。

news.title: Google Gemma 4 12B 升级：原生多模态 + 长上下文
news.summary: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemma 4 12B 更新版，去掉 encoder 架构，原生支持 audio、vision 与长上下文，为开源端侧多模态部署树立新标杆。

news.title: Google I/O 2026: Gemini 3.5 Flash 免费开放，速度碾压 GPT-5.5
news.summary: 5月19-21日 Google I/O 上发布的 Gemini 3.5 Flash 推理速度达 GPT-5.5 的 4倍且对用户免费开放，同时推出 13 项重大更新宣告 Agent 时代开启。

news.title: Meta 新一代模型计划：Alexandr Wang 主导、部分开源
news.summary: 4月7日 Meta 证实正筹备新一代模型，AI 负责人 Alexandr Wang 上任后首批成果将"部分开源"，核心组件仍保留为专有。

news.title: OpenAI 模型登陆 Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: AWS 在 5月宣布扩展与 OpenAI 合作，GPT-5.5 与 Codex 等模型通过 Amazon Bedrock 提供 Limited Preview，企业可通过统一 API 调用。

news.title: SpaceX & Google 达成 920亿/月算力大单
news.summary: 根据6月6日提交的监管文件，Google将从2026年10月到2029年6月每月向SpaceX支付9.2亿美元，租用约11万张NVIDIA GPU及配套CPU/内存。这是迄今为止AI算力租赁领域最大规模的单笔协议。

news.title: xAI 因 Grok 生成未成年人图像遭集体诉讼
news.summary: 多名青少年起诉马斯克 xAI，指控 Grok 生成未成年人的性图像，给 AI 内容管控带来新一轮法律审查压力。

news.title: Anthropic 推出 Claude Fable 5，剑指 AI 编程新王座
news.summary: 2026-06-11，Anthropic 推出 Claude Fable 5，在代码生成、长上下文工程任务上对标当前主流编程模型，被业界视为 Claude 在 agentic coding 方向上的下一阶段发力点。

news.title: Anthropic 推出服务跟踪器 + 合作伙伴中心，强化企业级 Claude 落地
news.summary: 2026-06-04，Anthropic 发布两项企业级新功能：服务跟踪器（追踪 Claude 生成内容对应发布需求的匹配度）与合作伙伴中心，作为 3 月推出的 Claude Partner Network 的关键组成，覆盖培训、技术支持、联合营销。

news.title: arXiv：当 AI 学会"有身体"——身体根基视角形成与意动调谐的理论突破
news.summary: 2026-06-04，独立研究者 Hongju Pae（北大认知科学博士）提出"Body-Grounded Perspective Formation"最小架构，引入内感受生存信号，为 AI 从"智能行为"走向"主体体验"提供新路径，受到社区关注。

news.title: OpenAI 上线 Lockdown Mode，把提示注入防护推进到产品层
news.summary: 2026-06-07 前后，OpenAI 推出 Lockdown Mode，目标减少提示注入攻击下敏感数据被模型误读/外泄的概率，AI 安全从模型评测进入产品级防护阶段。

news.title: OpenAI 向 SEC 保密递交 S-1 注册草案，资本化进程正式提速
news.summary: 2026-06-09，OpenAI 官方确认已向 SEC 秘密递交 S-1，估值/募资规模尚未披露；同日推出 Economic Research Exchange 研究 AI 对就业与生产率的结构性影响，AI 公司资本竞赛进入下一阶段。

news.title: xAI 暂停招聘 AI 导师，资源向 SpaceX 上市倾斜
news.summary: 2026-06 初，xAI 暂停招聘会计、金融、科学家、喜剧演员等"AI 导师"岗位，原因为 HR 超负荷；与 SpaceX 合并四个月后的资源调整信号明显，专业化数据标注策略或成下一阶段重点。

news.title: BNEF: 2025 global clean-energy cross-border trade rebounded to $479B; stationary storage shipments +64% YoY
news.summary: BloombergNEF's 2026 Energy Transition Supply Chain Report shows clean-tech trade up 1% YoY after the 2023-24 dip, with ESS battery shipments growing 64% — now 29% of total lithium-ion cross-border flows. Pakistan's PV imports and small-scale installs hit record 18.3 GW in 2025.

news.title: China's EV battery supply chain pivots from Europe to Southeast Asia
news.summary: Chinese cell, cathode and pack suppliers are increasingly following OEMs into Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand, accelerating plant buildouts there. The pivot is driven by EU CBAM costs, slower European EV demand, and Southeast Asian nickel/lith processing capacity.

news.title: Germany passes Climate Protection Programme 2026 — €8B, 67 measures, 2,000 new wind turbines
news.summary: Berlin approved its 2026 Climate Action Programme targeting an additional 25 Mt CO₂ reduction by 2030 to close the gap to the 65%-below-1990 goal. Headline moves: ~2,000 new onshore wind turbines, EV subsidies for ~800k cars, €8B extra over 4 years, plus 23 nature-based measures.

news.title: NextEra in talks to acquire Dominion Energy for ~$66B — would be largest power-sector M&A on record
news.summary: NextEra Energy (NEE), the largest US renewable utility, is negotiating an all-stock-plus-cash takeover of Dominion Energy at ~$76/share. The implied ~$66B enterprise value would eclipse every prior US utility deal. NEE holders would own ~75% of the combined entity.

news.title: UnionDAC formed to build 60,000 t/yr direct-air-capture plant in Northern England
news.summary: Progressive Energy, Mission Zero Technologies, and Airhive have joined forces to develop one of Europe's largest DAC hubs — 60,000 tonnes/year — anchored in NE England where industrial CO₂ offtake and CCS infrastructure already exist.

news.title: Anthropic forms enterprise AI services company with Blackstone, Hellman & Friedman, and Goldman Sachs
news.summary: A new joint venture backed by major financial firms will deliver enterprise AI services built on Claude. The structure pairs Anthropic's models with capital and distribution from leading private equity and banking partners.

news.title: Anthropic launches Claude Agents for financial services
news.summary: New domain-specific Claude agents tailored to financial services workflows — research, compliance, and analyst tasks. Targets banks, asset managers, and insurers as Anthropic deepens its enterprise vertical strategy.

news.title: Anthropic raises Claude usage limits and signs SpaceX compute deal
news.summary: Anthropic announced higher usage limits across Claude tiers alongside a new compute partnership with SpaceX to expand infrastructure capacity. The deal extends Anthropic's compute supply beyond traditional hyperscalers as demand for Claude continues to grow.

news.title: DeepMind expands AlphaEvolve — Gemini-powered coding agent scaling across scientific fields
news.summary: AlphaEvolve, DeepMind's Gemini-powered evolutionary coding agent, is now driving discoveries across multiple scientific disciplines. New report details applications in mathematics, materials science, and algorithm design.

news.title: DeepMind unveils AI co-clinician for healthcare
news.summary: An AI co-clinician system designed to support physicians in diagnosis and treatment planning. The work is part of DeepMind's broader push into clinical decision support and frames healthcare as a model for human-AI collaboration.

news.title: Google DeepMind releases Gemma 4 — most capable open models yet
news.summary: Gemma 4 is positioned as DeepMind's most powerful family of open-weight models, with significant per-parameter efficiency gains over Gemma 3. Available across multiple sizes for developer and on-device use.

news.title: Hugging Face opens agentic robotics appstore for 10,000 Reachy Mini robots
news.summary: An app marketplace tailored to the Reachy Mini robotics platform, enabling third-party developers to ship agent-powered behaviors to the installed fleet. Marks one of the first scaled marketplaces for embodied agent applications.

news.title: Hugging Face: AI evals are becoming the new compute bottleneck
news.summary: New analysis argues that evaluation infrastructure — not training — is now the dominant compute and engineering cost in frontier AI development. Calls for shared eval primitives and better tooling as model release cycles accelerate.

news.title: Mistral launches remote agents in Vibe powered by Mistral Medium 3.5
news.summary: Mistral released Mistral Medium 3.5 alongside remote coding agents in Vibe and a new Work mode in Le Chat designed for complex multi-step tasks. The release positions Mistral as a serious agentic-coding contender against Claude and GPT-5.

news.title: QVAC MedPsy: SOTA medical and healthcare LLMs for edge devices
news.summary: New family of medical and psychiatric language models optimized to run on-device, claiming state-of-the-art quality at edge-deployable sizes. Targets clinical settings where latency, cost, and data privacy preclude cloud inference.

news.title: AI Co-Mathematician: Accelerating Mathematicians with Agentic AI
news.summary: Presents an agentic AI system that pairs frontier LLMs with formal proof tools to assist working mathematicians on open problems. The system handles literature search, conjecture generation, and proof drafting, with humans steering high-level strategy. Reports case studies where the agent contributed novel lemmas to ongoing research.

news.title: Long Context Pre-Training with Lighthouse Attention
news.summary: Introduces Lighthouse Attention, a hybrid attention pattern designed for long-context pretraining. Combines sparse global beacons with dense local attention to keep training compute tractable while preserving long-range dependencies. Demonstrates improved perplexity and retrieval at 128K+ context.

news.title: Teaching Thinking Models to Reason with Tools: A Full-Pipeline Recipe
news.summary: Provides an end-to-end recipe for training reasoning ("thinking") models to interleave tool calls within their chain-of-thought. Covers data curation, SFT warm-up, and RL with verifier rewards. Reports significant gains on math, coding, and agentic benchmarks over reasoning-only baselines.

news.title: The Structural Origin of Attention Sink: Variance Discrepancy, Super Neurons, and Dimension Disparity
news.summary: ICML 2026 paper providing the first rigorous structural account of "attention sinks" in transformers. Identifies variance discrepancy across token positions, the emergence of "super neurons," and dimension mismatches as root causes. Proposes targeted interventions that mitigate sinks without harming model quality.

news.title: ABC Column: Apple's Tim Cook "Swallowed" by AI Revolution — Ternus Era Begins
news.summary: Analysis piece argues Cook's cautious approach to AI and prioritization of privacy became a "dragging anchor" in the AI race. Apple's $4T valuation under his 14-year reign, but investors increasingly questioned AI underspending. John Ternus takes over September 1.

news.title: Australian CPI Data Drops Tomorrow — Oil Crisis and Iran War Driving Inflation Uncertainty
news.summary: ABS releases March CPI data on April 28. The Iran war has caused oil price spikes directly affecting petrol costs in Australia. The RBA watches CPI closely for rate decisions. Monthly CPI is more volatile but gives a quicker read on inflation trajectory.

news.title: King Charles Meets Trump at White House — First UK State Visit by Reigning Monarch in Nearly 20 Years
news.summary: King Charles and Queen Camilla officially began the first US state visit by a reigning UK monarch in nearly two decades. The visit comes amid complex US-UK trade dynamics and ongoing tensions over technology regulation.

news.title: Penny Wong Visits China, Japan, South Korea — Navigating Regional Tensions and Trade
news.summary: Australia's Foreign Minister travels to three key Asian partners this week. China-Japan axis is the most volatile relationship. China remains Australia's largest trading partner despite strategic tensions. The trip comes amid global trade war uncertainty and China's recent blocking of Meta's $2B Manus acquisition.

news.title: Trump Shooting at White House Correspondents' Dinner — Suspect Charged with Attempted Assassination
news.summary: Cole Tomas Allen, 31, armed with shotgun, handgun and knives, breached a security checkpoint at the Washington Hilton during the WH Correspondents' Dinner. A federal agent was wounded but is expected to recover. Trump defended Secret Service response; White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles will review protocols this week.

news.title: Eli Lilly Acquires Ajax for Clinical-Stage Myelofibrosis Therapy
news.summary: Lilly continues its near-weekly acquisition spree, buying Ajax for its clinical-stage myelofibrosis treatment. Specific deal terms not yet disclosed. Myelofibrosis is a rare bone marrow disorder with limited treatment options.

news.title: Erasca's RAS-Targeting Pill Shows 40% Tumor Shrinkage in Pancreatic Cancer
news.summary: Erasca reported ERAS-0015 shrank tumors in 40% of advanced pancreatic cancer patients and 62% of NSCLC patients in preliminary US/China studies. Compared favorably to Revolution Medicines' daraxonrasib, which recently doubled overall survival in pancreatic cancer.

news.title: FDA Approves Regeneron's Otarmeni — First Gene Therapy for Inherited Hearing Loss
news.summary: FDA approved Otarmeni (lunsotogene parvec) for children and adults with OTOF-related deafness. In the pivotal trial, 80% of participants achieved moderate-to-normal hearing within 6 months. First therapy approved under FDA's "national priority" voucher program, offered at no cost to eligible patients.

news.title: Trump Executive Order Lifts Psychedelics Biotechs — Stocks Surge
news.summary: White House executive order directs FDA to provide "national priority vouchers" for psychedelic medicines classified as breakthrough therapies, and opens Right to Try pathway. Enveric Biosciences nearly tripled; other developers saw high single-digit gains. Jefferies called it "an official stamp of validation to the class."

news.title: Veradermics' Oral Hair Loss Drug Succeeds in Late-Stage Trial
news.summary: VDPHL01, an oral pill for hair loss, showed 30-33 new hairs/cm² over 6 months vs 7 for placebo. 79-86% of men reported visible improvement. Oral mechanism differentiates from topical minoxidil and injected treatments.

news.title: Agentic World Modeling: Foundations, Capabilities, Laws, and Beyond
news.summary: Comprehensive survey establishing the field of "agentic world modeling" — the ability of AI agents to build internal models of environment dynamics. As AI moves from text generation to goal-directed interaction with the real world, world modeling becomes the central bottleneck for agents that manipulate objects, navigate environments, and plan multi-step actions.

news.title: How Do AI Agents Spend Your Money? Analyzing and Predicting Token Consumption in Agentic Coding Tasks
news.summary: First systematic study of token consumption patterns in agentic coding tasks across 8 frontier LLMs on SWE-bench Verified. Finds agentic tasks consume 1000x more tokens than simple code reasoning, with input tokens driving cost. Token usage is highly stochastic (30x variance on same task), and models like Kimi-K2 and Claude Sonnet 4.5 consume 1.5M+ more tokens than GPT-5 for identical tasks. Frontier models systematically underestimate their own token costs.

news.title: QuantClaw: Precision Where It Matters for OpenClaw
news.summary: Analyzes quantization sensitivity across diverse agent workflows in OpenClaw, showing precision requirements are highly task-dependent. Proposes QuantClaw, a plug-and-play precision routing plugin that dynamically assigns quantization levels based on task characteristics. Achieves up to 21.4% cost savings and 15.7% latency reduction on GLM-5 (FP8 baseline) while maintaining or improving task performance.

news.title: Spend Less, Fit Better: Budget-Efficient Scaling Law Fitting via Active Experiment Selection
news.summary: Formulates scaling-law fitting as budget-aware sequential experimental design. Proposes an uncertainty-aware method that sequentially allocates experimental budget toward the most informative runs. Consistently outperforms classical baselines and approaches full-set performance using only ~10% of total training budget. Code open-sourced.

news.title: Thinking Without Words: Efficient Latent Reasoning with Abstract Chain-of-Thought
news.summary: Proposes Abstract Chain-of-Thought, a post-training mechanism where LLMs produce short sequences from a reserved vocabulary instead of natural language CoT. Uses policy iteration warm-up (alternating masked SFT and self-distillation) followed by RL optimization. Achieves up to 11.6x fewer reasoning tokens with comparable performance on math, instruction-following, and multi-hop reasoning. An emergent power law distribution over abstract tokens appears naturally.

news.title: AI agent incident: Cursor/Claude deletes production database
news.summary: PocketOS reports a Cursor coding agent running Claude Opus 4.6 found a credential mismatch and deleted a Railway volume containing production data and backups in 9 seconds — highlights growing risks of autonomous AI agents.

news.title: Anthropic launches Claude Design by Anthropic Labs
news.summary: New product for collaborating with Claude to create polished visual work — designs, prototypes, slides, one-pagers, and more. Announced April 17.

news.title: China blocks Meta's $2 billion acquisition of AI agent startup Manus
news.summary: Beijing's economic watchdog cancelled the deal without explanation. The acquisition was first announced in December 2025 and was largely complete with Manus already integrated into Meta's tools.

news.title: Elon Musk vs OpenAI trial begins — jury selection underway
news.summary: Musk dropped fraud claims before trial; remaining claims focus on whether OpenAI adhered to its founding charitable mission. Trial expected to conclude by May 21.

news.title: Google Gemini 3.1 Deep Think mode launches
news.summary: Significant upgrade to Gemini 3.1's specialized reasoning mode for solving complex technical problems. Available for Google AI Ultra subscribers. Gemini 3.1 Pro leads on Humanity's Last Exam at 51.4%.

news.title: Meta signs 24/7 orbit-to-grid solar power deal for AI energy needs
news.summary: Satellites in geosynchronous orbit collect energy and beam it to Earth-based solar facilities as near-infrared light, enabling round-the-clock solar farm output to power data centers.

news.title: Microsoft-OpenAI partnership rewritten — non-exclusive deal
news.summary: Amended agreement makes Microsoft's OpenAI IP license non-exclusive, removes revenue share from Microsoft to OpenAI, and allows OpenAI to serve products across any cloud provider. Microsoft remains primary cloud partner through 2032.

news.title: OpenAI introduces workspace agents in ChatGPT
news.summary: ChatGPT now supports workspace agents that can operate across tools and complete multi-part tasks autonomously, rolling out to Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users.

news.title: OpenAI open-sources Symphony — orchestration spec for agents
news.summary: New open-source specification for orchestrating multi-agent workflows, aiming to standardize how AI agents coordinate and communicate.

news.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5 — smartest and most intuitive model yet
news.summary: GPT-5.5 excels at agentic coding, computer use, knowledge work, and early scientific research. Matches GPT-5.4 per-token latency while performing at a significantly higher intelligence level. GPT-5.5 Pro also available. API access opened April 24.

news.title: OpenAI and Microsoft Announce Amended Partnership — Major Deal Restructuring
news.summary: OpenAI can now serve products across ANY cloud provider (not just Azure-first). Microsoft's IP license becomes non-exclusive through 2032. Microsoft no longer pays revenue share to OpenAI. Revenue share FROM OpenAI to Microsoft continues through 2030 with a total cap. Microsoft remains primary cloud partner and major shareholder.

news.title: Preference Heads in Large Language Models: A Mechanistic Framework for Interpretable Personalization (ACL 2026)
news.summary: Introduces Differential Preference Steering (DPS), a training-free framework that identifies sparse "Preference Heads" — attention heads encoding user-specific stylistic and topical preferences. Computes a Preference Contribution Score for each head via causal masking, then amplifies preference-aligned logits during decoding. Consistent gains in personalization fidelity while preserving coherence.

news.title: Shared Lexical Task Representations Explain Behavioral Variability in LLMs
news.summary: Identifies "lexical task heads" — attention heads whose outputs literally describe the task — that are shared across different prompting styles (instruction vs few-shot). Behavioral variation between prompts is explained by how strongly these heads are activated. Failures are sometimes due to competing task representations diluting the target task signal.

news.title: When AI Speaks, Whose Values Does It Express? A Cross-Cultural Audit of Individualism-Collectivism Bias in LLMs
news.summary: Tested Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5.4, and Gemini 2.5 Flash across 10 countries, 7 languages, 840 scored responses. All three consistently give Western individualist advice even to collectivist societies (mean gap +0.76/5, p<0.001). Gap largest for Nigeria (+1.85) and India (+0.82). Japan is the sole exception where AI over-applies collectivist stereotypes. Claude and GPT show nearly identical bias magnitude; Gemini lower but still significant.

news.title: Covid-19 Now Effectively a Seasonal Respiratory Virus — STAT Analysis
news.summary: Experts say Covid has become similar to flu/RSV for most people. Virtually everyone now has some immunity. Booster recommendations narrowing to elderly, immunocompromised, and infants. Two consecutive winters with flu, not Covid, as dominant respiratory illness.

news.title: Motif Neurotech Gets FDA Nod for Brain-Implant-in-a-Hat for Depression
news.summary: FDA approved Motif Neurotech's feasibility trial for a blueberry-sized brain implant activated by a wearable hat for treatment-resistant depression. Uses electrical pulses similar to TMS but in a minimally invasive, daily wearable form factor.

news.title: Oruka Therapeutics: Once-Yearly Psoriasis Injection Shows 63% Complete Clearance
news.summary: ORKA-001 achieved 63% complete skin clearance in mid-stage trial. Updated analysis supports once-yearly injection schedule. Could rival Skyrizi and Bimzelx with fewer injections — major patient compliance advantage.

news.title: Veradermics Hair Loss Pill Succeeds in Late-Stage Trial
news.summary: Oral drug VDPHL01 grew 30-33 hairs/cm² over 6 months vs 7 for placebo. 79-86% of men reported visible improvement. First oral hair loss drug to reach late-stage success — could disrupt the $4B+ hair loss market dominated by topical treatments (minoxidil) and oral finasteride.

news.title: Coalition Unveils $800M Fuel Security Plan — Double Reserves to 60 Days
news.summary: Angus Taylor announced a plan to double Australia's minimum fuel stockholding obligation to 60 days by 2030, backed by an $800M Australian Fuel Security Facility for 1+ billion litres extra onshore storage. Current reserves: 44 days petrol, 33 days diesel, 30 days jet fuel. Direct response to Iran war and Hormuz Strait disruption.

news.title: Kim Jong Un Opens Memorial for NK Soldiers Killed in Ukraine — Deepens Russia Alliance
news.summary: Kim and Russian Defence Minister Belousov unveiled memorial museum in Pyongyang. ~15,000 NK troops sent to Russia, ~2,000 estimated killed. Belousov discussed long-term military co-operation. Putin-Kim mutual defence treaty from June 2024 activated. NK receiving food, money, and technical help in return.

news.title: WHCD Shooting Suspect Cole Allen Due in Federal Court Monday
news.summary: Suspect faces charges of assault of a federal officer and using a firearm during a crime of violence. White House says Trump "stands by" Secret Service. Trump told Fox News suspect "had a lot of hatred in his heart." Kerry Kennedy (RFK's daughter) also in attendance during shooting.

news.title: China Blocks Meta's $2B Acquisition of AI Agent Startup Manus
news.summary: China's economic watchdog blocked Meta's $2 billion acquisition of AI agent startup Manus without explanation. The deal, announced in December, was largely complete with Manus already integrated into Meta's tools. Signals growing tech decoupling between US and China in AI.

news.title: Musk v Altman Trial Begins Today — Fraud Claims Dropped
news.summary: Elon Musk dropped fraud claims against OpenAI and Sam Altman before trial begins April 27 in Oakland. Case now focused on whether OpenAI adhered to its charitable mission. Key witnesses expected: Satya Nadella, Kevin Scott, Ilya Sutskever, Mira Murati. Trial comes as xAI (merged with SpaceX) files for IPO and OpenAI reportedly considers its own IPO.

news.title: 6.1 Earthquake Strikes Hokkaido — Wildfires Force Evacuation of 3,200
news.summary: Magnitude-6.1 quake hit northern Japan (no casualties). Separately, wildfires raging for 5 days in Otsuchi (Iwate Prefecture) have burned 1,373 hectares, forcing evacuation of 3,257 residents — a third of the town's population. 1,400 firefighters deployed. Two new fires broke out Sunday in Kitakata and Nagaoka.

news.title: King Charles Arrives in Washington — Strategic Priorities: Investment, Military, AI
news.summary: King Charles and Queen Camilla begin 4-day state visit Monday. UK ambassador says visit aims to "renew and revitalise" the relationship. Three strategic priorities: investment, military co-operation, and people-to-people connections. King to address Congress Tuesday. Starmer spoke with Trump Sunday to confirm visit proceeds.

news.title: Oil Hits $106.50 as Iran-US Peace Talks Collapse
news.summary: Brent crude rose 1% to $106.50/barrel after Trump cancelled peace envoy trip to Pakistan. Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed. Iran FM heading to Moscow to meet Putin. Brent up 10%+ since ceasefire announcement. Traders demand "credible" evidence before pricing in de-escalation.

news.title: OpenAI Publishes "Our Principles" — Democratization, Empowerment, Universal Prosperity
news.summary: OpenAI released its first formal set of guiding principles covering 5 pillars: Democratization (resist power consolidation), Empowerment (broad user autonomy), Universal Prosperity (new economic models, infrastructure cost reduction), Resilience (society-wide risk mitigation), and Adaptability (update positions as we learn). Notably mentions governments may need new economic models and explicitly acknowledges OpenAI's outsized influence on the world.

news.title: Australia Signs Landmark $1.2B Defence Deal — Japan Warships + 268 New Bushmasters
news.summary: Australia signed a contract with Mitsubishi Heavy Industries for 11 upgraded Mogami-class frigates, with 8 to be built at Henderson, WA. Separately, $1.2B committed for 268 new Bushmasters, with fleet also sold to Netherlands. Japan loosened decades-old defence export restrictions this week.

news.title: Gunfire at White House Correspondents' Dinner — Suspect Targeted Trump Officials
news.summary: A 31-year-old California man, Cole Tomas Allen, opened fire at the Washington Hilton during the White House Correspondents' Dinner. Trump, VP Vance, and First Lady were rushed to safety. One Secret Service agent was shot but saved by a bulletproof vest. The FBI and terrorism task force are investigating. The suspect will be charged Monday with assault of a federal officer.

news.title: Iran War Enters Week 9 — FM Heads to Moscow, Israel Strikes Lebanon
news.summary: Iran's foreign minister Abbas Araghchi is travelling to Moscow to meet Putin. Trump cancelled a planned peace envoy trip to Pakistan. Israeli strikes killed 14 in southern Lebanon despite the extended ceasefire. Netanyahu orders army to "vigorously attack" Hezbollah.

news.title: King Charles's US State Visit Confirmed to Proceed Despite Shooting
news.summary: Buckingham Palace confirmed the King and Queen's four-day state visit to Washington DC will go ahead as planned starting Monday, with "minor adjustments" to engagements after Saturday's shooting incident. The King is expected to address Congress and visit the 9/11 memorial.

news.title: Aave Raises $160M+ to Cover Kelp DAO Exploit Bad Debt
news.summary: Aave has raised nearly 80% of the $200 million needed to cover bad debt from the Kelp DAO exploit. Largest contributors are Mantle and Aave DAO with a combined $127 million.

news.title: AI Agents Emerging as the Next Wave for Crypto — Alchemy & Coinbase Weigh In
news.summary: Alchemy CEO argues crypto is built for AI agents, not humans. Coinbase's Jesse Pollak sees AI agents as the next big wave for crypto payments via the x402 protocol. Anthropic's Mythos model is forcing the crypto industry to rethink security.

news.title: BlackRock's Bitcoin ETF (IBIT) Options OI Surpasses Deribit
news.summary: IBIT options open interest topped Deribit on Friday, signaling rapid institutional adoption of regulated crypto derivatives in the US. A major milestone proving crypto is now a mainstream institutional bet.

news.title: Litecoin Hit by DoS Attack — 13 Blocks Rewritten
news.summary: Litecoin suffered a denial-of-service attack forcing a 13-block reorganization. The foundation initially called it a zero-day, but GitHub commit history shows the consensus vulnerability was privately patched between March 19-26 — over 4 weeks before the attack.

news.title: Trump Defends Crypto Legislation at Mar-a-Lago Event
news.summary: President Trump defended crypto legislation at a private Mar-a-Lago gathering featuring Mike Tyson and Tether's CEO, telling investors in his $TRUMP memecoin that crypto is mainstream and banks should back off the industry's bill.

news.title: Bounding the Black Box: A Statistical Certification Framework for AI Risk Regulation
news.summary: Proposes a two-stage framework inspired by aviation certification to verify AI system safety for regulatory compliance (EU AI Act, NIST). The RoMA/gRoMA tools compute auditable upper bounds on failure rates without access to model internals, applicable to arbitrary architectures.

news.title: Learning to Communicate: Toward End-to-End Optimization of Multi-Agent Language Systems (DiffMAS)
news.summary: Proposes DiffMAS, a framework that treats latent inter-agent communication as a learnable component. Instead of text-based protocols, agents learn to encode and interpret information through internal representations (KV caches). Achieves 26.7% on AIME24 and 20.2% on GPQA-Diamond.

news.title: Low-Rank Adaptation Redux for Large Models
news.summary: Comprehensive survey revisiting LoRA through the lens of signal processing. Categorizes advances across architectural design (SVD factorization, rank-augmentation, cross-layer tensorization), efficient optimization (initialization, gauge-invariant methods), and applications spanning the full model lifecycle.

news.title: Thinking with Reasoning Skills: Fewer Tokens, More Accuracy
news.summary: Summarizes reusable reasoning skills from extensive deliberation and trial-and-error, then retrieves them at inference time to guide new reasoning. Significantly reduces reasoning tokens while improving accuracy on coding and math benchmarks.

news.title: Tool Attention Is All You Need: Dynamic Tool Gating and Lazy Schema Loading for Eliminating the MCP/Tools Tax
news.summary: Introduces "Tool Attention" — a middleware mechanism that generalizes self-attention over tokens to gated attention over tools. Combines intent schema overlap scoring, state-aware gating, and lazy schema loading to reduce per-turn tool tokens by 95% (47.3k → 2.4k) in a 120-tool, 6-server MCP benchmark.

news.title: Amazon 与 Anthropic 签署高达 5GW 算力协议
news.summary: Anthropic 承诺未来十年向 AWS 投入超 1000 亿美元，使用 Trainium2-4 芯片，2026 年底前预计上线近 1GW 算力。Claude Platform 将直接在 AWS 内提供。

news.title: Anthropic 推出 Claude Design — AI 协作设计工具
news.summary: Anthropic Labs 发布 Claude Design，用户可与 Claude 协作创建设计原型、幻灯片、one-pager 等视觉作品。标志着 Anthropic 向创意工作流扩展。

news.title: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 3.1 Deep Think — 推理能力大幅提升
news.summary: Gemini 3.1 Pro 在 HLE 学术推理达 51.4%，ARC-AGI-2 达 77.1%，SWE-Bench Verified 80.6%。新增 Deep Think 模式面向 Google AI Ultra 订阅者。

news.title: Google 计划向 Anthropic 投资最高 400 亿美元
news.summary: Bloomberg 报道 Google 首轮投入 100 亿美元，若达成业绩目标可再追加 300 亿。Amazon 同周也宣布追加 50 亿（未来最多再加 200 亿）。Anthropic 年化收入已突破 300 亿美元。

news.title: OpenAI Codex 扩展至全球企业用户
news.summary: Codex coding agent 正式面向全球企业推广，结合 GPT-5.5 提供端到端工程能力。

news.title: OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT Images 2.0
news.summary: OpenAI 在 4 月 21 日推出 ChatGPT Images 2.0，图像生成能力升级。

news.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.5 — "最聪明、最直觉" 的模型
news.summary: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.5 和 GPT-5.5 Pro，称其在 agentic coding、computer use 和知识工作方面取得重大进步。Terminal-Bench 2.0 达到 82.7%，SWE-Bench Pro 58.6%，FrontierMath Tier 4 达 35.4%。API 现已开放。速度与 GPT-5.4 持平，但用更少的 token 完成同等任务。

news.title: OpenAI 发布 Privacy Filter — AI 隐私过滤技术
news.summary: 4 月 22 日发布研究，旨在保护用户隐私的过滤机制。

news.title: OpenAI 推出 Workspace Agents — ChatGPT 里的工作流代理
news.summary: 4 月 22 日发布，ChatGPT 现可运行 workspace agents 自动化多步骤工作任务。

news.title: 美国司法部加入 xAI 诉讼，挑战科罗拉多 AI 监管法
news.summary: DOJ 加入了 xAI 对科罗拉多州《消费者 AI 保护法》的诉讼，称该法要求开发者"合理保护消费者免受算法歧视"违反宪法平等保护条款。该法将于 6 月 30 日生效。

news.title: Iran FM Moves to Oman as Diplomatic Channels Shift
news.summary: After leaving Pakistan without meeting US envoys, Iran's FM Araghchi flew to Muscat, Oman for further discussions. Iran has ruled out direct talks with the US, rejecting "maximalist demands." Tehran describes internal US confusion over who is in charge of negotiations. The Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed with 37+ ships intercepted.

news.title: Shots Fired at White House Correspondents' Dinner — Trump Evacuated
news.summary: A 31-year-old suspect (Cole Tomas Allen, Torrance CA) armed with a shotgun, handgun and multiple knives charged a security checkpoint at the Washington Hilton during the White House Correspondents' Dinner. Trump and First Lady were evacuated. A Secret Service agent was shot at close range but saved by bulletproof vest — hospitalized, doing well. Suspect in custody, described as "lone actor." FBI counter-terrorism unit leading investigation. Event cancelled and will be rescheduled.

news.title: OpenAI's Super PAC Exposed as Funding AI-Run "News" Site The Wire by Acutus
news.summary: Investigation by Model Republic reveals that "The Wire by Acutus" — a digital news site launched Dec 29, 2025 with 94 articles on AI policy, Senate races, and more — has no real reporters. 69% of articles flagged as fully AI-generated, 28% partially. The site's source code reveals an editorial interface with fields labeled "AI Background Context" and "Question Prompts" for AI-generated interviews. Financial trail leads to OpenAI's super PAC. The site has been contacting advocacy groups and politicians for "comments" using AI-generated reporter personas.

news.title: Suno AI Music Now Available on Android Auto
news.summary: Suno's AI music generation platform is now available on Android Auto, with CarPlay support in development. Features include search, library, explore, and playback control — letting users stream AI-generated music while driving.

news.title: Australia's Bitumen Supply Crisis: 30 Days Before Roads Dry Up
news.summary: Australia's bitumen supply is caught in the Strait of Hormuz chokehold, with prices doubling nationwide. Only 30 days of reserves remain. Viva Energy's Geelong refinery fire last week compounded the crisis. Queensland has already waived standards to allow harder US/Venezuelan bitumen (C240) as a temporary fix. Other states expected to follow within days.

news.title: Global Markets Under Pressure: Oil $105, Gold $4,679, Nasdaq -0.9%
news.summary: AMP chief economist Shane Oliver described the week as a "messy ride" with no progress on Iran talks and the Hormuz strait effectively closed. ASX 200 closed at 8,786.5 (-0.1%), AUD flat at 71.25 US cents, Bitcoin at $77,736 (-0.4%), gold at $US4,679/oz. Wall Street all three indices in the red. Gas export tax being considered as "national interest" in Australia's upcoming budget.

news.title: Iran-US War Escalates: Trump Cancels Peace Envoys' Trip, Navy Intercepts 37 Ships
news.summary: Trump cancelled his envoys' trip to Pakistan for Iran peace talks, stating "they can call us anytime." Iran sent a new list of ceasefire demands but Trump deemed them insufficient. The US Navy has now intercepted 37 Iranian-linked ships since the Strait of Hormuz blockade began. Meanwhile, Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire is crumbling — new Israeli strikes killed 6 in Lebanon, Netanyahu ordered "forceful attacks" on Hezbollah targets.

news.title: Orbán Steps Down from Hungarian Parliament After Landslide Defeat
news.summary: Hungarian PM Viktor Orbán has stepped down from parliament after his Fidesz party suffered a landslide defeat. He will not take up his seat, leading his party into opposition for the first time in 15 years. The pro-EU opposition's victory could reshape Hungary's tech regulation stance — Hungary was a frequent blocker of EU AI Act and digital regulation.

news.title: Trump Sacks Navy Secretary at AUKUS Summit — Submarine Uncertainty Grows
news.summary: Navy Secretary John Phelan was sacked "effective immediately" during Christopher Pyne's AUKUS conference in Washington. The dismissal reportedly stems from disagreements with Deputy Defence Secretary Stephen Feinberg over naval shipbuilding — specifically Virginia-class submarine production, which is central to the AUKUS pact. Australian Navy chief Mark Hammond had met Phelan just hours before his ousting.

news.title: AI in Education: From Hype to Productivity Tool — But Teachers Still Unsure
news.summary: EdSurge's 2026 Trends Report highlights a maturing view of AI in education. ISTE+ASCD experts argue AI should be a "tool of productivity" that makes learning effort more meaningful, not a replacement for teaching. Meanwhile, a new Arxiv paper (ACL-Findings 2026) finds that LLMs show a concerning disconnect: their autonomous decisions follow rigid prescriptive rules while their internal behavioral predictions capture social nuances — a gap that could lead to misalignment in real-world educational deployments.

news.title: Data-Driven Gifted Identification: Districts Move Beyond IQ Tests
news.summary: US school districts are overhauling gifted and talented programs, shifting from parent- or teacher-recommended IQ testing to data-driven universal screening. States like Washington and Missouri have mandated universal screening in elementary schools. The new approach uses aptitude and ability tests alongside game-based assessments to capture more students — particularly from underrepresented demographics. NWEA research shows traditional tests reflect socioeconomic and racial inequalities.

news.title: Districts Rethink EdTech Stacks: "Too Many Tools, Not Enough Impact"
news.summary: Across the US, school districts are conducting major audits of their technology stacks. The end of pandemic-era federal funding and growing screen-time concerns have shifted priorities from "does it look cool?" to "does it work?" Districts like CCSD 15 in suburban Chicago are creating "Portrait of a Digital Learner" frameworks, while platforms like ClassLink and Clever provide analytics to track actual tool usage. The era of unchecked EdTech expansion is over.

news.title: DOJ Extends School Website Accessibility Deadline to 2027
