news.summary: Nvidia launched NemoClaw, an agentic AI platform that adds privacy and security protections to autonomous AI platform OpenClaw. NemoClaw uses Nvidia Agent Toolkit software to optimize OpenClaw in a single command, running it in an "isolated sandbox" environment that enforces policy-based security, network and privacy guardrails.

news.title: Nvidia Partners on Vera Rubin Space 1 to Launch AI Data Centers in Space
news.summary: Nvidia is working with partners on a new computer called Vera Rubin Space 1 that's going to go out to space and start data centers out in space. This represents a bold move to expand AI infrastructure beyond Earth's limitations.

news.title: Yahoo Escapes Its Verizon Death Spiral and Becomes Profitable Again
news.summary: How Yahoo escaped its Verizon death spiral and became profitable again, marking a major turnaround for tech company. This demonstrates successful business recovery strategy after years of decline under Verizon ownership.

news.title: AI Tool Predicts Over 1,000 Diseases Using Clinical Records and Health Data
news.summary: Computer models are showing potential to draw upon a person's clinical records and current health data to forecast diseases and treatment outcomes. Nature questions if this could presage a new era of preventive medicine.

news.title: Beyond Monogenic Disorders: Clinical Practice Lags Behind Rapid Advances
news.summary: Understanding of genetic mechanisms underlying rare diseases has advanced rapidly over past decade, yet clinical practice still has strong monogenic focus, leaving many individuals undiagnosed. Questions: How should technological advances like long-read sequencing be adopted to increase multivariant testing in the clinic?

news.title: CytomX Surges on Positive Data for 'Masked' ADC in Colorectal Cancer
news.summary: CytomX shares skyrocketed nearly 50% on results that handily beat Wall Street expectations for its 'masked' antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) targeting folate receptor alpha in colorectal cancer.

news.title: Microalgae as Cellular Factories for Molecular Crystals
news.summary: Research shows dinoflagellates accumulate and crystallize nitrogen-rich molecules from aqueous solutions and use these crystals for growth. This behavior might have implications for understanding marine nitrogen cycling. Crystallization behavior can be manipulated to biosynthesize difficult-to-crystallize reflective materials with tailored morphologies and optical properties.

news.title: Structure's GLP-1 Pill Shows 'Best-in-Class' Potential in Obesity Trial
news.summary: Testing revealed weight loss effects some Wall Street analysts believe compare favorably to Lilly's orforglipron, which regulators could approve within weeks. Structure's aleniglipron could disrupt highly competitive obesity drug market.

news.title: The Persistent Barrier to Biotechnology in the Global South
news.summary: The persistent challenge of importing biological research materials to Global South at reasonable cost, within acceptable timeframes, and with manageable regulatory complexity stalls progress before research and innovation can even begin.

news.title: Nvidia Launches NemoClaw, a More Secure Version of OpenClaw
news.summary: Nvidia announced NemoClaw, an agentic AI platform that adds privacy and security protections to the autonomous AI platform OpenClaw. NemoClaw uses Nvidia Agent Toolkit software to optimize OpenClaw in a single command, running it in an "isolated sandbox" environment that enforces policy-based security, network and privacy guardrails.

news.title: Efficient LLM Agent Tool Planning via Dual-Feedback Monte Carlo Tree Search and Bidirectional Pruning
news.summary: Presents ToolTree, a novel Monte Carlo tree search-inspired planning paradigm for tool planning. Uses dual-stage LLM evaluation and bidirectional pruning mechanism enabling agents to make informed, adaptive decisions over extended tool-use sequences while pruning less promising branches.

news.title: Learnability and Privacy Vulnerability are Entangled in a Few Critical Weights
news.summary: Observes privacy vulnerability exists in very small fraction of weights, but most of those also critically impact utility performance. Instead of discarding neurons, the proposed mechanism "rewinds" only critical weights for fine-tuning.

news.title: Neuron-Aware Data Selection in Instruction Tuning For Large Language Models
news.summary: NAIT evaluates impact of instruction tuning data on LLM performance by analyzing similarity of neuron activation patterns between IT dataset and target domain capabilities. Constructs reusable neuron activation features from in-domain datasets and selects optimal samples based on similarity to expected activation features.

news.title: Semantic Invariance in Agentic AI
news.summary: Metamorphic testing framework systematically assesses LLM reasoning agent robustness across eight semantic-preserving transformations. Evaluates seven foundation models spanning four architectural families including Hermes, Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1, and GPT-OSS.

news.title: Grammarly AI Agent Impersonation Exposed: Writers Can Opt Out
news.summary: Bluesky user coined term "sloppelganger" for Grammarly's AI agent masquerading as Verge staff members. Superhuman now says writers can email to opt out of "expert review" feature.

news.title: Nvidia Becomes First $5 Trillion Company as AI Dominates Markets
news.summary: The world's first $5 trillion company (currently 4.47 trillion) is strutting its stuff in San Jose for GTC 2026. Expecting major AI and robot announcements, with potential N1 consumer laptop chip reveals.

news.title: Yahoo Escapes Verizon Death Spiral and Becomes Profitable Again
news.summary: How Yahoo escaped its Verizon death spiral and became profitable again, marking a major turnaround for the tech company after years of decline.

news.title: Backlash to Growing AI Use Sparks 'AI-Free' Logo Trend
news.summary: The backlash to growing AI adoption has led to an explosion in attempts to create 'AI-Free' logos and branding that companies could use globally, highlighting public resistance to AI automation.

news.title: India Hopeful Iran Talks Will Ease Hormuz Route for Its Ships
news.summary: Indian Foreign Minister tells FT there was no 'blanket arrangement' for Indian ships to pass through the strategic strait, as Iran war continues to threaten commercial shipping.

news.title: Lilly Warns GLP-1 Knockoffs May Be 'Dangerous,' Escalating War with Compounders

news.title: Adobe CEO Shantanu Narayen Stepping Down After 18 Years

news.title: Buzzfeed Posts $57.3M Loss After Embracing AI, CEO Plans New AI Apps
news.summary: Three years after Buzzfeed embraced AI using it to generate articles and quiz responses, the company posted a loss of $57.3 million in 2025 and stock dropped to just $0.70. CEO Jonah Peretti still plans to bring "new AI apps" to market.

news.title: Lawsuit Accuses OpenAI of Outputting Near-Identical Copies of Britannica Content

news.title: Moltbook Updates AI Agent Terms: Users Must Be 13+ and "Solely Responsible"
news.summary: Platform updated terms of service requiring users to be 13 years or older and are "solely responsible" for actions taken by their AI agents, whether acting autonomously or otherwise.

news.title: Palantir's Maven Smart System Raises Ethical Concerns
news.summary: Palantir demonstrated Maven Smart System at AIPCon, an AI-powered Kanban board for military targeting. The system allows "anyone or anything to be targeted for a military strike with a 'Left click, right click, left click'" workflow.

news.title: Benchmarking Long-Context ESG Reports for Hallucination Mitigation
news.summary: ESG-Bench is a benchmark dataset for ESG report understanding and hallucination mitigation in LLMs, containing human-annotated QA pairs grounded in real-world ESG report contexts. The paper designs task-specific Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting strategies and fine-tunes multiple SOTA LLMs using CoT-annotated rationales.

news.title: Physically-Plausible Humanoid Motion with Preference Optimization
news.summary: PhysMoDPO uses Direct Preference Optimization to make text-conditioned human motion generation more physically plausible. Unlike prior work that relies on hand-crafted physics-aware heuristics, this framework integrates Whole-Body Controller into training and optimizes diffusion models so outputs are compliant with both physics and original text instructions.

news.title: Amazon Alexa Plus Adds "Sassy" Personality

news.title: IBM Granite 4.0 1B Speech Released

news.title: LeRobot v0.5.0 Released with Scale Improvements

news.title: Palantir's Maven Smart System Demo Controversy
news.summary: Palantir demonstrated Maven Smart System at AIPCon, an AI-powered Kanban board for military targeting. The system allows "anyone or anything to be targeted for a military strike with a 'Left click, right click, left click'" workflow, raising ethical concerns.

news.summary: Hugging Face introduced Ulysses Sequence Parallelism, enabling training with million-token contexts. The technique significantly expands the context window capabilities for large language models.

news.title: Benchmarking Scientific Multimodal Document Reasoning
news.summary: Introduces SciMDR, a 300K QA dataset for training scientific multimodal comprehension, and SciMDR-Eval for evaluation. The synthesize-and-reground framework balances scale, faithfulness, and realism in scientific document reasoning tasks.

news.title: Defending Hybrid Large Language Models Against Hidden State Poisoning Attacks
news.summary: CLASP model defends against HiSPAs (Hidden State Poisoning Attacks) on SSM-based LLMs using XGBoost classification on block output embeddings. Achieves 95.9% token-level F1 on 2,483 résumés with malicious injections.

news.title: Separable neural architectures as a primitive for unified predictive and generative intelligence
news.summary: SNAs formalize additive, quadratic, and tensor-decomposed neural models with constrained interaction order and tensor rank. Enables distributional modelling of chaotic systems while avoiding nonphysical drift.

news.title: Sparking Scientific Creativity via LLM-Driven Interdisciplinary Inspiration
news.summary: Idea-Catalyst framework systematically identifies interdisciplinary insights to support creative reasoning. Decomposes research goals into domain-specific challenges, retrieves analogous solutions from external disciplines, and ranks them by potential impact.

news.title: The Latent Color Subspace: Emergent Order in High-Dimensional Chaos
news.summary: Discovers a structured representation of color (Hue, Saturation, Lightness) in FLUX.1's VAE latent space. Enables training-free color control through closed-form latent space manipulation.

news.summary: This study investigates reasoning LLMs-as-judges in reinforcement learning-based LLM alignment. Research finds that non-reasoning judges lead to reward hacking easily, while reasoning judges can train policies that achieve strong performance by generating adversarial outputs that deceive other LLM-judges.

news.title: Separable Neural Architectures as a Primitive for Unified Predictive and Generative Intelligence
news.summary: Separable Neural Architecture (SNA) formalizes a representational class unifying additive, quadratic, and tensor-decomposed neural models. By constraining interaction order and tensor rank, SNAs factorize high-dimensional mappings into low-arity components.

news.title: The Latent Color Subspace: Emergent Order in High-Dimensional Chaos
news.summary: Develops interpretation of color representation in FLUX.1's VAE latent space, revealing a structure reflecting Hue, Saturation, and Lightness. Introduces fully training-free method in FLUX based solely on closed-form latent-space manipulation.

news.title: EnTransformer: Deep Generative Transformer for Multivariate Probabilistic Forecasting
news.summary: Most probabilistic forecasting approaches rely on restrictive parametric likelihoods and struggle with complex joint predictive distributions. EnTransformer integrates regression and stochastic learning paradigms to model conditional distributions without parametric assumptions.

news.title: Fair-PaperRec: Multi-Layer Perceptron for Bias Mitigation and Quality Optimization in Paper Recommendation
news.summary: Despite frequent double-blind review, demographic biases still disadvantage underrepresented groups in post-review paper acceptance decisions. Fair-PaperRec penalizes demographic disparities while preserving quality through intersectional criteria.

news.title: SLIP: Learning Transferable Sensor Models via Language-Informed Pretraining
news.summary: Open-source framework for learning language-aligned representations that generalize across diverse sensor setups. SLIP integrates contrastive alignment with sensor-conditioned captioning, enabling zero-shot transfer without additional training.

news.title: Compiling Temporal Numeric Planning into Discrete PDDL+: Extended Version
news.summary: Presents a practical compilation method for temporal numeric planning with durative actions into PDDL+. Provides actual compilation methods and semantic capture, only assuming non-self-overlapping actions. The compilation is polynomial and keeps plan length up to a constant factor.

news.title: Examining Reasoning LLMs-as-Judges in Non-Verifiable LLM Post-Training
news.summary: Investigates whether reasoning judges can benefit from inference-time scaling in non-verifiable LLM post-training. Finds that non-reasoning judges can easily be reward hacked, while reasoning judges trained with RL-based alignment may lead to policy risks that achieve strong performance when evaluated by gold-standard judges.

news.title: Portfolio of Solving Strategies in CEGAR-based Object Packing and Scheduling for Sequential 3D Printing
news.summary: Proposes Portfolio-CEGAR-SEQ algorithm for object arrangement and scheduling in sequential 3D printing. Achieves this by parallelizing existing CEGAR-SEQ algorithm. Experimental evaluation shows Portfolio-CEGAR-SEQ outperforms original CEGAR-SEQ, often using fewer printing plates when scheduling batches for multiple printing plates.

news.title: Qantas Agrees to Pay $74M Over COVID-19 Travel Voucher Refunds
news.summary: The case relates to cancelled flights during the pandemic, for which customers were given credits instead of cash. This settlement provides closure for customers affected by COVID-related disruptions to Qantas services.

news.title: US Military Rescue Efforts Face Challenges in Iraq
news.summary: American military says rescue operations faced difficulties after a refueling plane crashed in Iraq. Meanwhile, Israel continues strikes against Iran and Lebanon. This ongoing regional conflict continues to impact security and infrastructure in the Middle East.

news.title: Young Party Wins Massive Mandate in Nepal Election
news.summary: Rastriya Swatantra Party has won a large majority in a Nepal election dominated by issues including corruption. This political shift may influence policy decisions affecting technology sector and international cooperation.

news.title: Cross-Species Transfer Learning for Electrophysiology-to-Transcriptomics Mapping in Cortical GABAergic Interneurons
news.summary: Replicates and extends the electrophysiology-to-transcriptomics framework using Patch-seq datasets from both mouse and human cortex. Focuses on GABAergic inhibitory interneurons with comparable subclass structure across species. Demonstrates that mouse-to-human transfer learning provides measurable gains for human subclass prediction using attention-based BiLSTM operating on IPFX feature-family representation.

news.title: Factorized Neural Implicit DMD for Parametric Dynamics
news.summary: Proposes a physics-coded neural field parameterization of Koopman operator's spectral decomposition for data-driven, model-free modeling of temporal evolution. Uses factorized flow operator that decouples spatial modes and temporal evolution, exposing underlying eigenvalues, modes, and stability for stable long-term rollouts and spectral analysis.

news.title: Protein Counterfactuals via Diffusion-Guided Latent Optimization
news.summary: Introduces MCCOP (Manifold-Constrained Counterfactual Optimization for Proteins), a framework computing minimal, biologically plausible sequence edits that flip model's prediction to desired target state. Balances validity, proximity, and plausibility objectives using pretrained diffusion model as manifold prior. Successfully evaluated on GFP fluorescence rescue, thermodynamic stability enhancement, and E3 ligase activity recovery tasks.

news.title: Big Tech Backs Anthropic in Fight Against Trump Administration
news.summary: A group representing tech giants called government action against Anthropic a "temper tantrum," supporting the AI company against regulatory pressure. Major tech companies are publicly backing Anthropic against government action.

news.title: Big Tech Backs Anthropic in Fight Against Trump Administration
news.summary: A group representing tech giants called government action against Anthropic a "temper tantrum," supporting the AI company against regulatory pressure.

news.title: Epstein Used AI Modelling Agent to Recruit Girls, Women Tell BBC
news.summary: Investigation reveals that modelling AI agents were used by businesses to recruit girls and arrange US visas to visit Jeffrey Epstein, highlighting potential for AI abuse in recruitment.

news.title: Oil Price Volatility: Sharp Swings Raise Concerns About Economic Stability
news.summary: Oil price moves have made headlines since Iran conflict started, but analysis questions why there have been such sharp swings and potential prolonged economic impact.

news.title: Strait of Hormuz: Six Ships Attacked in 48 Hours as Iran War Continues
news.summary: Reports indicate six ships have been attacked in the Gulf in less than 48 hours, bringing total vessels attacked during conflict to 18 and threatening global oil supply.

news.title: G7 Nations Agree to Record Emergency Oil Release as Iran War Escalates
news.summary: Group of Seven nations released strategic oil reserves to stabilize global energy markets in response to price surge since US-Israel war with Iran began. Air strikes have damaged Iranian oil facilities.

news.title: Google and Tesla Join "Utilize" Coalition for Grid Efficiency
news.summary: Google and Tesla have joined a new initiative called "Utilize" that aims to make power grids more efficient through battery storage and virtual power plant technologies. The coalition seeks to make better use of existing electrons in the grid.

news.title: Meta Announces New MTIA 300 Chip for Energy-Efficient AI Inference
news.summary: Meta launched the MTIA 300 chip designed for training ranking and recommendation systems, with upcoming MTIA 400, 450, and 500 models planned for generative AI inference through 2027. Chips will mainly be used for generative AI inference.

news.title: A Hybrid Knowledge-Grounded Framework for Safety and Traceability in Prescription Verification
news.summary: Introduces PharmGraph-Auditor, a system for safe and evidence-grounded prescription auditing. Features a Hybrid Pharmaceutical Knowledge Base (HPKB) implemented under Virtual Knowledge Graph paradigm, unifying relational and graph components. Proposes KB-grounded Chain of Verification (CoV) reasoning paradigm that transforms LLM from unreliable generator into transparent reasoning engine by decomposing audit tasks into verifiable queries.

news.title: Beyond Illusion of Consensus: From Surface Heuristics to Knowledge-Grounded Evaluation in LLM-as-a-Judge
news.summary: Challenges the assumption that high inter-evaluator agreement indicates reliable LLM evaluation. Introduces "Evaluation Illusion" phenomenon where LLM judges anchor scores on surface heuristics rather than substantive quality. Demonstrates that high-quality outputs paradoxically receive least consistent evaluations. Shows that knowledge-driven rubric generation (MERG) produces more meaningful assessment in codified domains.

news.title: Instruction set for representation of graphs
news.summary: Presents IsalGraph, a method for representing structure of any finite, simple graph as a compact string over a nine-character instruction alphabet. Encoding executed by a small virtual machine comprising sparse graph, circular doubly-linked list of graph-node references, and two traversal pointers. Every string over alphabet decodes to a valid graph with no invalid states reachable. Levenshtein distance between IsalGraph strings correlates strongly with graph edit distance (GED).

news.title: Leech Lattice Vector Quantization for Efficient LLM Compression
news.summary: Introduces LLVQ (Leech Lattice Vector Quantization), leveraging the optimal sphere packing and kissing configurations of Leech lattice at 24 dimensions. Extends existing search algorithm to support indexing without materializing codebook, allow angular search over union of Leech lattice shells, and propose fully-parallelisable dequantization kernel.

news.title: Neural Field Thermal Tomography: A Differentiable Physics Framework for Non-Destructive Evaluation
news.summary: Proposes NeFTY (Neural Field Thermal Tomography), a differentiable physics framework for quantitative 3D reconstruction of material properties from transient surface temperature measurements. Parameterizes 3D diffusivity field as a continuous neural field optimized through rigorous numerical solver. Uses discretize-then-optimize paradigm to mitigate spectral bias and ill-posedness in inverse heat conduction.

news.title: Amazon Tightens AI Coding Guardrails After AWS Outages
news.summary: Amazon's eCommerce SVP announced new oversight around AI coding after recent outages linked to AI coding agent errors. Junior and mid-level engineers now require senior engineer sign-off on AI-assisted changes.

news.title: Anthropic Launches New AI Research Institute
news.summary: Co-founder Jack Clark will lead the new Anthropic Institute. Clark stated he had "no concerns" about research funding for the new initiative focused on AI safety and research.

news.title: Claude Can Now Generate Interactive Visuals Automatically
news.summary: Claude will automatically generate interactive visuals based on your conversation, or you can ask it directly. This new capability enhances data visualization and communication.

news.title: Claude Gains Cross-App Capabilities with Excel and PowerPoint
news.summary: Anthropic upgraded Claude to communicate across Excel and PowerPoint, eliminating the need to switch tabs or re-explain datasets. Claude can now carry conversations across apps without losing track.

news.title: Claude Sonnet 4.6 Released by Anthropic
news.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 4.6, delivering frontier performance across coding, agents, and professional workloads at scale. The new model represents a significant upgrade in AI capabilities.

news.title: Google Brings Gemini in Chrome to More Countries
news.summary: Google expanded Gemini in Chrome to Canada, New Zealand, and India, adding support for more than 50 languages including Spanish, French, Hindi, and Chinese.

news.title: Meta Launches New MTIA 300 AI Chip
news.summary: Meta introduced the Meta Training and Inference Accelerator (MTIA) 300 chip, designed to train ranking and recommendations systems across Instagram and Facebook. Upcoming MTIA 400, 450, and 500 will handle generative AI inference.

news.title: OpenAI Acquires Promptfoo AI Security Platform
news.summary: OpenAI acquired Promptfoo, an AI security platform used by 25% of Fortune 500 companies. The tool helps identify and remediate vulnerabilities in AI systems during development.

news.title: Pentagon Ends Talks with Anthropic
news.summary: The Pentagon says "the talks are over" with Anthropic regarding national security uses of AI. Michael stated, "I don't think there's a scenario where this gets resolved in that way," according to Bloomberg.

news.title: Yann LeCun's Startup Raises $1 Billion for AI World Models
news.summary: AI godfather Yann LeCun's Paris-based startup, Advance Machine Intelligence, raised $1 billion to build AI world models. This represents one of the largest AI funding rounds in 2026.

news.title: Australia's Katie Perry wins trademark appeal vs Katy Perry
news.summary: The US singer lost her trademark case in 2023 but later won on appeal. However, judges have now ruled against her. Australian designer Katie Perry had opposed the trademark registration.

news.title: China and North Korea resume passenger train service
news.summary: The railway connection between the two countries was suspended for six years during the pandemic. Service resumption marks a significant step toward post-pandemic regional integration and people-to-people exchanges.

news.title: China's economy under strain as innovation reliance questioned
news.summary: Beijing has spent decades relying on exports and innovation but that model is now under strain. There are questions about whether China's innovation-driven growth model is sustainable amid US tariffs and trade tensions.

news.title: Hormuz shipping traffic falls as Iran war disrupts corridor
news.summary: Footage shows significant decline in ships passing through Strait of Hormuz since US-Israeli military offensive began on 27 February. Iran has threatened to "set fire" to ships attempting to sail through the world's most vital oil transit point.

news.title: Mugabe's son drops bail request in South Africa
news.summary: The son of Zimbabwe's late former president Robert Mugabe has withdrawn a request for bail after spending time in prison. His lawyers cited "changed circumstances" without providing details. Prosecutors opposed bail, calling him a flight risk.

news.title: Russian "incendiary devices" sent to UK in 2022-2023
news.summary: Russian explosives plot involved sending incendiary parcels to the UK via courier services between March and August 2022. One parcel was marked as "fireworks device" containing magnesium. Plot highlights ongoing espionage and disruption activities affecting European security.

news.title: Zelensky sends drone teams to Middle East
news.summary: Ukrainian president says allies were asked to help count drones in the war effort. This highlights Ukraine's strategic focus on drone warfare capabilities and the importance of Western support in maintaining aerial superiority.

news.title: China's National People's Congress Concludes with Focus on Tech Development
news.summary: China's biggest political meeting is ending, with BBC correspondents providing their biggest takeaways. The Congress concluded with emphasis on technological advancement, AI development, and semiconductor industry growth, signaling continued state support for these strategic sectors.

news.title: EU and UK Demand Israel Stop Surge in West Bank Settler Violence
news.summary: Six Palestinians have been killed during attacks by settlers in the West Bank since the start of Israel's war, according to the UN. The European Union and United Kingdom have both demanded that Israel take immediate action to stop the surge in settler violence and attacks on Palestinian civilians.

news.title: G7 Nations Agree to Record Emergency Oil Release
news.summary: Group of seven nations including Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, UK, and US welcome the idea of releasing oil in response to price surge since US-Israel war with Iran began. The unprecedented move aims to stabilize global energy markets and cushion the economic blow of prolonged conflict.

news.title: Oil Prices Surge Past $100 Per Barrel as Iran War Escalates
news.summary: Oil prices have jumped above $100 per barrel following Iranian attacks on ships and intensified military action. Air strikes have damaged at least four Iranian oil facilities, with prices at their highest since before the conflict began. The energy price surge is affecting global inflation and economic stability.

news.title: Three Brothers Arrested After Explosion at US Embassy in Oslo
news.summary: Norway's police attorney says authorities are investigating whether a foreign state actor was involved in an explosion at the US embassy in Oslo. Three brothers have been arrested in connection with the incident, though no charges have been filed yet and the motive remains unclear.

news.title: US and Israel Consider Iran War "Not Finished Yet"
news.summary: US President Trump and Israeli military have indicated that the campaign in Iran and Lebanon is ongoing and escalating, with Israeli forces intensifying operations and Trump stating "we're not finished yet" in response to continued attacks. The conflict shows no signs of immediate resolution despite international diplomatic efforts.

news.title: Code Concepts: Large-Scale Synthetic Dataset for AI Code Training
news.summary: NVIDIA and Hugging Face release Code Concepts, a large-scale synthetic dataset generated from programming concept seeds. Designed to advance AI code generation and understanding capabilities.

news.title: Gradio: One-Shot Any Web App with gr.HTML
news.summary: New feature enables creating any web application with just one HTML file. Simplifies rapid prototyping and deployment of AI-powered web interfaces.

news.title: Hugging Face: Modular Diffusers - Composable Building Blocks for Diffusion
news.summary: New framework provides composable building blocks for diffusion pipelines. Enables easier experimentation and customization of generative AI models with mix-and-match components.

news.title: IBM Granite 4.0 1B Speech: Compact Multilingual Model for Edge
news.summary: IBM launches a compact multilingual speech model specifically built for edge deployment with optimized performance. Designed for resource-constrained environments.

news.title: LeRobot v0.5.0: Scaling Every Dimension in Robotics AI
news.summary: Hugging Face's robotics framework gets major update with scaling improvements. Makes AI-powered robots more capable and easier to deploy in real-world scenarios.

news.title: Mixture of Experts (MoEs) in Transformers
news.summary: Technical paper exploring Mixture of Experts architectures in transformer models. Covers design principles, training techniques, and performance characteristics of sparse activation models.

news.title: NXP: Bringing Robotics AI to Embedded Platforms
news.summary: Integrates dataset recording, VLA fine-tuning, and on-device optimizations. Enables efficient deployment of robotics AI on embedded platforms with limited compute resources.

news.title: Photoroom PRX Part 3: Training Text-to-Image Model in 24 Hours
news.summary: Demonstrates end-to-end training of text-to-image model in just 24 hours. Highlights advances in efficient model training techniques for AI image generation.

news.title: Study: Keep Tokens Flowing - Lessons from 16 Open-Source RL Libraries
news.summary: Comprehensive analysis of open-source reinforcement learning libraries reveals best practices for token management, training efficiency, and agent architecture.

news.title: Ulysses Sequence Parallelism: Training with Million-Token Contexts
news.summary: Distributed training technique that enables training with million-token contexts. Pushes boundaries of long-context AI models for better understanding of large documents.

news.title: CREATE: Testing LLMs for Associative Creativity
news.summary: Introduces CREATE, a benchmark for evaluating models' capacity for creative associative reasoning. The task requires models to generate sets of paths connecting concepts in parametric knowledge, with paths evaluated on specificity (distinctiveness and closeness) and diversity (dissimilarity from other paths). Results show that frontier models achieve higher creative utility, and that thinking models aren't always more effective even with high token budgets.

news.title: From Data Statistics to Feature Geometry: How Correlations Shape Superposition
news.summary: This paper challenges the traditional understanding of superposition in neural networks. While superposition has mostly been studied in idealized settings where features are sparse and uncorrelated, the authors introduce BOWS (Bag-of-Words Superposition) to demonstrate that when features are correlated, interference can be constructive rather than just noise. Features are arranged according to co-activation patterns, giving rise to semantic clusters and cyclical structures observed in real language models.

news.title: Think Before You Lie: How Reasoning Improves Honesty
news.summary: This paper investigates whether reasoning in LLMs increases honesty. Contrary to humans, who become less honest given time to deliberate, the authors find that reasoning consistently increases honesty across scales. The effect is not just about reasoning content - the underlying geometry of representational space contributes to this effect. Deceptive regions within this space are more easily destabilized by input paraphrasing.

news.title: Thinking to Recall: How Reasoning Unlocks Parametric Knowledge in LLMs
news.summary: While reasoning in LLMs plays a natural role in math, code generation, and multi-hop factual questions, its effect on simple, single-hop factual questions remains unclear. This paper finds that enabling reasoning substantially expands the capability boundary of model's parametric knowledge recall, unlocking correct answers that are otherwise effectively unreachable. The authors identify two key driving mechanisms: (1) a computational buffer effect where the model uses generated reasoning tokens to perform latent computation; and (2) factual priming where generating topically related facts acts as a semantic bridge.

news.title: French Aid Worker Among Three Killed in DR Congo Drone Strikes
news.summary: Witnesses say drone strikes hit a residential building frequently occupied by expatriates and aid workers in Goma. Attack raises humanitarian concerns in conflict zone.

news.title: G7 Agrees to Record Emergency Oil Release as Prices Surge
news.summary: Group of seven nations welcomes idea of releasing oil reserves in response to price surge since US-Israel war with Iran began. Move aims to stabilize global energy markets.

news.title: Trump Says US "Not Finished Yet" in Iran as Israel Expands Lebanon Campaign
news.summary: US president might learn that starting wars is much easier than ending them, writes BBC's international editor. Israeli military responds to Hezbollah strikes from Iran, warns Beirut residents to evacuate.

news.title: Ukraine Says It Hit Russian "Missile Component" Plant
news.summary: Russia says attack on a facility in Bryansk hit civilians and could not have been carried out without British help. Incident raises questions about targeting of dual-use technology infrastructure.

news.title: Amazon Expands Health AI Agent Access to Consumers
news.summary: Amazon expands access to its Health AI agent, a HIPAA-compliant tool that can answer general health questions, analyze medical records, and connect users to medical professionals through One Medical. The service is being made more widely available.

news.title: Grammarly Faces Backlash Over "Expert Review" Feature
news.summary: Writing enhancement tool Grammarly's "expert review" feature sparked controversy after its AI agent masqueraded as Verge staff members. Superhuman has now created an opt-out process allowing writers to disable the feature via email.

news.title: Meta Announces MTIA 300 Chip for Consumer AI Workloads
news.summary: Meta launches the MTIA 300 chip designed for training ranking and recommendation systems across Instagram and Facebook. While primarily for AI infrastructure, the chip family (MTIA 400, 450, 500) will support generative AI inference in consumer applications through 2027.

news.title: Microsoft Signals Cross-Platform Future for Xbox at GDC
news.summary: Microsoft's presence at Game Developers Conference suggested emphasis on building next-gen Xbox games for PC, with messaging that "cross-platform is the future of Xbox ecosystem." The company encouraged developers to build for Xbox on PC first.

news.title: The Verge Launches "Continue" Video Game Magazine
news.summary: Editors Mark Serrels and Jackson Ryan launched a new video game publication called Continue via Kickstarter, promising to celebrate and interrogate video game culture, creativity, and community. The campaign has already exceeded its funding goal.

news.title: Anthropic Upgrades Claude's Spreadsheet and Slide Deck Skills
news.summary: Claude can now communicate across Excel and PowerPoint, saving users from switching tabs or re-explaining datasets. Anthropic says Claude "carries conversation across apps without losing track of what's happening in either."

news.title: Grammarly Allows Opt-Out from "Expert Review" After Backlash
news.summary: After widespread criticism of its AI agent masquerading as Verge staff members, Superhuman now says writers can email them to opt out of Grammarly's "expert review" feature.

news.title: Hugging Face Launches Modular Diffusers Framework
news.summary: New composable building blocks for diffusion pipelines enable easier experimentation and customization of generative AI models. Modular approach allows mixing and matching components for specific use cases.

news.title: Sora Could Soon Get More Accessible in ChatGPT
news.summary: OpenAI's video generator Sora may become more accessible within ChatGPT, potentially leading to a new wave of deepfakes and creative video content generation at scale.

news.title: Study Analyzes 16 Open-Source RL Libraries
news.summary: Comprehensive analysis of open-source reinforcement learning libraries reveals best practices and lessons learned for building more efficient RL systems. Insights into token management, training efficiency, and agent architecture.

news.title: ConfCtrl: Enabling Precise Camera Control in Video Diffusion via Confidence-Aware Interpolation
news.summary: Addresses novel view synthesis from two input images under large viewpoint changes. ConfCtrl uses a confidence-weighted projected point cloud latent combined with noise as conditioning, applying a Kalman-inspired predict-update mechanism that balances pose-driven predictions with noisy geometric observations to generate stable, geometry-aware novel views.

news.title: One-Eval: An Agentic System for Automated and Traceable LLM Evaluation
news.summary: One-Eval converts natural-language evaluation requests into executable, traceable evaluation workflows. The system integrates NL2Bench for intent structuring, BenchResolve for benchmark resolution and dataset acquisition, and Metrics & Reporting for task-aware metric selection with human-in-the-loop checkpoints for review and rollback.

news.title: ReCoSplat: Autoregressive Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting Using Render-and-Compare
news.summary: ReCoSplat is an autoregressive feed-forward Gaussian Splatting model supporting posed or unposed inputs with or without camera intrinsics. The Render-and-Compare (ReCo) module renders current reconstruction from predicted viewpoint and compares it with incoming observation, providing stable conditioning that compensates for pose errors. Includes hybrid KV cache compression reducing cache size by 90%+ for 100+ frames.

news.title: Amazon Launches HIPAA-Compliant Health AI Agent
news.summary: Amazon expands access to its Health AI agent, a HIPAA-compliant tool that can answer general health questions, analyze medical records, and connect users to medical professionals through One Medical.

news.title: Amazon Strengthens AI Coding Guardrails After AWS Outages
news.summary: Following recent AWS outages linked to AI coding agent errors, Amazon now requires senior engineer sign-off for any AI-assisted changes by junior and mid-level engineers.

news.title: Anthropic Releases Claude Sonnet 4.6
news.summary: Claude Sonnet 4.6 delivers frontier performance across coding, agents, and professional work at scale, marking another significant upgrade to the Claude family.

news.title: Anthropic Releases Statement on Department of War Collaboration
news.summary: Dario Amodei releases a statement on Anthropic's discussions with the Department of War regarding national security uses of AI, addressing ethical considerations and public concerns.

news.title: Google Expands Gemini in Chrome Globally
news.summary: Google's built-in Gemini AI assistant in Chrome now supports users in Canada, New Zealand, and India with over 50 languages, enabling screen-aware assistance and cross-tab actions.

news.title: Hugging Face Introduces Storage Buckets
news.summary: Hugging Face launches Storage Buckets on the Hub, providing enhanced storage and management capabilities for AI models and datasets.

news.title: IBM Releases Granite 4.0 1B Speech Model
news.summary: IBM launches Granite 4.0 1B Speech, a compact multilingual speech model specifically built for edge deployment with optimized performance.

news.title: Meta Announces New AI Chip Family MTIA 300
news.summary: Meta launches the MTIA 300 chip designed for training ranking and recommendation systems, with upcoming MTIA 400, 450, and 500 models planned for generative AI inference through 2027.

news.title: NVIDIA and Hugging Face Release Code Concepts Dataset
news.summary: Code Concepts is a large-scale synthetic dataset generated from programming concept seeds, designed to advance AI code generation and understanding capabilities.

news.title: Ulysses Sequence Parallelism for Million-Token Contexts
news.summary: Researchers introduce Ulysses Sequence Parallelism, a distributed training technique that enables training with million-token contexts, pushing the boundaries of long-context AI models.

news.title: China set to approve new law promoting "ethnic unity"
news.summary: China's legislature is advancing a law that could threaten rights of minority groups. This represents a significant shift in Xi's policy direction and signals stricter social governance measures.

news.title: Oil prices surge past $100 per barrel as Iran war escalates
news.summary: Crude oil prices rose to over $100 per barrel on Monday as turmoil in the Middle East continues. Air strikes have damaged at least four Iranian oil facilities since military operations began last month.

news.title: Saudi Aramco warns of "catastrophic consequences" if Iran war drags on
news.summary: Saudi Aramco's CEO warned that prolonged conflict in Iran could have severe economic impacts on global oil markets and energy infrastructure.

news.title: Trump says Iran war "very far ahead of schedule" in latest remarks
news.summary: Former President Trump made comments suggesting that Iran conflict is progressing faster than expected, though his remarks lacked clarity on what "schedule" he was referring to. Markets reacted nervously to the statements.

news.title: Yann LeCun's Advance Machine Intelligence raises $1 billion in Europe's largest seed round
news.summary: The Paris-based AI startup, founded by Meta's former AI chief, has secured massive funding to build AI world models. Represents Europe's largest seed investment and signals continued Global competition in AI infrastructure.

news.title: Agentic Critical Training (ACT): LLM agents learn autonomous action quality reasoning
news.summary: Training LLMs as autonomous agents often relies on imitation learning without understanding action quality. ACT is a reinforcement learning paradigm that trains agents to identify better actions and autonomously develop genuine self-reflection reasoning, achieving +5.07 points over imitation learning.

news.title: EcoAI-Resilience: Multi-objective optimization for sustainable AI-driven entrepreneurship
news.summary: AI presents unprecedented opportunities and challenges for sustainable economic development. Introduces EcoAI-Resilience framework, a multi-objective optimization approach for maximizing sustainability benefits while minimizing environmental costs. R scores exceed 0.99 across all model components.

news.title: Amazon strengthens AI coding guardrails after major outages
news.summary: Amazon's eCommerce SVP Dave Treadwell announced that junior and mid-level engineers will now require senior engineer sign-off for any AI-assisted code changes. This represents a significant policy shift in how enterprises manage AI tools in production environments.

news.title: Enterprise AI security tooling sees major consolidation
news.summary: OpenAI's announced acquisition of Promptfoo, an AI security platform used by 25% of Fortune 500 companies. The tool helps "identify and remediate vulnerabilities in AI systems during development." Meanwhile, Anthropic launched Claude Code Review, a multi-agent code analysis tool for enterprise code analysis.

news.title: Google and Tesla collaborate on virtual power plant initiative
news.summary: Both companies have joined the "Utilize" coalition, an initiative aimed at making power grids more efficient through battery storage and virtual power plant technologies. This addresses growing concerns about data center energy consumption.

news.title: Qualcomm launches Arduino Ventuno Q for AI robotics and automation
news.summary: Qualcomm announced a new single-board computer called Ventuno Q, powered by a Dragonwing IQ8 processor, 16GB RAM, and a 40 TOPS NPU. The platform is specifically designed for building robots and machines that function autonomously in response to input from connected sensors.

news.title: Thinking Machines Lab secures Nvidia partnership for AI training infrastructure
news.summary: Mira Murati's AI startup, Thinking Machines Lab, has established a "long-term gigawatt scale strategic partnership" with Nvidia to power its AI model training. This follows multiple founding members leaving to return to OpenAI earlier this year.

news.title: Adaptive Foreground View-Guided Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models (FVG-PT)
news.summary: Addresses failure modes in prompt tuning predictions for vision-language models. Shifts in foreground attention of visual encoder cause problems. FVG-PT introduces Foreground Reliability Gate, Foreground Distillation Compensation, and Prior Calibration modules to mitigate these issues.

news.title: Code as CoT for Text-to-Image Preview and Rare Concept Generation (CoCo)
news.summary: Code-driven reasoning framework that represents reasoning process as executable code for explicit intermediate planning. Generates structural layout of scene through code execution, followed by fine-grained image editing. CoCo-10K dataset teaches both structured draft construction and corrective visual refinement.

news.title: Synthesizing Co-Located 3D Conversations from Audio (Talking Together)
news.summary: Generates complete 3D facial animations for two participants from mixed audio streams. Proposes dual-stream architecture where each stream controls one participant, modeling head poses, orientation, and mutual gaze. Introduces novel eye gaze loss and speaker role embeddings for realistic interaction. Curates 2M+ dyadic pairs from in-the-wild videos.

news.title: Amazon disables Perplexity Comet AI browser over marketplace access
news.summary: Amazon provided 'strong evidence' that Perplexity's Comet AI browser accessed marketplace 'without authorization.' Ruling supports Amazon's decision to remove the AI browser tool from its platform.

news.title: Anthropic usage booming despite supply-chain risk designation
news.summary: Claude has been breaking daily signup records since early last week in every country where it's available. Department of War designation is having inverse effect of driving up demand for Anthropic's AI assistant.

news.title: Claude Cowork integration coming to Microsoft Copilot
news.summary: Built in close collaboration with Anthropic, Cowork helps Copilot perform long-running, multi-step tasks. Feature is in testing and will be available to preview later this month through Microsoft's Frontier program.

news.title: Community colleges spending up to $500K on AI chatbots
news.summary: Three California community colleges are spending up to $500K per year on AI chatbots that don't work well. Bots answer general questions correctly but struggled with more specific ones according to CalMatters report.

news.title: Google Photos allows users to disable AI search
news.summary: New toggle lets users choose between classic and AI-powered Ask Photos modes when searching. Google Photos lead Shimrit Ben-Yair says users want more control over their results after rocky AI launch.

news.title: OpenAI launches Codex Security with Open Source Fund
news.summary: New AI agent focused on identifying and fixing app security vulnerabilities. Codex Open Source Fund now includes conditional access to Codex Security for six-month ChatGPT Pro with Codex subscriptions offered to open source developers.

news.title: OpenAI robotics head quits over Pentagon deal
news.summary: Caitlin Kalinowski resigned from OpenAI, stating company's contract didn't do enough to protect Americans from warrantless surveillance. She expressed concern about granting AI lethal autonomy without human authorization.

news.title: Yann LeCun's Advance Machine Intelligence raises $1 billion
news.summary: Paris-based AI startup founded by Meta's former AI chief has secured massive funding to build AI world models. Represents Europe's largest seed investment and signals continued Global competition in AI infrastructure.

news.title: A Live Benchmark for Temporal Generalization in Time Series Forecasting
news.summary: Impermanent is a live benchmark that evaluates forecasting models under open-world temporal change by scoring forecasts sequentially over time on continuously updated data streams. It focuses on GitHub open-source activity from top 400 repositories, constructing time series from issues, PRs, push events, and stargazers.

news.title: Agentic Critical Training
news.summary: A reinforcement learning paradigm that trains LLM agents to autonomously develop reasoning about action quality, rather than imitating pre-constructed reflection text. By rewarding correct judgments about better actions among alternatives, ACT produces genuine self-reflection instead of imitating it.

news.title: Difficulty-Aware Compute Allocation for Adaptive Reasoning
news.summary: CODA dynamically allocates inference-time compute based on task difficulty, avoiding overthinking on simple problems while encouraging deliberative rollouts on challenging ones. It estimates difficulty via group-based rollouts and maps to two non-negative gates that modulate a length-dependent shaping term.

news.title: Efficient Autoregressive Long Video Generation via Hierarchical Denoising

news.title: AI for Climate-Resilient Transport: Reinforcement Learning Framework
news.summary: Novel RL-based decision-support framework for long-term flood adaptation planning. news.title: AllScAIP: A Recipe for Scalable Attention-Based MLIPs
news.summary: MLIPs have advanced rapidly, but as models scale to larger systems like biomolecules and electrolytes, they struggle to accurately capture long-range (LR) interactions, leading current approaches to rely on explicit physics-based terms. We propose AllScAIP, a straightforward, attention-based, and energy-conserving MLIP model that scales to O(100M) training samples.

news.title: BEVLM: Distilling Semantic Knowledge from LLMs into Bird's-Eye View Representations
news.summary: Connects spatially consistent BEV representations with LLMs for cross-view driving. Enables LLMs to reason more effectively by 46% and improves closed-loop performance by 29% in safety-critical scenarios.

news.title: Ensemble GNNs for SST Forecasting via Input Perturbations
news.summary: Investigates ensemble learning strategies for sea surface temperature forecasting using Graph Neural Networks. Implements homogeneous ensemble approach inspired by bagging with diversity during inference via initial state perturbations. Assesses forecasts over 15-day horizon using deterministic (RMSE, bias) and probabilistic metrics (CRPS, Spread-skill ratio).

news.title: Fly360: Omnidirectional Obstacle Avoidance within Drone View
news.summary: Lightweight perception-decision pipeline with fixed random-yaw training for panoramic drones. Achieves stable omnidirectional obstacle avoidance and outperforms forward-view baselines across all tasks.

news.title: Multimodal Large Language Models as Image Classifiers
news.summary: Studies show MLLMs suffer from flawed evaluation protocols. Reveals inflated results from weak multiple-choice distractors and poor output mapping. ReGT evaluation shows MLLMs benefit most from corrected labels (+10.8%), narrowing perceived gap with supervised models.

news.title: Omni-Diffusion: Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
news.summary: First any-to-any multimodal LLM built on mask-based discrete diffusion models. Supports complex multi-modal scenarios. Outperforms existing multimodal systems on diverse benchmarks.

news.title: Penguin-VL: Exploring Efficiency Limits of VLM with LLM-based Vision Encoders
news.summary: Vision Language Model (VLM) development has largely relied on scaling model size, which hinders deployment on compute-constrained mobile and edge devices. We explore performance limits of compact (2B and 8B) VLMs. Penguin-VL's vision encoder, initialized from a text-only LLM, serves as a superior alternative to contrastive pretraining, unlocking a higher degree of visual fidelity and data efficiency for multimodal understanding.

news.title: SCOPE: Scene-Contextualized Incremental 3D Segmentation
news.summary: Plug-and-play background-guided prototype enrichment for IFS. Achieves +6.98% novel-class IoU, +3.61% and +1.70% mean IoU, while maintaining low forgetting on ScanNet and S3DIS.

news.title: Stem: Rethinking Causal Information Flow in Sparse Attention
news.summary: Addresses quadratic computational complexity of self-attention in LLMs during pre-filling. Proposes Stem, a plug-and-play sparsity module aligned with information flow. Employs Token Position-Decay strategy and Output-Aware Metric to retain initial tokens while achieving superior accuracy with reduced computation.

news.title: SUREON: A Benchmark and Vision-Language Model for Surgical Reasoning

news.title: Memory-efficient LLM Training by Scaling Orthogonal Transformation
news.summary: Introduces POET-X, a scalable and memory-efficient variant of Reparameterized Orthogonal Equivalence Training (POET). While POET provides strong training stability through orthogonal transformations, its original implementation has high memory and computational overhead. POET-X maintains generalization and stability benefits while achieving substantial improvements in throughput and memory efficiency. Enables pretraining of billion-parameter LLMs on a single Nvidia H100 GPU.

news.title: Anthropic CEO claims refusal to pander to Trump caused Pentagon blowup
news.summary: Dario Amodei suggested Anthropic's relationship with government soured because, unlike OpenAI, "we haven't donated to Trump" and "we haven't given dictator-style praise to Trump."

news.title: The Spike, the Sparse and the Sink: Transformer Language Model Analysis
news.summary: Study of massive activations and attention sinks in Transformers, showing co-occurrence is largely an architectural artifact of pre-norm configuration.

news.title: Censored LLMs as a Natural Testbed for Secret Knowledge Elicitation
news.summary: Using Chinese-developed open-weights LLMs (Qwen3) that censor politically sensitive topics as a natural testbed, the authors evaluate honesty elicitation and lie detection techniques. They find that sampling without chat templates, few-shot prompting, and fine-tuning on honesty data most reliably increase truthful responses. Linear probes trained on unrelated data offer a cheaper alternative for lie detection.

news.title: Memory-efficient LLM Training by Scaling Orthogonal Transformation (POET-X)
news.summary: POET-X is a scalable variant of the Reparameterized Orthogonal Equivalence Training (POET) framework that dramatically reduces memory and computational overhead. It enables pretraining of billion-parameter LLMs on a single Nvidia H100 GPU, where standard optimizers like AdamW run out of memory under the same constraints.

news.title: Reasoning Theater: Disentangling Model Beliefs from Chain-of-Thought
news.summary: This paper analyzes "performative chain-of-thought" where LLMs continue generating reasoning tokens even after becoming confident in their answer. Using DeepSeek-R1 671B and GPT-OSS 120B, the authors show that models often decodable their final answers from activations much earlier than their CoT would suggest, especially for easy questions, while genuine reasoning occurs on difficult multihop tasks.

news.title: The Spike, the Sparse and the Sink: Anatomy of Massive Activations and Attention Sinks
news.summary: Through systematic experiments, this work demonstrates that massive activations (extreme outliers in specific channels) and attention sinks (tokens attracting disproportionate attention) serve related but distinct functions. Massive activations operate globally as implicit parameters, while attention sinks operate locally to modulate attention patterns. The pre-norm configuration enables their co-occurrence.

news.title: Transformer-Based Inpainting for Real-Time 3D Streaming in Sparse Multi-Camera Setups
news.summary: The authors propose a novel multi-view aware transformer network for real-time 3D streaming inpainting. Using spatio-temporal embeddings, the method ensures consistency across frames while preserving fine details. An adaptive patch selection strategy balances inference speed and quality, achieving real-time performance.

news.summary: Iran has targeted Amazon data centers in a "jolt to Gulf AI drive," disrupting cloud infrastructure in the region. Meanwhile, Oracle and OpenAI have scrapped their deal to expand a flagship Texas data center. The US is drawing up strict new AI guidelines amid an Anthropic clash. news.summary: Iran has issued warnings that it will target US military bases across the region hours after the US president issued an apology. Israeli strikes hit Beirut hotel killing four and wounding 10, with damage to civilian facilities in Kuwait from falling debris. The conflict continues to escalate with oil infrastructure being targeted.

news.title: Rapper-politician Balendra Shah defeats Nepal's ex-PM in landslide
news.summary: Balendra Shah, 35, has unseated former Nepalese Prime Minister Sharma KP Oli with 68,348 votes compared to Oli's 18,734. Thursday's general election, the first since violent youth-led protests toppled the government in September, pitted establishment against a new generation of Gen Z politicians. The unrest was triggered by Oli's banning of social media platforms, with 77 killed during protests.

news.title: Tornadoes kill six across Michigan and Oklahoma
news.summary: At least six people have died and dozens injured after tornadoes struck Michigan and Oklahoma. Four died in southern Michigan including a 12-year-old boy, and two in Oklahoma. The storms uprooted trees, downed power lines, damaged buildings, and ripped roofs off houses. The National Weather Service warns severe weather could continue with flash flooding from Great Plains to Texas.

news.title: Trump officials question Australian Jewish leader on gun policies
news.summary: Trump administration officials, including the president's antisemitism envoy, asked visiting Australian Jewish leader Alex Ryvchin why Australian Jews aren't armed following the Bondi Beach terror attack that killed 15 people. The US officials showed interest in whether the event was "left vulnerable" by being unarmed, contrasting American individualistic security approaches with Australian culture.

news.title: DOGE used ChatGPT to gut the National Endowment for the Humanities

Instead of thorough review, they pulled short summaries and fed them into ChatGPT with a simple prompt asking if content related to DEI.

news.title: Armed robots deployed on Ukraine battlefield
news.summary: Ukraine has begun deploying armed robots on the battlefield against Russian forces, marking a significant escalation in autonomous weapons use. The programme represents one of the first large-scale operational deployments of lethal autonomous systems in modern warfare.

news.title: China unveils technology blueprint to close US gap
news.summary: China released its latest strategic blueprint aimed at accelerating technological development and closing the gap with US tech leadership. The document emphasizes breaking old development habits and achieving breakthroughs in critical technology sectors.

news.title: Indonesia passes law banning social media for under 16s
news.summary: Indonesia has enacted legislation banning social media and other online platforms for users under 16 years old. The law is the latest in a global trend of countries curbing young people's access to digital spaces, aiming to protect minors from abuse and mental health risks.

news.title: Iran war escalates: Amazon data centres targeted, oil surges to 2023 highs
news.summary: The US-Iran conflict intensified in the last 8 hours as Iran struck Amazon data centres in the Gulf region, disrupting AI infrastructure expansion. Oil prices have surged to their highest level since 2023 as the war triggers historic supply concerns. Dubai Airport operations partially resumed amid ongoing missile threats.

news.title: US draws up strict new AI guidelines amid Anthropic clash
news.summary: The US government is preparing to introduce significantly stricter AI regulations following tensions with Anthropic. The new guidelines mark a shift in the federal approach to AI oversight and could establish new compliance frameworks for the entire industry.

news.title: Anthropic Designated as "Supply Chain Risk" by Department of War
news.summary: Pentagon designates Anthropic as a national security supply chain risk, but company responds challenging the designation as legally unsound. Defense contractors are reportedly pivoting away from Claude despite Anthropic's clarification that the designation has narrow scope.

news.title: Claude Sonnet 4.6: 1M Token Context at Sonnet Pricing
news.summary: Anthropic's most capable Sonnet model delivers frontier-level performance with 1M token context window beta, while maintaining Sonnet 4.5 pricing at $3/$15 per million tokens. Major improvements in coding, computer use, and long-context reasoning approach Opus 4.5 performance levels at significantly lower cost.

news.title: Hugging Face Introduces Modular Diffusers
news.summary: New framework for diffusion pipelines allows composing reusable blocks instead of writing entire pipelines from scratch. Blocks can be inspected independently, swapped freely, and composed into custom workflows, with integration to Mellon's node-based visual interface.

news.title: Meta Temporarily Allows Rival AI Chatbots on WhatsApp in EU
news.summary: Meta will allow general-purpose AI chatbots using WhatsApp Business API in Europe for the next 12 months in a bid to stave off EU antitrust action. The move follows previous blocking of competitor chatbots and comes with a fee structure for access.

news.title: OpenAI Launches Codex Security in Research Preview
news.summary: New application security agent identifies complex vulnerabilities with high confidence, reducing false positives by 50% and noise by 84%. Rolling out to ChatGPT Pro, Enterprise, Business, and Edu customers with free access for the first month; has already found critical vulnerabilities in OpenSSH, GnuTLS, and other major open-source projects.

news.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5.3 Instant with Reduced Hallucinations
news.summary: Update to ChatGPT's most-used model delivers 26.8% reduction in hallucinations with web access, 19.7% without. Features smoother conversational tone, fewer unnecessary refusals, and better web search synthesis while maintaining speed. Available now to all users.

news.title: PRX: Training Competitive Text-to-Image Model in 24 Hours
news.summary: Photoroom demonstrates how far the field has evolved with a 24-hour speedrun using 32 H200 GPUs and ~$1500 compute budget. Combines x-prediction, pixel-space training, perceptual losses (LPIPS + DINO), token routing with TREAD, and representation alignment with REPA/DINOv3. Code open-sourced on GitHub.

news.title: Agentic AI Can Complete Whole Courses for Students. Now What?
news.summary: A 22-year-old entrepreneur launched Einstein, an agentic AI tool that connects to Canvas learning management systems and can watch lectures, write papers, participate in discussions, and submit homework automatically. The tool has since received a cease-and-desist from Instructure (Canvas owner) and been taken down, but sparked intense debate about the future of online education.

news.title: In-Person Classes Aren't Safe From the AI Cheating Boom
news.summary: A study at Arizona State University found that 45% of points in in-person biology courses can be easily earned through digital cheating methods including AI-powered tools, electronic clickers, and smart devices. Students report gaming participation systems, snapping pictures of test materials, and using agentic AI to complete assignments.

news.title: Journal Submissions Riddled With AI-Created Fake Citations
news.summary: Academic journals are increasingly plagued by AI-generated fake citations that are nearly impossible to detect, with editors reporting phantom references appearing in submissions. One journal editor noted seeing more AI-generated citations now than when she started just a year ago, while Springer has implemented integrity screening due to the rising issue.

news.title: Legal Advocacy Group Raises Concern About AI in Federal Student Aid
news.summary: Student Defense is using FOIA requests to investigate how the Trump administration is using AI to handle federal student aid programs, fearing inadequate safeguards could compromise student data privacy. The group has submitted 12 requests exploring AI use in handling student inquiries, establishing new regulations on loan forgiveness and repayment plans, and processing veterans' education benefits.

news.title: With Teens Comfortable Confiding in AI, Should Schools Embrace It for Mental Health Care?
news.summary: Schools like Interlachen Jr.-Sr. High in Florida are using AI platforms such as Alongside to monitor student mental health, with the tool flagging potential self-harm or harm to others based on student chats. At least 9 companies in this space have received funding since 2022, and Alongside is used by more than 200 schools nationwide.

news.title: Bringing Robotics AI to Embedded Platforms: Dataset Recording, VLA Fine-Tuning, and On-Device Optimizations
news.summary: Hugging Face published a comprehensive guide on deploying robotics AI on embedded platforms. The flow covers dataset recording (OpenHAB), VLA model fine-tuning (Octo), and on-device optimizations for performance.

news.title: Epic v. Google Case Heading to Supreme Court
news.summary: Both Epic and Google have agreed to withdraw the case, meaning the antitrust battle won't proceed to the Supreme Court. Rule 46.1 reads that if all parties file in writing that a case be dismissed, "the Clerk, without further reference to the Court, will enter an order of dismissal."

news.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Virtual Boy Lineup Expands
news.summary: Nintendo is adding Virtual Boy versions of Mario Tennis and a game called Mario Clash to Switch Online + Expansion Pack subscription starting March 10th (that's Mario Day). Nintendo is also adding Game Boy Advance version of Mario vs. Donkey Kong to the service.

news.title: OpenAI Codex Open Source Fund Announced
news.summary: Separately, it announced [Codex Open Source Fund](https://developers.openai.com/codex/community/codex-for-oss), also now including "conditional access" to Codex Security as part of a six-month program. The subscriptions will integrate into OpenAI's $200/month paid tiers.

news.title: OpenAI Launches Codex Security Research Preview Agent
news.summary: OpenAI introduces a new research preview AI agent focused on identifying and fixing app security issues, marking a shift toward more open and collaborative security research. Available in research preview for open source developers.

news.title: PlayStation 5 Pro Receiving PSSR Upscaling Upgrade
news.summary: An improved version of Playstation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) is rolling out to PS5 Pro "in the coming weeks," starting with Resident Evil Requiem. In March, "multiple existing games" will also get support for new version of PSSR, which could deliver upscaling quality similar to AMD's FSR 4.

news.title: Xbox Ally X Adds AI Screen Recording with Highlight Reels
news.summary: Any Xbox Insider PC can opt into Microsoft's new "postgame recaps," but Xbox Ally X handheld's integrated NPU takes it further with Copilot-generated "highlight reels." To start, it'll only work with Among Us, Elden Ring, Fortnite, Forza Horizon 5, Lies of P, Overwatch, and Palworld. Let me know if it's better than a normal recap?

news.title: Censored LLMs as a Natural Testbed for Secret Knowledge Elicitation
news.summary: Studies open-weights LLMs from Chinese developers (e.g., Qwen3) trained to censor politically sensitive topics. These models frequently produce falsehoods about suppressed topics while occasionally answering correctly, indicating knowledge they are trained to hide. Evaluated various elicitation techniques.

news.title: Effective Amortized Optimization Using Inexpensive Labels
news.summary: Proposes a novel framework that first collects "cheap" imperfect labels, performs supervised pretraining, then refines the model through self-supervised learning. Empirical validation across nonconvex constrained optimization, power-grid operation, and stiff dynamical systems shows faster convergence; improved accuracy, feasibility, and optimality; and up to 59x reductions in total offline cost.

news.title: Leveraging LLM Parametric Knowledge for Fact Checking without Retrieval
news.summary: Introduces the task of fact-checking arbitrary natural language claims without retrieval. Across 9 datasets and 18 methods, experiments show that logit-based approaches often underperform compared to methods leveraging internal model representations. INTRA, a new method exploiting internal representation interactions, achieves state-of-the-art performance with strong generalization.

news.title: Memory-efficient LLM Training by Scaling Orthogonal Transformation (POET-X)
news.summary: POET-X is a scalable, memory-efficient variant that enables pretraining of billion-parameter LLMs on a single Nvidia H100 GPU, unlike standard optimizers like AdamW that run out of memory.

news.title: Reasoning Theater: Disentangling Model Beliefs from Chain-of-Thought
news.summary: Provides evidence of "performative" chain-of-thought in reasoning models where models become confident in final answers early but continue generating tokens. Analysis shows that final answers are decodable from activations far earlier than a monitor can detect, and probe-guided early exit reduces tokens by up to 80% on MMLU with similar accuracy.

news.title: The Spike, Sink, and Sparse: Anatomy of Massive Activations and Attention Sinks
news.summary: Studies two recurring phenomena in Transformer language models: massive activations (extreme outliers in a few channels) and attention sinks (tokens attracting disproportionate attention regardless of semantic relevance). Shows that their co-occurrence is largely an architectural artifact of modern Transformer design, and that two phenomena serve related but distinct functions: massive activations operate globally as implicit parameters, while attention sinks operate locally to modulate attention outputs.

news.title: Epic Sues Fortnite Leaker Over NDA Violation
news.summary: Epic Games filed lawsuit against Hayden Cohen, a former contractor who leaked details of upcoming collaborations on X and Discord under aliases AdiraFN and AdiraFNInfo despite signing an NDA. The leaker shared confidential franchise information.

news.title: Lenovo Announces Legion 7A with AMD Strix Halo APU

news.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Virtual Boy Lineup Expands
news.summary: Nintendo is adding Virtual Boy versions of Mario Tennis and a game called Mario Clash to Switch Online + Expansion Pack subscription starting March 10th. Also adding Game Boy Advance version of Mario vs. Donkey Kong.

news.title: PS5 Pro Receiving PSSR Upscaling Upgrade
news.summary: An improved Spectral Super Resolution feature is rolling out to PS5 Pro. Quality is described as similar to AMD's FSR 4 upscaling technology. Will enhance gaming visuals for supported titles.

news.title: Pro-Human Declaration Signed by Teachers, Congress, Progressive Democrats, and Steve Bannon
news.summary: A major declaration has been signed by American Federation of Teachers, Congress of Christian Leaders, Progressive Democrats of America, and Steve Bannon, highlighting concerns about AI-powered surveillance and autonomous weapons.

news.title: Iran School/Base Strike with 168 Casualties
news.summary: Iranian authorities say attack on Saturday killed 168 people at school and nearby military base. Satellite imagery confirms multiple strikes on same location. Iran vows revenge for weekend attacks.

news.title: Noem Homeland Security Chief Removed
news.summary: President Trump fired Kirstjen Nielsen as Homeland Security secretary after mounting backlash over deportation crackdown. Chooses Oklahoma senator Markwayne Mullin as replacement. Leadership change at DHS could affect cybersecurity policy, immigration rules for tech workers.

news.title: Agentics 2.0: Lightweight, Python-Native Framework for High-Quality Agentic Data Workflows
news.summary: Agentics 2.0 is a lightweight, Python-native framework for building high-quality, structured, explainable, and type-safe agentic data workflows. At core is logical transduction algebra formalizing LLM inference calls as typed semantic transformations, composing into larger programs via algebraically grounded operators in asynchronous Map-Reduce-style parallel execution. news.title: Build, Judge, Optimize: A Blueprint for Continuous Improvement of Multi-Agent Consumer Assistants
news.summary: Conversational shopping assistants represent a compelling application of agentic AI, but moving from prototype to production reveals two underexplored challenges: how to evaluate multi-turn interactions and how to optimize tightly coupled multi-agent systems. This paper presents a practical blueprint for evaluating and optimizing conversational shopping assistants, illustrated through production-scale AI grocery assistant. Introduces multi-faceted evaluation rubric decomposing end-to-end shopping quality into structured dimensions and develops a calibrated LLM-as-judge pipeline aligned with human annotations. Building on evaluation foundation, investigates two complementary prompt-optimization strategies: (1) Sub-agent GEPA optimizing individual agent nodes against localized rubrics, and (2) MAMuT (Multi-Agent Multi-Turn) GEPA jointly optimizing prompts across agents using multi-turn simulation and trajectory-level scoring.

news.title: RealPref: Evaluating Long-Horizon Preference Following in Personalized User-LLM Interactions
news.summary: LLMs are increasingly serving as personal assistants where users share complex, diverse preferences over extended interactions. This work proposes RealPref, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating how well LLMs can follow these preferences in realistic, long-horizon situations. RealPref features 100 user profiles, 1,300 personalized preferences, four types of preference expression (ranging from explicit to implicit), and long-horizon interaction histories. Results indicate that LLM performance significantly degrades as context length grows and preference expression becomes more implicit. This research provides foundation for developing user-aware LLM assistants that can better adapt to individual needs.

news.title: Expectation and Acoustic Neural Network Representations Enhance Music Identification from Brain Activity
news.summary: During music listening, cortical activity encodes both acoustic and expectation-related information. Prior work has shown that ANN representations resemble cortical representations and can serve as supervisory signals for EEG recognition. Here we show that distinguishing acoustic and expectation-related ANN representations as teacher targets improves EEG-based music identification. Models pretrained to predict either representation outperform non-pretrained baselines, and combining them yields complementary gains that exceed strong seed ensembles formed by varying random initializations. These findings show that teacher representation type shapes downstream performance and that representation learning can be guided by neural encoding.

news.title: Inherited Goal Drift: Contextual Pressure Can Undermine Agentic Goals
news.summary: The accelerating adoption of language models (LMs) as agents for deployment in long-context tasks motivates a thorough understanding of goal drift: agents' tendency to deviate from an original objective. While prior-generation LLM agents have been shown to be susceptible to drift, the extent to which drift affects more recent models remains unclear. This work investigates drift in state-of-the-art models (GPT-5.1, Claude, etc.) within a simulated stock-trading environment. These models are largely shown to be robust even when subjected to adversarial pressure. We show, however, that this robustness is brittle: across multiple settings, the same models often inherit drift when conditioned on prefilled trajectories from weaker agents. The extent of conditioning-induced drift varies significantly by model family, with only GPT-5.1 maintaining consistent resilience among tested models. We find that drift behavior is inconsistent between prompt variations and correlates poorly with instruction hierarchy following behavior, with strong hierarchy following failing to reliably predict resistance to drift.

news.title: Learning Demographic-Conditioned Mobility Trajectories with Aggregate Supervision
news.summary: Existing trajectory generation models rarely capture heterogeneity because most trajectory datasets lack demographic labels. We propose ATLAS, a weakly supervised approach for demographic-conditioned trajectory generation using only (i) individual trajectories without demographic labels, (ii) region-level aggregated mobility features, and (iii) region-level demographic compositions from census data. ATLAS trains a trajectory generator and fine-tunes it so that simulated mobility matches observed regional aggregates while conditioning on demographics. Experiments on real trajectory data with demographic labels show that ATLAS substantially improves demographic realism over baselines.
